jobs.excerpt: Who we are For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.

Our Vision

Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.

Our Business

Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.

Our Value

Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.

All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!

About the role

The Director, Area Asset Manager position will have responsibility for meeting and exceeding EBITDA and Free Cash Flow targets for the asset base under their direction. They will also lead asset management and development activities across a regional base of assets (primarily Energy-from-Waste facilities). The role entails direct oversight of revenue generating activities including service agreements, merchant waste as well as expense and capital items related to facility operations, improvements, and operational byproducts (residues). They will also have shared responsibilities in the areas of energy sales development and contracting, as well as residue management and revenue related thereof. Working closely with the Area Operations Manager, a significant part of the role is coordinating activities across operational, financial, energy, legal, business development, engineering, construction, environmental, government relations, and human resources disciplines and departments.

It is anticipated that the primary focus of the Director workload will be (i) regional financial performance, and (ii) regional asset development and asset improvement related activities that can further advance the entire company portfolio. Notable areas of identified opportunities include moving up the waste hierarchy, bolt on treatment technologies to support the growth of our Environmental Solutions (profiled) waste business, effective ash management/reuse, enhanced metals recovery, and enhancement of our energy portfolio capabilities (profitability/efficiency/diversity of energy production).

The Director must be able to originate and task a goal-oriented team of multi-disciplined managers in a way to harmoniously effectuate revenue growth and profit improvement of our asset base.

This role will be the principal point of contact for reporting and discussing financial performance of the asset base within their jurisdiction. The Director must be able to engage in constructive dialogue and have a sound decision making process to achieve success in the role and for the company. On regular occasions, the Director will report to the Chief Commercial Officer on assets and financial performance.


DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

· Profit and Loss management

  • Asset Improvement & Asset Development focused on revenue and margin growth

· Contract oversight & compliance

  • Effective and prompt service delivery to Reworld customer base
  • Implementation of market strategy, including merchant waste and client agreement contracting strategies
  • Ability to manage and direct stakeholders at all levels – including internal and external senior executive and/or elected level decision makers.

· Risk management

  • Strategy development, Business Development and/or strategy implementation

REQUIREMENTS (Education, Skills, Certificate, Licenses, Experience):

Education: Business degree or strong technical degree combined with a well-developed operating background required. MBA with a bachelor’s in engineering or business/ finance preferred.

Minimum of 7 years of waste/energy/production related industry experience in a senior management role required · Prior knowledge and experience managing profit and loss, budgets and forecasts in an industrial/production environment or commensurate experience in our existing Energy-from-Waste business required.

  • Must possess strong business acumen
  • Solid analytical, planning and organizational skills and ability to multi-task
  • Highly developed verbal and written communication and negotiation skills
  • Proactive thinking with detail-oriented and creative problem-solving approach
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships
  • Exceptionally strong planning and interpersonal skills
  • Developed executive presence; engaging personality and the confidence to make decisions Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with partners and government officials
  • Strong strategic thinker with well-practiced negotiation skills
  • Strong manager, team player with commensurate leadership skills
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate and execute in an operating business

· Goal-oriented mindset

What Reworld Offers You:

  • Health Care Benefits - start 1st day of employment
  • Performance based Annual Incentive Plan
  • Wellness Program Incentives & Rewards

· 401k - match up to 7%

  • Paid Time Off (Vacation & Holiday)

· Paid Parental Leave

  • Short-Term & Long-Term Disability Benefits

· Tuition Reimbursement

· Employee Referral Bonus

In addition to salary, this role is eligible for benefits. The benefits would include medical, prescription drug, vision, and dental plans; 401(k) plan; paid parental leave; paid time off; and paid holidays.

Additional details are available at .

For additional information, refer to the Pay Transparency section below.

All Reworld positions require a candidate's ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the role while upholding Reworld's Values, including (but not limited to) contributing to a safe and inclusive workplace, delivering results through trust, and building breakthrough capabilities.

Please note that Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills.

Pay Transparency


Reworld is committed to paying its staff equitably, and we strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits packages. The range below reflects Reworld’s reasonable estimate of base pay for this role based on primary posting location. It is expected that most qualified candidates in this location will fall within the posting range. The final salary offered for this role will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to: experience, education, geographic location, skills and competencies, travel requirements and/or union contracts (if applicable). Pay ranges are reviewed from time to time and may be modified in the future.

Our 401(k) plan is industry-leading, with an up to 7% company match. Additional benefits include Company-paid life and AD&D insurance, EAP, paid parental leave, and educational assistance. For more information regarding these offerings, please visit the Reworld Careers Benefits Page. Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Role summary:
As a Data Analyst II, you will combine technical expertise and business acumen to support testing, release validation, and cross-product quality assurance. You will identify and analyze data discrepancies before deployment, helping prevent issues that impact Suppliers, Merchants, and other business partners. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Support teams, you will validate business-critical metrics, translate complex defects into actionable solutions, and drive resolution efforts. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, adaptability in a fast-paced environment, and a passion for advancing automation through agentic AI and innovative testing practices.
About the team:
The Data Quality and Testing teams at Data Ventures ensure data integrity and system resilience through thorough validations and comprehensive testing frameworks. Leveraging advanced machine learning, anomaly detection, and automation, they proactively identify irregularities and validate global data pipelines. Their certification and monitoring processes support continuous quality assurance and timely issue resolution across Walmart’s ecosystem. Collaborating with global stakeholders, these teams drive process enhancements, strengthen data governance, and accelerate innovation by delivering automated testing and data quality solutions that enable reliable, data-driven decision-making and support business growth.
What you'll do:
  • Support release validation, cross-product testing, and data quality assurance activities.
  • Identify and analyze data discrepancies before deployment to prevent business-impacting issues.
  • Validate business-critical metrics and investigate defects to ensure product quality and reliability.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to translate findings into actionable solutions and drive issue resolution.
  • Leverage data analysis, automation, and agentic AI tools to improve testing efficiency and accelerate delivery.

What you'll bring:
  • Experience with software testing, release validation, and test automation using Playwright.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery.
  • Ability to analyze data, identify defects, and validate business-critical metrics.
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into actionable solutions.
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams and a passion for automation, AI-driven tools, and continuous improvement.

jobs.excerpt: Our Why At Dotmatics At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive.
jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need:

As a Validation Lead, you will be responsible for leading validation activities for the Dotmatics Luma platform and its internal systems operating under GxP requirements. Serving as the subject matter expert for computer system validation (CSV) and ensures that software development, testing, and release activities comply with applicable regulations and standards including 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, ICH Q10, and ISO 9001 as applicable.

The Validation Lead partners closely with Product, Engineering, and Quality Management teams to drive validation best practices throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), ensuring traceable, audit ready deliverables that meet customer and regulatory expectations.

In this role you will get to:

  • Author, review, and approve validation lifecycle documentation including Validation Master Plans, URS, FRS, Traceability Matrix, Risk Assessments, IQ, OQ, PQ protocols and reports following GAMP 5 principles, including risk-based approaches to validation activities
  • Working with the software quality team and devops to leverage automated tools such as Cypress to develop, review and run IQ, OQ, and PQ protocols.
  • Apply GAMP 5 framework to determine appropriate validation strategies and documentation requirements.
  • Mentor/lead junior validation team members and QA staff on validation methodologies and documentation best practices.
  • Serve as Luma subject matter expert for GAMP5, 21 CFR Part, EU Annex 11, and applicable ISO standards.
  • Provide validation guidance and training to engineers, QA analysts, and project managers on CSV principles, IQ/OQ/PQ expectations, and 21 CFR Part 11 controls.

We are looking for people who can support customer-facing validation activities, coordinate validation testing and defect resolution, assist with CAPA investigations and audit responses, and collaborate with the Quality Management team to maintain document control, periodic reviews, and overall audit readiness for validation artefacts.

The key skills we are looking for:

  • Deep working knowledge of GAMP 5, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and GxP requirements as they apply to software systems
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001quality management system principles
  • Demonstrated experience authoring and executing IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, traceability matrices, and validation summary reports, including use of automated testing tools (e.g., Cypress, Playwright) to generate and capture test evidence
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
  • Experience with validation of cloud-based systems, SaaS applications, or commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software

You may also have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biology, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field (preferred but not required).
  • Background in regulated life sciences environments, such as pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industries.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

The ABM will demonstrate initiative, drive, independence, and take ownership for meeting and exceeding individual business goals. Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and Specialty Care neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Report To: Consulting Delivery manager

Who is ControlPlane?

ControlPlane is a London-headquartered consultancy specialising in cloud-native, Kubernetes, and open-source security solutions. Our expertise lies in helping organisations adopt and secure complex cloud infrastructures by implementing security measures that are "secure-by-design" and "secure-by-default." This engineering excellence drives ControlPlane deep into cybersecurity, providing services like zero-trust architectures, threat modeling, supply chain security, and platform engineering.

We are acclaimed for our work in highly regulated industries, such as finance, healthcare, and national infrastructure. We help clients consume next-generation and open-source projects safely and securely. In addition to consulting, we are active contributors to the open-source community supporting projects like Flux CD, OpenBao, and FINOS AI Readiness.

What We’re Looking For in a Cloud Native Consultant

We are looking for cloud native engineers and consultants at all levels to represent the technical and cultural values of ControlPlane, leading our customers by example in the complex and fast-changing world of cloud native technology. You will perform a mix of client consulting, working on internal labs projects, and contributing to Open Source projects on ControlPlane’s behalf.

This is a remote position, but we invite you to spend time in person at our London office: this is optional and we aim to be entirely flexible to your needs.

As part of the engineering team we may ask you to be involved in pre-sales or business development activities to support the ongoing growth of our organisation.

Role, Responsibilities and Requirements of Our Cloud Native Consultant

What you'll bring (Essential):

  • Experience and a deep understanding of Kubernetes using GKE, EKS or OpenShift
  • Experience with one or more cloud providers and Infrastructure as Code tools and practices
  • Experience with GitOps tooling such as FluxCD or ArgoCD
  • Development experience with Golang, Python, or Java
  • Understanding of CI/CD best practices and a range of build tools
  • Cloud security awareness and a desire to build hardened systems
  • Customer facing/Consulting experience.

What you'll bring (Desirable):

  • Experience with SPIFFE/SPIRE
  • Experience with Hashicorp Vault/OpenBao
  • Experience with Zero Trust Architectures, tools and practices

Benefits

ControlPlane is a dynamic, cutting-edge and passionate business to work for. Our employees are at the heart of our business, which means we care about our culture, our people and their progression.

Alongside this, as a colleague you will have the following benefits:

  • Generous and competitive salary + Bonus

  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance
  • An individual training budget for personal development, including but not limited to:

We are looking for technical practitioners who can work with our clients and the team to deliver these projects and help establish ControlPlane as a world-class technical thought leader.

We believe our peers are equally as important as the technology we use. We’re looking for people of the highest personal calibre, quietly confident, with a good work ethic, keenness to learn, emotional maturity and respect, who know that “we” is more than “me”, and who embrace human diversity of all kinds. As we grow you will help us to build a company culture of which we can all be proud. If you espouse these values, we want you!

jobs.title: Patient Strategy & Experience, Customer Experience Lead
jobs.excerpt: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back.
jobs.description:
Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.

We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

As the Patient Customer Experience (CX) Lead, you are accountable for building and leading the discipline within the argenx Patient Strategy & Experience. You will establish how argenx understands, designs, delivers, and continuously improves the end-to-end experience of patients and caregivers across the enterprise portfolio, therapeutica areas, indications, brands, and stages of the patient journey.

You will create the frameworks, methods, standards, and capabilities that enable argenx to translate patient needs, behaviors, and experiences into meaningful experience-related and business decisions. Through end-to-end journey design, voice-of-patient insights, Design Thinking (DT), Human-Centered Design (HCD), co-creation, experimentation, and rapid prototyping, you will identify the moments that matter most and help Patient Marketing and Engagement Strategy, Patient Support Services, Field Clinical Educators, Patient Advocacy, Media, and other cross-functional partners design optimal stakeholder experiences.

As a member of the Patient Strategy & Experience leadership team, you will serve as the senior integrator of CX across communities. You will also connect with CX leaders and capabilities across argenx communities to share insights, build & strengthen repeatable models, and help advance a more connected experience across customer groups. This is a new capability for argenx, requiring a leader who can bring structure to ambiguity, build the discipline from the ground up, and influence leaders across the organization to translate patient insight into measurable improvements in the experience argenx delivers.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Customer Experience Strategy & Voice of Patient

  • Define and lead CX strategy and establish the CX discipline across all argenx patient services and communities.
  • Develop and maintain an integrated, portfolio-level understanding of patient and caregiver journeys across disease areas, patient populations, and lifecycle stages.
  • Establish repeatable approaches for journey mapping, patient personas, touchpoint and channel assessment, and identification of the moments that matter most across the patient experience.
  • Define how patient insight and voice-of-patient inputs are gathered, synthesized, prioritized, and translated into strategic priorities and experience decisions.
  • Identify experience opportunities, unmet needs, friction points, and gaps across patient journeys and translate them into clear recommendations for relevant communities and teams.
  • Maintain a portfolio-level view of evolving patient needs and experiences, helping leadership determine where focused attention and investment can create the greatest impact.
  • Ensure CX strategy remains connected to evolving patient, disease, market, scientific, and portfolio dynamics.
  • Codify CX approaches and learnings into scalable frameworks and practices that can support patient-facing teams and, where relevant, inform broader CX efforts across argenx.

Design Thinking, Experience Design & Experimentation

  • Establish HCD/DT, including empathy research, co-creation workshops, and design sprints, as a core approach for developing, prototyping, testing, and improving CX concepts before they are deployed at scale.
  • Lead journey design, concept development, co-creation, prototyping, and structured testing approaches that enable argenx to learn directly from patients and caregivers.
  • Translate ambiguous or emerging opportunities into clearly defined experience challenges, hypotheses, pilots, and success measures.
  • Build an experimentation model that allows new CX concepts to be tested, refined, and de-risked before broader investment and implementation.
  • Identify opportunities to create differentiated patient experiences as argenx expands into new disease areas and patient populations.
  • Partner with patient-facing teams and external specialists to apply experience design approaches where they can create the greatest value.
  • Connect emerging scientific, medical, and portfolio developments to CX planning, so future experience needs are considered early rather than after strategies and programs are established.
  • Bring a forward-looking perspective on experience innovation, identifying new approaches, technologies, and capabilities that could meaningfully improve how patients engage with argenx and our medicines.

Cross-Community & Executive Leadership

  • Serve as the senior CX integrator across Patient Marketing and Engagement Strategy, Patient Support Services, Field Clinical Educators, Patient Advocacy, and other relevant communities and teams.
  • Translate patient journeys, voice-of-patient insights, and experience testing into clear, actionable recommendations for the teams responsible for designing and delivering patient programs and interactions.
  • Influence leaders to act on CX opportunities while preserving clear accountability within individual communities and teams for strategy and execution.
  • Partner closely with the Vice President, Patient Strategy & Experience, and represent CX directly in enterprise-wide strategic planning, portfolio governance, and executive leadership forums.
  • Connect with CX leaders and capabilities across argenx communities to share insights, contribute to common experience principles and practices, and identify opportunities to strengthen consistency and connectivity across customer journeys.
  • Build strong partnerships across Commercial, Medical, Digital & Technology, Insights & Analytics, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Clinical Trials, and other relevant communities and capabilities.
  • Create effective ways of working across patient-facing teams to strengthen alignment, reduce experience fragmentation, and create a more connected end-to-end patient journey.
  • Translate CX opportunities and insights into compelling business cases and recommendations that enable leadership action and investment decisions.
  • Champion patient-centered thinking across the organization and help build understanding of how decisions made across communities contribute to the overall experience patients have with argenx and our medicines.

Measurement, Technology & Customer Experience Capability Building

  • Define the measurement approach for CX, establishing the outcomes and indicators needed to understand experience quality, impact, and improvement across the portfolio.
  • Establish consistent approaches for measuring CX while allowing metrics to flex based on disease area, patient population, journey stage, and experience objective.
  • Use CX data, qualitative insight, behavioral signals, and other relevant measures to identify opportunities for continuous improvement across key touchpoints and journeys.
  • Bring an analytical and portfolio-level perspective to experience prioritization, ensuring resources and effort are focused where they can create the greatest patient and business impact.
  • Partner with Digital & Technology and other teams to identify, design, and deploy technology and AI-enabled solutions that can meaningfully improve the experiences patients have with argenx and our medicines.
  • Define the tools, frameworks, standards, and ways of working required to build a scalable CX capability, aligning with and contributing to broader customer experience approaches across argenx communities, where relevant.
  • Build CX and HCD capability across patient-facing teams through training, coaching, and hands-on facilitation, so teams can increasingly apply patient-centered approaches within their own work.
  • Establish external partnerships and specialist resources where needed to supplement internal capability and accelerate development of the discipline.
  • Foster a culture of patient-centeredness, curiosity, experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES:

  • Deep understanding of customer and CX strategy, experience design, Design Thinking (DT), and Human-Centered Design (HCD) within healthcare, life sciences, or other complex customer environments.
  • Ability to develop end-to-end patient journeys and translate patient needs, behaviors, insights, and pain points into clear experience priorities and strategic recommendations.
  • Strong practitioner fluency in DT/HCD approaches, including empathy mapping, journey mapping, persona development, co-creation, prototyping, testing, and iterative experience design.
  • Ability to bring structure and strategic direction to ambiguous, early-stage opportunities where no established playbook exists.
  • Strong portfolio thinking, with the ability to identify common experience needs while recognizing meaningful differences across disease areas and patient populations.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders and leaders across communities without formal authority and align teams around shared CX priorities.
  • Strong analytical orientation and ability to connect qualitative and quantitative patient insight to decisions, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ability to translate complex CX findings into compelling, actionable business recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Strong understanding of the opportunities and considerations associated with digital, data, technology, and AI in healthcare experience design.
  • Strong understanding of the regulatory, legal, compliance, and privacy considerations associated with designing patient experiences in biotechnology and pharmaceutical environments.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to bring the CX strategies and opportunities to life for a range of audiences.
  • Executive-level communication and presence, with the ability to represent CX in enterprise governance and portfolio forums.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and demonstrated ability to build new capabilities, approaches, or disciplines in an evolving organization.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • BA/BS required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Approximately 12-15+ years of relevant experience across Customer Experience, Human-Centered Design, Design Thinking, innovation, or related disciplines.
  • Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare experience required, with meaningful experience working in patient-facing environments strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience setting and leading CX, Innovation, or Human-Centered Design strategy within a complex organization.
  • Track record of building or scaling a new capability, discipline, program, or way of working from the ground up.
  • Significant experience applying HCD, journey mapping, patient/customer insight, and experimentation to improve experiences.
  • Demonstrated success influencing senior leaders and cross-community teams in a highly matrixed environment.
  • Experience translating customer or patient insight into strategic recommendations, business cases, and organizational action.
  • Experience establishing measurement approaches and using insight and performance data to guide prioritization and continuous improvement.
  • Experience partnering with Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Medical, Digital/Technology, and other teams within a regulated environment.
  • Innovation, entrepreneurial, or capability-building experience strongly preferred.
  • CX and/or Human-Centered Design credentials are a plus but are not a substitute for demonstrated strategic leadership and experience.

jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Business Analyst, you will drive strategic improvements across clinical research operations by analyzing complex business processes, gathering and translating stakeholder requirements, and designing solutions that enhance efficiency and compliance. This position plays a key role in process optimization, system implementation, requirements management, and operational transformation. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across clinical operations, follow industry-standard methodologies, and contribute to strategic initiatives from planning through execution.

Responsibilities include leading comprehensive business analysis activities, conducting process improvement initiatives, designing solutions that meet business requirements, and mentoring team members. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Business Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and technology integration.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead comprehensive analysis of business needs, processes, and workflows across clinical research functions

  • Conduct thorough requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders at all levels and translate complex business needs into clear, detailed, and actionable requirements documentation

  • Develop use cases, user stories, and functional specifications that accurately reflect business requirements and validate requirements with stakeholders to ensure completeness and accuracy

  • Analyze current state business processes to identify inefficiencies and gaps, document existing workflows using process mapping techniques, and design future state processes that optimize efficiency, quality, and compliance

  • Develop recommendations for process standardization and automation, perform cost-benefit analyses for proposed process changes, and measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented improvements

  • Collaborate with technical teams to design solutions that meet business requirements and develop functional specifications and design documents for system implementations

  • Support the development and execution of test plans and test cases, validate that implemented solutions meet business requirements and quality standards, and develop training materials and support documentation for end users

  • Lead business analysis activities for medium to large-scale projects, develop project scope and deliverables, create and manage business analysis work plans and timelines, and identify and manage risks related to requirements and solution implementation

  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders across clinical operations, facilitate communication between business units and technology teams, and present analysis findings and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels

  • Mentor junior business analysts and share best practices, stay current with industry trends and regulatory changes affecting clinical research, and identify opportunities for innovation in clinical processes and systems

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in business process analysis, requirements management, and process improvement methodologies

  • Proficiency with business analysis tools and software (JIRA, Confluence, Visio) and familiarity with process modeling notations (BPMN, UML, flowcharts)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with advanced facilitation and presentation capabilities, including the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences

  • Strong leadership capabilities including team mentoring, project coordination, decision-making, and the ability to influence without authority

  • Experience working in clinical research, pharmaceutical industry, or regulated environments with deep understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows

  • A patient-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and commitment to regulatory compliance and quality standards

Required Qualifications:

  • 5 to 7 years of business analysis experience, with at least 3 years in clinical research or pharmaceutical industry

  • Demonstrated experience leading requirements gathering and process improvement initiatives

  • Strong understanding of clinical trial processes and workflows

  • Experience with clinical systems implementation and configuration (EDC, CTMS, eTMF, etc.)

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements in clinical research (GCP, ICH, FDA, EMA)

  • Experience with Agile and traditional software development methodologies

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, information systems, life sciences, or related field

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Professional certifications such as CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional), IIBA certifications, or PMI-PBA (Professional in Business Analysis)

  • Training in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma)

  • Background in implementing or optimizing clinical data management processes

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and facilitating decision-making

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

jobs.description:
Cayenta, a division of Harris; is seeking a Technical Consultant who will join our Cayenta Managed Services (CMS) team within Managed Services & Technical Operations.

As a Technical Consultant, you will help manage and maintain the technical environments that support our customers' Cayenta ERP and Customer Information Systems. You will work across system administration, database administration, troubleshooting, maintenance, monitoring, customer support, and eventually cloud infrastructure.

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys solving problems, learning how systems work, and taking ownership of customer environments. You will initially focus primarily on on-premises customer environments, with opportunities to expand into Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud operations as the Managed Services offering continues to grow.

You will work closely with other Managed Services team members as well as Cayenta Support, Technical Services, Development, Business Intelligence, and other teams to maintain reliable, secure, and stable customer environments.

This may be the most important section of this job description. Read it carefully before applying.

Technical knowledge can be developed. Curiosity, resourcefulness, and ownership are much harder to teach.

We are looking for someone who is hungry to learn, willing to dig, and comfortable solving problems that don't come with step-by-step instructions.

In Managed Services, you will encounter unfamiliar configurations, technical issues you haven't seen before, incomplete documentation, and situations where the first answer you try doesn't work.

When you hit that wall, we don't expect you to already know everything.

We do expect you to keep going.

Search the internal knowledge base. Read the product and vendor documentation. Review previous tickets. Look at logs. Compare environments. Test safely. Ask knowledgeable teammates better questions. Use AI tools responsibly to help research, reason through possibilities, interpret information, and accelerate troubleshooting.

If one path doesn't work, try another.

And when you solve something new, document what you learned so the next person doesn't have to start from zero.

We are not looking for someone whose troubleshooting process ends with "I checked the KB and couldn't find it." We are looking for someone who sees that as the beginning of the investigation.

Ask yourself: when you last encountered a technical problem with no obvious answer, what did you do next?

If your instinct was to follow every reasonable lead until you understood what was happening, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

We are committed to using emerging technologies to improve how we work, solve problems, and support our customers.

The successful candidate will be comfortable incorporating AI-enabled tools, copilots, chat-based assistants, scripting, and automation into their everyday work where appropriate.

AI should accelerate good technical thinking-not replace it. Team members are expected to validate outputs, protect customer and company information, and follow applicable security, privacy, and compliance requirements.

You will serve as a primary or secondary technical consultant for multiple Cayenta Managed Services customers and help ensure their environments remain reliable, secure, stable, and well maintained.

This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in Canada and the US.

Salary:

75K - 85K CAD

53K - 61K USD

AI & Innovation Mindset

We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.

What your impact will be:

  • Manage multiple Cayenta ERP and/or Customer Information System environments simultaneously.
  • Perform SQL Server database administration and support environments that may also include Oracle.
  • Perform system administration for customer application and infrastructure environments.
  • Monitor customer environments and proactively address conditions that could affect availability, reliability, security, or performance.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution across teams when necessary.
  • Manage technical work through our ticketing systems and maintain clear, accurate updates.
  • Perform regular system administration activities including product releases, patching, updates, configuration changes, and maintenance.
  • Build a strong understanding of each assigned customer's environment, configuration, dependencies, and operational requirements.
  • Identify recurring problems and look for opportunities to eliminate them through better processes, automation, monitoring, or documentation.
  • Build productive, long-term customer relationships and communicate technical information clearly and professionally.
  • Prepare and deliver customer reporting containing relevant information about environment health, maintenance, risks, and activities when required.
  • Participate in the team's 24x7 on-call rotation when required.
  • Perform scheduled evening or weekend activities when customer maintenance windows require them.

Growing Into Cloud Operations

  • Help administer highly available Azure infrastructure supporting Cayenta applications.
  • Maintain Linux and Windows virtual machines and related Azure services.
  • Support Azure database, storage, networking, and security services.
  • Configure and maintain services such as Azure Storage, Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID, and single sign-on.
  • Help ensure cloud environments are designed and administered with an emphasis on availability, reliability, security, recoverability, and scalability.
  • Develop scripts and automation for deployment, monitoring, administration, and maintenance.
  • Configure and maintain Windows Server and desktop operating systems.
  • Support or co-lead disaster recovery planning, testing, and execution for Azure environments.
  • Manage user access, permissions, authentication, and password management.
  • Support Active Directory Group Policy and Microsoft Azure/Entra policies such as Conditional Access.
  • Monitor cloud environments and help identify performance, capacity, security, and reliability concerns.
  • Participate in cloud implementation or migration projects as your experience grows.

Knowledge Sharing & Continuous Improvement

  • Create, update, and improve internal technical documentation, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and procedures.
  • Document new solutions and lessons learned from unusual or complex technical issues.
  • Participate in daily team discussions related to service delivery, deployments, customer environments, and operational improvements.
  • Prepare and participate in knowledge-transfer and training sessions with other team members.
  • Share discoveries and technical approaches that could benefit other customer environments.
  • Look for processes that can be standardized, simplified, automated, or eliminated.
  • Participate in internal projects that improve Managed Services tools, processes, monitoring, automation, or service delivery.
  • Work collaboratively with Cayenta Support, Technical Services, Business Intelligence, Development, Product, and other teams to investigate and resolve complex issues.

AI & Innovation Mindset

  • Research an unfamiliar technical issue.
  • Analyze logs or error messages.
  • Develop or review scripts.
  • Explore possible root causes.
  • Improve documentation.
  • Summarize technical findings.
  • Automate repetitive administrative work.
  • Identify better ways to monitor or maintain customer environments.

What we are looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, system administration, managed services, infrastructure, database administration, or a related technical role; equivalent education and experience will also be considered.
  • Experience with or strong working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Working knowledge of system administration concepts in Windows and/or Linux environments.
  • Some experience with or knowledge of Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • A demonstrated ability to investigate technical problems independently and work through unfamiliar issues.
  • Curiosity and a desire to understand why something is happening rather than simply applying a workaround.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while knowing when collaboration or escalation is appropriate.
  • Strong customer-service mindset and the ability to develop trusted customer relationships.
  • Comfort balancing multiple customer environments, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Experience with Apache Tomcat, including configuration, hardening, and SSL certificates.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong time-management and organizational skills.
  • Experience using Jira, TeamSupport, or comparable ticketing/work-management systems.
  • Willingness to participate in weekend schedules or alternative workweeks when required, including Tuesday-Saturday or Sunday-Thursday schedules.
  • Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation when required.
  • A commitment to continuous learning, documentation, knowledge sharing, and improvement.
  • Comfort responsibly using AI-assisted tools as part of technical investigation, research, scripting, documentation, and everyday work.

What would make you stand out:

  • Previous experience working in a Managed Services environment.
  • Experience administering both Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle.
  • Microsoft Azure administration or cloud infrastructure experience.
  • Certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft AZ-104, or AZ-305.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies.

  • Experience supporting or delivering Azure implementations or migrations.
  • Experience with identity and access management, including Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Experience explaining technical concepts to non-technical customers or stakeholders.

  • Significant experience with Inland Marine and/or Builders Risk lines of business

This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.

Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As an Inland Marine Territory Manager, you'll be the primary relationship manager within a territory for large, complex or specialty commercial lines of business. We'll count on you to underwrite, market and manage new and renewal commercial lines business, as provided within letters of authority, through direct contact with select agencies or brokers. To succeed, you'll need to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through development, negotiation and execution of business plans. You will lead and influence agencies through creation of sales strategies and implementation of sales processes and practices that drive new sales, increase shelf space, profit and customer retention. You will also collaborate with all lines of business to support and increase the overall NW presence. Under limited direction, you will underwrite accounts based on authority level granted to the role and underwriting appetite.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitors market conditions and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and factors necessary to win the account.

  • Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. Analyzes regional underwriting performance experience, identifies problems on a territory level and proposes action plans to address/resolve those situations.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis. Decisions require review of multiple variables, maximizing agency relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions. Reviews for acceptability and handles those within authority using company underwriting guidelines and standards.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting a significant volume of assigned work, utilizing company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with and through others to meet service level agreements. Effectively influences activities of territory manager underwriting team to facilitate the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, account abilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively finds opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the territory manager underwriting team regarding new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets company’s products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Proactively consults with agents and internal partners to develop business solutions. Shares understanding of organizational capabilities and opportunities to drive maximum value of relationships. Consults regarding the appetite, acceptability, terms, conditions, pricing and sales techniques of large or unique business. Provides industry trend observations to leadership. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options and to improve retention and profitability.

  • Effectively communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates market intelligence to agencies and leadership. Communicates and collaborates actively with team members and leadership to share industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance, and enhance agency relationship. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of advanced customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter authority.

  • Proven ability to manage significant workload effectively and backup other team members as needed. Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Manager or Director. No direct reports.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU or CIC is preferred.

Experience: Seven to ten years of progressively responsible middle market commercial lines underwriting experience preferred. Two to five years of sales and business development experience in middle market commercial lines is also preferred. Expertise in markets consistent with our underwriting appetite and product portfolio preferred.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for small and middle market business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and best practices compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

At Lumen, the company is building the trusted network for the AI-powered world—connecting people, data, and applications through one of the industry’s most expansive fiber networks and connected ecosystems. Every day, Lumen teams help enterprises, governments, and communities unlock what’s possible through secure, high-performance connectivity that powers cloud, edge, and AI innovation.

As a Senior Software Engineer, the successful candidate will collaborate with talented peers in an agile environment to design, develop, test, and deliver impactful software solutions that solve real-world challenges. From enhancing existing platforms to creating new capabilities, this role works across disciplines, translates complex requirements into scalable solutions, and influences outcomes that matter to customers around the globe.

Location

The Talent Acquisition Specialist serves as a strategic partner to hiring managers and HR Business Partners, proactively identifying and delivering talent solutions aligned with workforce needs. This role is responsible for managing the full-cycle recruitment process across assigned business units, with a strong emphasis on innovative sourcing strategies and proactive pipeline development.

The role requires the ability to manage a high volume of requisitions—including complex and hard-to-fill roles—while maintaining an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience.

Strategic Talent Partnership

  • Partner with hiring managers and HR Business Partners to understand current and future hiring needs
  • Anticipate workforce trends and develop proactive recruiting strategies to address talent gaps
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on talent market insights, candidate availability, and hiring best practices

Full-Cycle Recruitment

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for all assigned positions, from intake through offer

Sourcing & Pipeline Development

  • Engage in both tactical and strategic sourcing to build robust talent pipelines
  • Proactively source passive candidates and cultivate relationships for current and future opportunities

Recruitment Strategy & Process Improvement

  • Support workforce planning by participating in forecasting and recruitment planning efforts
  • Develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with business priorities
  • Continuously identify opportunities to enhance recruitment processes and improve outcomes

Project Leadership & Operational Excellence

Experience

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Practice law, not billable hours.

Nationwide is seeking an experienced Senior Trial Attorney to join our team in a fully remote role serving Upstate New York. This position offers the opportunity to handle sophisticated insurance defense litigation while enjoying the flexibility of working from home and the freedom of no billable hour requirements.

The preferred candidate will have 8+ years trial (personal lines and commercial lines) insurance defense litigation (automobile) experience.

Would you thrive in an environment where you can deliver top-quality legal services to support the mission of a Fortune 100 insurance company’ to protect people, businesses and futures with extraordinary care? If you possess the academic credentials, strong analytical skills and legal acumen needed for successful litigation work, our team may be the place for you!

Nationwide Trial Division is a national team with approximately 40 offices through six regions across the United States. Our Senior Trial Attorneys are seasoned litigation attorneys with significant civil litigation experience in property and casualty insurance defense or subrogation. As a Senior Trial Attorney, you’ll represent clients under both commercial and personal lines insurance policies independently as lead counsel, as well as be part of a larger team as needed. Caseloads are typically including a mix of cases varying in complexity, severity, product lines, and specialized concentrations, throughout all courts and agencies in the assigned jurisdiction(s).   • Communicates in a highly effective manner, consistently and proactively identifying, understanding and meeting client, claims and internal NTD communication expectations (both written and verbal), as well as those commonly expected within the jurisdictions and communities in which he/she practices.
  • Serves as a mentor for junior attorneys and NTD staff providing guidance and training, as well as serving as role model in terms of engagement, coaching and feedback, efficiency, attitude and collaboration.

jobs.excerpt: Why Join Omnicell? At Omnicell, we are transforming how healthcare organizations operate by creating innovative solutions that improve business outcomes and customer experiences.
jobs.description:
Why Join Omnicell?

At Omnicell, we are transforming how healthcare organizations operate by creating innovative solutions that improve business outcomes and customer experiences. As a Contract Advisor, you will serve as a critical driver of contract execution excellence, partnering across Commercial, Legal, Finance, Procurement, IT, Customer Success, and customer-facing teams to ensure opportunities move efficiently from intake through execution.
This role offers the opportunity to influence business outcomes, improve contract cycle times, strengthen operational effectiveness, and contribute to a high-performing customer lifecycle organization. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex problems, and excel at coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

What You’ll Do

As a Contract Advisor, you will own and coordinate the end-to-end contract lifecycle for assigned opportunities, ensuring contracts progress efficiently, compliantly, and with clear stakeholder alignment.

Drive Contract Lifecycle Execution

  • Own assigned contracts from intake through execution, serving as the operational lead throughout the contract lifecycle.
  • Coordinate contract-related deliverables, approvals, milestones, and stakeholder activities to ensure timely execution.
  • Monitor contract progress, proactively identify risks, and remove barriers that could delay execution.
  • Maintain accountability for contract momentum, ensuring opportunities continue advancing toward completion.
  • Provide consistent visibility into contract status, key risks, open items, and next steps.

Lead Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Serve as the primary point of coordination between Commercial, Legal, Procurement, Finance, IT, Customer Success, and other business stakeholders.
  • Facilitate meetings, discussions, approvals, and decision-making processes necessary to support contract execution.
  • Coordinate communications with customers and external stakeholders when required.
  • Build collaborative relationships that accelerate issue resolution and improve stakeholder alignment.
  • Influence outcomes and drive progress without direct authority.

Ensure Contract Governance & Compliance

  • Promote adherence to approved contract templates, clause libraries, policies, and governance standards.
  • Route non-standard terms, contractual exceptions, and deviations to appropriate Legal and leadership resources.
  • Ensure all required approvals are obtained, documented, and auditable.
  • Maintain complete and accurate contract records throughout the contracting process.
  • Support audit readiness and compliance with corporate contracting policies and procedures.

Manage Workflow and Operational Risk

  • Monitor contract portfolios for bottlenecks, delays, workflow challenges, and execution risks.
  • Escalate issues proactively to minimize impact on timelines and business objectives.
  • Manage action items and stakeholder follow-through to maintain deal velocity.
  • Support overall contract pipeline health through accurate tracking, reporting, and operational discipline.

Maintain Systems and Data Integrity

  • Manage contract documentation, communications, milestones, and data within Agiloft and other approved business systems.
  • Ensure contract records are complete, current, and consistently maintained.
  • Support reporting needs related to contract execution, cycle times, and operational performance.
  • Champion data integrity, process discipline, and system adoption across contract activities.

Contribute to Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring challenges, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to improve contract lifecycle performance.
  • Recommend and support workflow improvements that reduce cycle times and increase operational effectiveness.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and standard operating procedures.
  • Support adoption of contract management technologies and process optimization initiatives.

Who You Are

Minimum Qualifications

About the Role

This role works closely with the Enterprise Business and Technology Solutions (EBTS) Division to develop, implement, and enhance processes that identify, assess, and remediate vulnerabilities across Horizon’s technology environment. The analyst is responsible for performing internal and external vulnerability assessments, managing vulnerability scanning programs, establishing security standards, and evaluating exceptions and false-positive findings.

The position plays a key role in reducing organizational risk by partnering with technology teams to prioritize and remediate vulnerabilities, developing long-term security solutions, and supporting threat intelligence and threat hunting initiatives. The incumbent will stay current on emerging threats, industry standards, and security trends, providing regular updates and recommendations to leadership regarding risks requiring remediation.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and enhance vulnerability scanning strategies to ensure comprehensive coverage across Horizon’s enterprise environment.

  • Conduct internal and external vulnerability assessments and validate scan results.

  • Apply established vulnerability management standards to classify vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, and business risk.

  • Categorize and prioritize assets according to criticality and organizational impact.

  • Partner with EBTS teams to develop and execute vulnerability remediation plans in accordance with established service level agreements (SLAs).

  • Track and report remediation activities to ensure timely resolution of identified vulnerabilities.

  • Analyze emerging cyber threats and assess potential impacts to Horizon’s technology environment.

  • Communicate current risk exposure, remediation efforts, and security recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.

  • Develop, maintain, and present weekly and monthly vulnerability management metrics and executive reports.

  • Create, update, and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and process documentation related to vulnerability management and threat intelligence operations.

  • Ensure security controls, policies, and standards are operating effectively to satisfy audit and regulatory requirements.

  • Assist in the development and maturation of a threat hunting program by documenting threat scenarios, response playbooks, and use cases.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to investigate, validate, and resolve vulnerability findings, false positives, and remediation exceptions.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening the organization’s overall cybersecurity posture

What You Bring

  • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

  • GCTI (GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence)

  • GIAC certifications

  • CompTIA Security+

  • Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)

Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and methodologies, including Cyber Kill Chain, Defense-in-Depth, and related security models.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of vulnerability management and patch management processes and their respective remediation approaches.

  • Deep understanding of indicators of compromise (IOCs), advanced persistent threats (APTs), cybercrime techniques, and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

  • Knowledge of operating systems including Windows, Linux/Unix, and macOS.

  • Experience with vulnerability management platforms such as Nessus, Qualys, InsightVM (Nexpose), or similar solutions.

  • Knowledge of Center for Internet Security (CIS) benchmarks and Critical Security Controls.

  • Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms and sources such as Recorded Future, ThreatConnect/ThreatStream, H-ISAC, NJCCIC, and similar resources.

  • Understanding of audit, regulatory, and compliance requirements related to cybersecurity programs.

Skills & Abilities:

  • Experience utilizing CVSS scoring and risk-based vulnerability management methodologies.

  • Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience creating executive-level dashboards, scorecards, and presentations using tools such as Microsoft PowerPoint, Visio, and Excel.

  • Experience developing and documenting security processes, standards, and procedures.

  • Ability to facilitate cross-functional collaboration and drive vulnerability remediation efforts across multiple teams.

  • Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to operational excellence.

  • Self-motivated and capable of working independently while maintaining effective communication with stakeholders.
