The Insights and Analytics team is dedicated to enabling improved decision-making at Novartis by leveraging data and advanced analytics capabilities to generate actionable insights that drive business growth. We collaborate closely with the US business, bringing insights and challenging ideas to empower smarter, data-driven decision-making. Reporting into the VP Head, Intelligence & Analytics Capabilities, this role is crucial in advancing the frontiers of personalized healthcare.

The role of the ED Advanced Analytics & Precision Health is at the forefront of utilizing EHR, clinical and diagnostic data to uncover patterns and indicators to improve patient identification, enhance treatment efficacy and advance patient outcomes. By effectively communicating complex analytical findings, the individual will drive the company's mission to deliver innovative, personalized treatment solutions that improve patient health.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the team responsible for analyzing healthcare data, including clinical trial datasets, transactional claims, and electronic health records. Guide the application of established and novel statistical and analytical techniques to support strategic objectives in patient identification, diagnostics utilization, and RWE analytics.
  • Develop and lead strategic partnerships with providers to identify eligible patients in their existing patient pools. Lead the team in leveraging analysis of provider EHR to inform strategic initiatives and improve patient outcomes.
  • Oversee the use of data generated by digital health technologies (DHTs) to capture patient-generated data, electronic patient-reported outcomes (ePROs), and electronic clinical outcome assessments (eCOAs). Guide the team in supporting key strategic goals.
  • Lead the tracking and analysis of metrics on companion diagnostic availability, offering, and usage. Provide the roadmap to enhance diagnostic strategies and improve patient care.
  • Lead initiatives that analyze real-world evidence and clinical & diagnostic data to identify patterns and indicators associated with patient response to treatment regimens. Focus on strategic insights, especially regarding genetic and biomarker indicators.
  • Aligning with NVS stakeholders on research, evidence development, and clinical strategies to drive strategic decision-making, generation of data-driven insights, and the implementation of personalized and precision medicine in healthcare systems.
  • Guide the team in conducting the analysis, drafting and reviewing of the relevant sections of technical and study reports, manuscripts for publishing in high-impact peer-reviewed journals, and abstracts and presentations for international conferences. Ensure alignment with strategic goals and organizational priorities.
  • Communicate complex concepts and interpretations of analysis and findings to diverse audiences, including internal leadership and stakeholders, health economists, clinicians, and health systems. Influence decision-making and strategic planning through effective communication.
  • Communicate high impact relevant insights on underdiagnosed or undertreated patients to the Patient Finding team. Ensure insights are strategically aligned and actionable.

Experience:

Novartis seeks an individual with extensive experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, with a strong understanding of personalized and precision medicine approaches. This individual should have a proven track record in applying epidemiological principles to assess target patient populations and inform treatment strategies. A strong analytical background is essential, with the ability to analyze complex datasets and derive actionable insights.

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, with a deep understanding of personalized and precision medicine
  • A bachelor’s degree in Medicine, Pharmacology, Epidemiology, Data Science, or a related field; an MBA or advanced degree is preferred
  • Minimum 5+ years of domain expertise in these areas are highly desired: Personalized and precision healthcare secondary data analytics, data science, primary market research, field analytics and insights, market access and patient service analytics, or other related strategic analytics and management consulting
  • Minimum 5+ years of people management experience. Proven track record of enabling data-driven decision-making at a senior leadership level, including addressing complex business challenges and shaping organizational strategy particularly in therapeutic areas
  • Proficiency in analyzing healthcare data, including clinical trial datasets and electronic health records, using advanced statistical techniques (e.g., data modelling, time to event analysis)
  • Familiarity with digital health tools / technologies and their application in capturing patient-generated data and outcomes
  • Experience in working with clinical and diagnostic data to identify genetic and biomarker indicators that influence treatment efficacy
  • Ability to draft and review technical reports, manuscripts, and presentations for high-impact scientific publications and conferences
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex insights and strategies effectively to diverse audiences
  • Proven ability to collaborate with healthcare providers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to align strategies and initiatives
  • Strong leadership skills in a team environment which requires negotiation, persuasion, collaboration, and analytical judgment
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing business needs and priorities

jobs.title: Document Control Supervisor
jobs.excerpt: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities.
jobs.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

Position Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Document Control Supervisor to lead document control activities supporting construction, engineering, quality, procurement, subcontractors, suppliers, and project management functions.

This role will oversee document control processes, systems, governance, and personnel for construction programs and projects. The supervisor will ensure that controlled documents and project records are received, processed, reviewed, approved, distributed, retrieved, retained, and protected in accordance with project procedures, the project Quality Management System, contractual requirements, client standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate will build order out of complexity, strengthen document control practices across field and office teams, and serve as a trusted partner to Project Managers, Construction Managers, Engineering, Quality, and Operations leaders. This position will also administer and improve systems such as Procore and SharePoint, provide training and user support, and drive continuous improvement throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Document Control and Records Management

  • Lead project document control activities supporting construction, engineering, quality, procurement, project management, subcontractors, suppliers, and field operations.
  • Develop, maintain, and administer document control processes and procedures for identifying, receiving, processing, reviewing, approving, revising, distributing, filing, preserving, retrieving, and retaining controlled documents and records.
  • Administer controlled documents in accordance with the project Quality Management System, applicable ASME NQA-1 requirements, project procedures, client requirements, and contractual obligations.
  • Control engineering and project documents, including drawings, specifications, procedures, work packages, vendor documents, quality records, change requests, RFIs/RFPs, and construction documentation.
  • Ensure personnel have access to the current, approved revisions of drawings, specifications, procedures, work packages, and other controlled documents.
  • Maintain document registers, revision histories, document status information, distribution records, transmittals, and other required tracking tools.
  • Process new and revised documents through established review and approval workflows.
  • Identify and prevent the unintended use of obsolete, superseded, or unapproved documents.
  • Maintain document traceability and ensure controlled records are complete, legible, accurate, retrievable, secure, and protected from unauthorized access or alteration.
  • Ensure the collection and retention of construction documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Manage the as-built documentation process and support the preparation, compilation, and turnover of final project records and closeout packages.
  • Coordinate the handover of documents and records to Operations during construction and project closeout.

Systems Administration and Governance

  • Administer, configure, and improve document management platforms, including Procore, SharePoint, and related electronic document management systems.
  • Establish and maintain project repositories, file structures, naming conventions, metadata, permissions, workflows, document numbering, revision control, and distribution requirements.
  • Provide oversight of employees, contractors, subcontractors, and other users operating within Procore and other project repositories.
  • Perform quality control reviews of metadata, document content, cross-references, required signatures, revision status, and associated records.
  • Manage user access, permissions, administrative controls, and periodic access audits.
  • Ensure document control systems and records management practices align with client standards, project requirements, governance policies, and applicable legal, contractual, regulatory, and quality obligations.
  • Safeguard confidential and protected information through appropriate storage, handling, distribution, access, and retention practices.
  • Work with IT and project stakeholders to troubleshoot system issues, resolve access or workflow problems, and support system enhancements.

Project and Stakeholder Support

  • Coordinate document control activities with Quality, Engineering, Construction, Procurement, Supply Chain, Contracts, project management, subcontractors, suppliers, and external client representatives.
  • Partner with Project Managers, Construction Managers, and Operations leaders to tailor document control solutions to project needs while maintaining consistent standards.
  • Monitor document workflows and resolve outstanding reviews, approvals, distribution issues, missing information, and other document control discrepancies.
  • Ensure Document Control Coordinators regularly engage with site teams to confirm compliance with client standards, document numbering requirements, turnover requirements, and project procedures.
  • Support audits, surveillances, assessments, inspections, and compliance reviews by retrieving controlled documents, records, and objective evidence.
  • Verify that document control activities and records meet applicable project, quality, contractual, and client requirements.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend practical improvements that enhance accuracy, efficiency, traceability, and user adoption.

Leadership, Training, and Continuous Improvement

  • Provide direction, work coordination, supervision, mentoring, and performance support to Document Control Coordinators and other assigned personnel.
  • Assign work, establish service expectations, monitor performance, and ensure timely and accurate document control support to active projects.
  • Develop and deliver training for Document Controllers, field personnel, project teams, and system users.
  • Prepare clear training materials, user guides, standard operating procedures, and onboarding resources that support quick and consistent adoption.
  • Coach project teams and reinforce disciplined document management practices through regular communication, touchpoints, and feedback.
  • Revise existing processes and procedures when project, client, system, or regulatory requirements change.
  • Capture lessons learned and implement continuous improvements across the document control function.
  • Stay current on emerging document management technologies, automation, and AI-enabled tools that may reduce manual effort and improve quality, accuracy, and accessibility.

Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Typically 10 years of related experience, including 3 in a supervisory or management role in document control, records management, project controls, quality records, project information management, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting industrial construction, engineering, infrastructure, transportation, energy, DOE, nuclear, federal, or other highly regulated projects.
  • Experience administering controlled technical documents and revision processes.
  • Experience with Procore; experience administering or supporting SharePoint is also required or strongly preferred.
  • Experience with electronic document management systems, document repositories, and document workflow processes.
  • Working knowledge of document numbering, revision control, distribution, transmittals, records retention, document status tracking, and access control.
  • Experience supporting engineering drawings, specifications, procedures, work packages, vendor documents, construction records, and/or quality records.
  • Experience with construction documentation such as change requests, RFIs, RFPs, submittals, work packages, and as-built records.
  • Experience developing and maintaining document control processes, procedures, standard operating procedures, training materials, user guides, or governance documentation.
  • Experience leading, supervising, or coordinating Document Control Coordinators, contractors, or other system users.
  • Familiarity with construction closeout documentation, project turnover, audit readiness, records retrieval, retention requirements, and compliance reporting.
  • Excellent computer skills, including advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, and SharePoint.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Acrobat and/or Bluebeam.
  • Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, client service, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, changing requirements, multiple stakeholders, and time-sensitive deadlines.
  • Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • High level of discretion, dependability, professionalism, accountability, and reliability when handling confidential or protected information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Construction Management, Quality, Information Management, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
  • Experience working under an ASME NQA-1, DOE, USACE, or comparable quality program.
  • Previous EPC, nuclear, energy, industrial construction, infrastructure, or large-scale construction experience.
  • Experience supporting federal or highly regulated clients.
  • Experience with USACE RMS or similar client-mandated project management and reporting systems.
  • Membership or certification through ARMA, an Enterprise Content Management organization, or a related professional organization.
  • Experience administering SharePoint sites, libraries, workflows, metadata, permissions, and document templates.
  • Experience supporting project turnover and final records packages.
  • Familiarity with quality audits, surveillances, assessments, and objective evidence retrieval.
  • Experience using workflow automation, reporting tools, or AI-enabled solutions to improve document control performance.

Core Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Process Leadership: Ability to design, standardize, implement, and improve practical document control processes.
  • Quality and Compliance: Strong understanding of controlled documents, quality records, traceability, revision control, and retention requirements.
  • Systems Proficiency: Ability to administer and support Procore, SharePoint, and related document management systems.
  • Attention to Detail: Consistent focus on accuracy, completeness, metadata quality, signatures, cross-references, and document status.
  • Communication: Ability to make complex requirements clear and practical for field personnel, project teams, clients, and senior leaders.
  • Problem Solving: Sound business judgment and the ability to resolve complex issues with appropriate escalation and follow-through.
  • Leadership: Ability to lead, coach, train, and develop a small team while coordinating work across multiple project stakeholders.
  • Adaptability: Ability to respond effectively to changing projects, clients, systems, and regulatory requirements.
  • Accountability: Demonstrated dependability, punctuality, focus, ownership of assigned work, and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Teamwork: Professional attitude and ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.

Key Relationships

  • Reports To: Operations
  • Matrixed Alignment: Director, Quality
  • Supervises: Document Control Coordinators and assigned document control personnel
  • Internal Partners: Project Managers, Construction Managers, Engineering, Quality, Procurement, Supply Chain, Contracts, IT, Operations, and field teams
  • External Partners: Clients, subcontractors, suppliers, vendors, and external auditors or assessors

Success Measures

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

  • Consistent use of approved document control processes across assigned projects.
  • Timely processing, review, approval, distribution, and retrieval of project documents.
  • Accurate document registers, metadata, revision histories, transmittals, and status records.
  • Effective prevention of obsolete or superseded document use.
  • Strong Procore, SharePoint, and repository governance.
  • Audit-ready project records and successful closeout and turnover packages.
  • Effective training, adoption, and support for field and project teams.
  • Timely resolution of workflow, access, quality, and compliance issues.
  • Improved efficiency, traceability, and user experience across the document control function.

Other Duties

This job description is not intended to include every duty, responsibility, or activity required for the role. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.

We promote a culture of excellence and close-knit teams that take pride in delivering, protecting, and sustaining our nation's most critical assets, from Earth to cyberspace. Job Summary

The Licensed Mental Health Therapist provides comprehensive mental health care to patients with emotional, behavioral, or psychological challenges. This role delivers evidence-based individual therapy; conducts psychosocial assessments; develops treatment plans; and collaborates with interdisciplinary clinical teams to ensure high-quality, patient-centered care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform clinical assessments, intake interviews, and mental health evaluations.
  • Develop and implement personalized treatment plans and goals.
  • Provide individual therapy using evidence-based modalities (e.g., CBT, DBT, trauma-informed care).
  • Monitor client progress and adjust interventions as needed.
  • Maintain accurate clinical documentation and treatment records.
  • Collaborate with neurologists, medical staff, and support providers to coordinate care.
  • Ensure compliance with ethical, regulatory, and documentation standards.
  • Participate in case consultation, supervision, and team meetings.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or Doctoral degree in Counseling, Psychology, Social Work, Marriage & Family Therapy, or related field.
  • Active Colorado, Arizona or Nevada professional license (LPC, LCSW, LMFT, or equivalent).
  • Proven experience providing therapy in clinical or medical behavioral health settings.
  • Strong assessment, treatment planning, and clinical documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

Preferred:

  • Experience with neuropsychological or neurological patient populations.
  • Training in trauma-informed, cognitive, or integrative therapies.

Market Compensation

Base Salary Range: $100,000 – $150,000 per year

jobs.description:
Since our founding in 2011, our mission has been to improve the lives of seniors and their caregivers. We are deeply passionate about communication and committed to becoming the foremost provider of services and solutions that enable seniors to lead more meaningful and independent lives. We also understand the power of connection and the profound impact it has on the lives of individuals who are hard-of-hearing. ClearCaptions is a Federal Communications Commission (FCC)-certified telephone captioning provider, adhering to the highest industry standards of privacy, security, and professionalism. We recognize the importance of maintaining the trust and confidence of our customers, and we continually strive to exceed their expectations. For more information about our services please visit clearcaptions.com.

The kind of people we look for:

  • Versatile people who thrive on variety and challenge
  • Excited about working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Innate problem solvers who want to grow in a flexible, collaborative culture.
  • Takes initiative, pushes boundaries, motivated to innovate.
  • Individuals with a growth mindset who want to use their learning and relationship-building skills.
  • Align with our company core values: Integrity, Accountability, Collaboration, Service and Quality.

Summary:

The Business Insights Manager leads cross-functional analytics across Marketing, Sales, and Implementation within our mission-driven organization dedicated to improving lives. This role partners with senior leadership, including the C-suite, to deliver reporting frameworks, forecasts, and deep-dive analyses that inform strategic and operational decisions. The role connects insights across the customer lifecycle, helping the organization understand performance drivers from lead generation through sales conversion, implementation, and customer activation. The Manager leads a team of analysts responsible for translating complex data into clear, actionable insights aligned with organizational priorities. As a strategic thought partner to functional leaders, the Manager guides performance measurement, identifies opportunities for growth and operational efficiency, and strengthens data-driven decision-making across the Operations organization.

What This Role Does:

  • Leads and develops a high-performing analytics team responsible for delivering insights across Marketing, Sales, and Implementation operations.
  • Works collaboratively with internal teams to solve cross-functional business challenges and provide key insights and actionable, data-backed recommendations that drive improvement for both our business and our customers.
  • Assesses broad business questions and distill root causes to develop analytical frameworks for data-driven answers.
  • Partners with senior leadership to define key performance indicators (KPIs), measurement frameworks, and reporting that support strategic planning and operational execution.
  • Analyzes business and financial initiatives to measure their effectiveness and impact on KPIs for both the functional department and the overall business.
  • Provides constructive feedback and coaching to drive continuous improvement, strengthening both technical and business acumen, while aligning individual team member growth with organizational goals.
  • Guides the development and optimization of models and advanced analytics (e.g., regression, time series, segmentation), including ongoing monitoring and variance analysis.
  • Establishes and scales reporting frameworks, dashboards, and data products that deliver actionable visibility into performance and business value, while upholding customer service, integrity, and resource efficiency.
  • Independently determines and pursues deep-dive opportunities to identify performance drivers, growth opportunities, and operational efficiencies across acquisition, conversion, and implementation processes.
  • Maintains a detailed understanding of platforms, data structures, and services to become a reliable source for the organization and contribute to the evolution of analytics capabilities and frameworks.
  • Partners closely with Data Engineering and Reporting teams to communicate and collaborate on complex data needs and projects to support business requirements, automation initiatives, and opportunities.
  • Guides the design and interpretation of experiments, pilots, and new initiatives to measure impact and support data-driven decision making.
  • Fosters a culture of data literacy and self-service analytics by improving accessibility, clarity, and adoption of reporting tools and insights.
  • Takes an active approach to talent management by onboarding, mentoring, and inspiring a diverse, highly engaged, and skilled team. Continuously strengthens team capability through talent development, succession planning, and recruitment.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Business, Economics, Statistics, Analytics) or equivalent experience; Masters preferred. Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • A minimum of eight (8) years of increasing responsibility in data analytics, business intelligence, or operations analytics, with demonstrated expertise in cross-functional business and financial data.
  • A minimum of two (2) years of experience leading or mentoring analysts or analytics teams, including accountability for performance, development, and delivery of results aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Proficiency in data analysis and related technologies, including SQL, DAX, Python and/or R, advanced Excel, and experience working with large, complex datasets, Salesforce data, operational platforms, Git repositories, and Fabric and/or Azure environments.
  • Strong data visualization and communication skills using Power BI and/or Tableau, with demonstrated ability to translate insights into compelling data storytelling and presentations for organizational leadership.
  • Excellent analytical skills and understanding of statistical concepts with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Experience with evaluation of statistical significance, variance analysis, funnel and/or lifecycle analysis, A/B testing and performance optimization.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with business unit leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to influence decision-making through data as well as to communicate technical findings for executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter with strong leadership, organizational, communication, and time management skills, self-directed and able to handle multiple priorities with demanding timeframes.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and team members to create a high-quality, results-driven, team environment built on trust and respect.
  • Ability to plan and manage at both strategic and tactical operational levels, while achieving goals, overcoming obstacles, and planning for contingencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to use discretion, make sound decisions, and maintain confidentiality.
  • Willingness and ability to work flexible hours as needed, and travel up to 10%, which may include occasional overnight travel.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and modern communication tools for virtual teams (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Slack).

Physical Demands:

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws, the Company will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with documented disabilities to enable them to perform the essential functions of the job, unless such accommodations would impose an undue hardship. Employees seeking accommodation should contact the People Department to initiate the interactive process.

Employees may experience the following physical demands for extended periods of time:

  • Sitting, standing, and walking (90-100%)
  • Keyboarding (95-100%)
  • Viewing computer monitor, tablet, and cell phone requiring close vision (70-90%)

Work Environment:

100% Remote with Travel: Work environment is primarily indoors (home office, customer or vendor sites, or other business meeting venues); travel may involve exposure to varying weather and temperature conditions, as well as driving and traffic hazards. Travel is required, approximately 10%, and may include overnight and out-of-state trips.

Compensation:

$130,000 to $145,000/yr plus 10% bonus determined by competitive market analysis and internal equity considerations. Final compensation will be based on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and business needs. For details on our comprehensive benefits program, visit www.clearcaptions.com/careers to explore our total rewards package.

jobs.excerpt: Why MSI?  We thrive on solving challenges.  As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs.
jobs.description:
Why MSI? We thrive on solving challenges. As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs. We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners.


Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle. Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better.


The Problem

Platform Architecture is our most overloaded cross-cutting team. Priorities are pushed down onto them from every direction. They're also the final gate in the PR approval chain (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture) — not the only reviewers, but the ones who carry the heaviest review load and have the most influence over how that process is designed — which makes them a bottleneck with limited ability to control their own inbound work.


Infrastructure has a related but distinct problem. They just stood up a formal SDLC and are early in adopting ADO, and teams with dependencies on them often reach out at the last minute rather than planning ahead — disrupting their flow of work the same way competing top-down asks disrupt Platform Architecture's. They also need to get better at communicating outward: proactively flagging when scrum and product teams need to test architectural changes or enhancements, rather than that falling through the cracks after the fact.


Both teams need their capacity protected from poorly-timed, uncoordinated demands, and both need a partner who can build the two-way communication habits — inbound planning lead time and outbound impact visibility — that neither currently has.


We also want dedicated Agile coaching capacity across the broader team eventually — someone who can dig into how each team runs planning, standups, and retros, and help our strategic Agile plan translate into practice, not just theory. That's not this role's starting focus: given the depth of what's already being asked for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, we don't want to set this person up to juggle too much on day one. We see broader coaching as a natural growth path for this role once the Platform Architecture and Infrastructure work is stable, and only if/when they have the capacity for it.


The Role

Reports to the Head of Agile or Head of AI Enabled Delivery with a dotted line to the other. Serves as the embedded Scrum Master for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, and acts as mentor/lead to the other Scrum Masters across the organization to drive consistent execution of our Agile strategy. No direct reports.


Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities (Day One)

  • Prioritization gatekeeping: Push back on stakeholders, convene cross-team prioritization sessions, and protect Platform Architecture and Infrastructure capacity from competing top-down asks, maintaining clear cross-portfolio dependency maps so trade-offs are visible to stakeholders.
  • Cross-team visibility & coaching: Coach Platform Architecture and Infrastructure to proactively communicate their work, roadmap, and potential downstream impact to dependent scrum and product teams; facilitate a recurring cross-team forum until this becomes routine practice, and use it to support prioritization decisions.
  • Capacity protection for bottleneck relief: Influence and partner with Platform Architecture leadership to reduce the volume of competing top-down asks landing directly on their team, freeing their capacity to redesign the release-approval process they anchor (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture). This role does not own that approval process itself — it protects the time Platform Architecture needs to fix it.
  • Ceremony-level coaching: Run and coach ceremonies for both teams, tailoring facilitation and training to each team's specific needs and maturity rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.
  • Strategic accountability: Report directly to the Heads of Agile on team health, blockers, and adherence to the strategic plan.
  • Compliance & documentation: Ensure delivery routines for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure align with applicable security, risk, and governance requirements across Baldwin partner organizations; support accurate delivery documentation and audit/accreditation readiness where required.

Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows)

  • SM mentorship: Provide informal lead guidance to the Scrum Masters on other teams, ensuring our strategic Agile plan is executed consistently across the org.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as an embedded Scrum Master or Agile Coach supporting highly technical, cross-cutting engineering or infrastructure teams.
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder-alignment skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and drive alignment across business units and portfolios.
  • Working knowledge of Azure DevOps (ADO); familiarity with DevSecOps, multi-cloud, or CI/CD delivery environments a plus.
  • Experience with cross-portfolio dependency mapping, OKRs, and delivery/quality metrics reporting.
  • Agile certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM/Advanced SM, or equivalent) preferred.

Success Metrics (6–12 Months)

  • Platform Architecture reports measurably more protected capacity (e.g., reduced ad hoc/competing asks), enabling them to own redesign of their release-approval process.
  • Recurring cross-stakeholder prioritization cadence established and adopted.
  • Recurring roadmap/impact forum between Platform Architecture, Infrastructure, and dependent teams established and running independently of this role.
  • Visible execution of the Heads of Agile's strategic plan across team ceremonies.

Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows)

  • Tailored coaching plans rolled out for Scrum Masters.
  • Informal coaching practices shared with Scrum Masters on other teams, if bandwidth allows once core scope is stable.

jobs.description:
At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work.

We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco.

Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.

Why Verda

  • Cash and equity compensation along with various fringe benefits.

  • Profitable operations with rapid, sustained growth.

  • 30+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.

  • A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.

Practicalities

  • Work mode: Remote (EU)

  • Level: Mid / Senior

  • Employment type: Full time and permanent

About the role

GPUs only deliver value once they're wired into a cluster that researchers can actually train on. As our HPC Engineer, you'll own the baremetal and virtualized clusters behind our AI cloud - from the InfiniBand fabric and shared filesystems up through the workload orchestration layer. You'll be the person who keeps large-scale GPU clusters healthy, performant, and ready for the next workload.

Your responsibilities

  • Administer baremetal GPU/HPC clusters end to end, from provisioning through day-two operations

  • Administer virtualized clusters, including the hypervisor and GPU virtualization stack underneath them

  • Design, deploy, and tune InfiniBand fabrics, including topology planning, subnet management, and performance validation

  • Deploy and operate shared/parallel filesystems supporting training and inference workloads, balancing performance, capacity, and reliability

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the full fabric stack: fibers, transceivers, NICs, switches, drivers, and firmware

  • Partner with remote-hands and data center teams to diagnose hardware faults and execute physical-layer fixes and cluster expansions

  • Operate and tune Slurm (or equivalent) workload scheduling deployments used by customers and internal teams

  • Keep issue tracking, IPAM, and DCIM records accurate as clusters are built, changed, and decommissioned

  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for cluster-level issues

  • Collaborate with platform, network, and storage teams to integrate new clusters into the broader AI cloud

Your key competencies

  • Solid Linux skills, with specialization in memory management, PCIE topologies and virtualization being a bonus

  • Deep Infiniband knowledge, including fabric design, subnet management, and performance tuning

  • Solid experience with IB clustering, troubleshooting/debugging, understanding the ecosystem of fibers+transceivers+NICs+switches and all the things that could possibly fail in them

  • Experience about shared filesystems (e.g. Lustre, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, WekaFS, or similar)

  • Ability to work with remote hands teams to diagnose and resolve hardware issues remotely

  • Knowledge about NCCL, CUDA, DOCA and the Nvidia stack

  • Knowledge about Slurm and/or other workload scheduling solutions, bonus points for Slinky/slurm-bridge

  • Understanding the importance of keeping issue tracking/IPAM/DCIM up to date

  • Comfort operating production clusters where uptime and performance directly affect customer workloads

  • Scripting/automation ability (e.g. Python, Bash, Ansible) for repeatable cluster operations

Nice to have

  • RoCEv2 knowledge (and/or Spectrum-X)

  • Understanding of agentic guardrails, especially when applied to administration of complex systems

  • Ability to think beyond what is needed right now vs. some given trajectory or roadmap

  • Experience with GPU health-checking and diagnostics tooling (e.g. DCGM, field diagnostics)

  • Experience with baremetal provisioning/orchestration tooling (e.g. MAAS, Foreman, custom PXE/iPXE pipelines)

  • Familiarity with GPU-aware virtualization or containerization (Kubernetes device plugins, KVM/QEMU with GPU passthrough, SR-IOV)

  • Exposure to observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki) for cluster-level monitoring

What's next

We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now.

Please submit your application through our Careers page. We don't accept applications sent by email.

Job Description

A bit about this role:

On the Provider Operations team, we are responsible for credentialing the providers and facilities contracting with our health plan. We built our credentialing program from the ground up, and it credentials providers compliantly in industry-leading timeframes. That lets us build new networks quickly, show operational excellence to our providers, and keeps provider data current and accurate.

In our stage of growth, we are focused on implementing AI initiatives and expanding the responsibilities of our offshore team to make our operations faster, more efficient, and ready to scale. We’re looking for a Manager of Provider Operations who is a hands-on operator. You’ll be just as comfortable digging into work queues and untangling a messy case as you are redesigning a workflow or rethinking how a process could run with AI. Priorities will shift, and you’ll shift with them.

This is an ideal role for a results-driven leader who is mission driven, process oriented, data obsessed, and energized by change.


Your responsibilities and impact will include:

  • Supporting day-to-day credentialing operations, including working queues yourself, unblocking complex cases, and driving best-in-class turnaround times and quality.

  • Helping manage and develop our offshore team, including training, documentation, and quality and productivity monitoring, with the goal of owning the offshore relationship over time.
  • Partnering on offshore transitions by identifying work that can move offshore and supporting smooth handoffs without disrupting turnaround times or compliance.
  • Assessing operational pain points and using data to size opportunities and build the business case for new solutions using data insights, including quantifying the impact of AI solutions, tech improvements, and offshore transitions before and after they launch.
  • Creating and implementing AI solutions that make operations more efficient and enable scale, partnering with product and engineering where needed and testing, measuring, and refining what you build.

  • Becoming an expert in our internal systems and tools so you can troubleshoot issues and propose clear improvements to system logic.
  • Owning key operational metrics, building reporting that surfaces trends and bottlenecks, and using data to guide decisions.
  • Ensuring credentialing operations remain compliant with CMS, AAAHC, and state requirements as processes and tools evolve.
  • Partnering cross-functionally with internal leadership, network and contracting teams, providers, vendors, and offshore partners.

Required skills and experience:

  • 3-5+ years in operations, process improvement, or consulting.
  • A true operator with a bias toward action. You’re willing to roll up your sleeves and do the work, not just direct it.
  • A clear head for process. You’re passionate about efficiency and can predict and prevent bottlenecks before they happen.
  • Comfort moving quickly between big-picture strategy and detailed, in-the-weeds execution.
  • Ability to shift focus and reprioritize quickly in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • You run toward complexity and have the stamina for hard problems.
  • Detail-oriented, with a high bar for quality and accuracy.
  • Ability and desire to understand and follow complex regulations.
  • Strong communicator who can work with cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment.
  • Data, systems, and tech savvy, with the ability to build reporting that improves decision-making.

Desired skills and experience:

Pebble is Bedrock Facility Solutions’ in-house platform for managing facility work across multiple locations. It brings work orders, assets, preventative maintenance, service-provider coordination, approvals, documentation, invoice records, and reporting into one place.

We are looking for a full-stack developer to work on the existing production application. You will take features and problems from the initial conversation through development, testing, and release.

Facility software has a lot of connected parts. A single work order may involve a location, asset, service provider, quote, approval, SLA, invoice record, and service history. This role is responsible for making those connections reliable and easy for people to use.

What you’ll do

  • Build and improve features across the frontend, backend, and database
  • Work directly with Bedrock’s operations team to understand how facility work moves from request to completion
  • Improve the work-order lifecycle, including intake, assignment, approvals, status tracking, documentation, and closeout
  • Build stronger asset and equipment records, warranty history, preventative maintenance schedules, and service history
  • Improve service-provider assignment, trade coverage, compliance records, and dispatch workflows
  • Strengthen user roles, permissions, account access, and audit history
  • Improve dashboards, global search, saved views, reporting, imports, and exports
  • Investigate production issues, identify the root cause, and release durable fixes
  • Create safe database migrations and data corrections without damaging customer records
  • Write automated tests and complete release checks before changes reach production
  • Monitor application errors, performance, and data consistency
  • Document technical decisions and important workflows
  • Help prepare Pebble for future integrations, APIs, enterprise account structures, and single sign-on

What we’re looking for

  • At least three years of experience building and maintaining production web applications
  • Experience working across user interfaces, backend logic, APIs, and relational databases
  • Strong knowledge of a modern frontend framework such as React, Next.js, Vue, or a comparable framework
  • Experience with server-side application development and API design
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational data
  • Experience building authentication, permissions, and role-based access
  • Experience using Git, testing tools, deployment workflows, and production monitoring
  • The ability to debug issues that involve multiple parts of an application
  • Good judgment when working with customer data and production systems
  • The ability to explain technical decisions to people who do not work in software
  • The ability to manage work independently and follow through without constant supervision

A college degree is not required. We care more about what you have built, how you solve problems, and whether you can take responsibility for production work.

Helpful experience

• Multi-tenant SaaS applications

  • CMMS, work-order, field-service, property-management, or facility-management software
  • Asset and preventative-maintenance systems
  • Data imports, exports, dashboards, and reporting
  • Accounting, SSO, or third-party API integrations
  • Cloud deployment platforms such as Vercel or comparable services

This is a full-time remote position open to applicants located in Florida.

Bedrock Facility Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.excerpt: Here at Savista, we enable our clients to navigate the biggest challenges in healthcare: quality clinical care with positive patient experiences and optimal financial results.
jobs.description:
Here at Savista, we enable our clients to navigate the biggest challenges in healthcare: quality clinical care with positive patient experiences and optimal financial results. We partner with healthcare organizations to problem solve and deliver revenue cycle improvement services that enable their success, support their patients, and nurture their communities, all while living our values of Commitment, Authenticity, Respect and Excellence (CARE).

This position is responsible for reviewing claims and payment information and underpayment identification systems to identify potential individual underpayments and underpayment trends. Identified potential underpayments and trends will be analyzed and screened to remove false positives, enabling other team members to accurately and efficiently pursue lost revenue on behalf of Underpayment Recovery clients. The auditor must ensure that all underpayment trends are identified so as to use best practices and processes to resolve.

Underpayment Auditor I

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Makes use of high-volume reports to review historical payment information and determine the accuracy of reimbursements
  • Reviews hospitals managed care contracts to determine appropriate application of rates, provisions and terms
  • Identifies potential underpayment trends through comparison of managed care contracts to actual reimbursement information via contract management technology
  • Applies analytical techniques during report review to remove inaccurate information and potential false positive returns
  • Investigates third party payor policies and contracts to verify accuracy of underpayment variances according to published payor guidelines
  • Interfaces with Contract Specialist team to refine contract models if discrepancies are identified
  • Makes efforts and utilizes available resources to verify patient benefits and eligibility to screen out denials, plan type and other demographic information that may negatively impact the accuracy of identified potential underpayment trends
  • Reports underpayments and underpayment trends to management and audit team for pursuit and collection
  • When necessary, updates reason for pursuit and pursued amounts to accurately reflect current information
  • Communicates well both verbally and in writing, has good listening skills, builds strong relationships, is flexible/open-minded, negotiates effectively, solicits performance feedback and handles constructive criticism.
  • Meets established individual and team goals for volume and value of underpayments identified
  • Supports Savista’s Compliance Program by adhering to policies and procedures pertaining to HIPAA, FDCPA, FCRA, and other laws applicable to Savista’s business practices. This includes: becoming familiar with Savista’s Code of Ethics, attending training as required, notifying management or Savista’s Helpline when there is a compliance concern or incident, HIPAA-compliant handling of patient information, and demonstrable awareness of confidentiality obligations.

Minimum Requirements & Competencies:

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • 1-2 years of experience working with managed care reimbursement and contracts.
  • Familiar with ICD-9 and ICD-10, CPT Coding, revenue codes, UB and 1500 billing formats
  • Self-motivated and independent
  • Strong analytical acumen.
  • Proficiency with MS Office
  • Strong leadership skills.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.

Savista is required by state-specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The annual range for this role is $43,870-$50,000 annually. However, specific compensation for the role will vary within the above range based on many factors including but not limited to geographic location, candidate experience, applicable certifications, and skills.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an Operations Research Engineer to join the Workforce Management (WFM) product stream and help build the optimization capabilities behind workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and resource allocation for a large-scale contact center environment.
The role focuses on applying operations research, mathematical optimization, and algorithm design to solve complex workforce planning problems at enterprise scale. You will work closely with Product, Workforce Management experts, Architects, and Engineering teams to transform business requirements into optimization models and production-grade optimization services that support scheduling, staffing, coverage management, and operational efficiency.
This role is ideal for an engineer with strong expertise in optimization, constraint programming, mathematics, and software engineering who enjoys solving real-world planning and resource allocation challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop optimization models for contact center workforce planning, scheduling and resource allocation.
  • Design and implement the schedule optimization engine using OR-Tools/CP-SAT.
  • Own the constraint model end to end: formalize business rule into a solvable, maintainable model.
    Build the production-grade solver as a service within the WFM platform that meets latency targets for real forecast group volumes.
  • Define and validate schedule quality metrics (coverage attainment, constraint violations, solve time, solution stability across re-solves) and instrument the service so quality can be monitored in production.
  • Build and execute tests and validation of optimization algorithms to deliver performance, scalability, and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to integrate optimization models into an enterprise-grade optimization engine of the workforce management platform.
  • Partner with workforce-planning and real-time-analyst stakeholders to validate that generated schedules are operationally usable.
  • Effectively communicate and present findings, methodologies, and results to engineering and business stakeholders.
  • 6+ years of professional experience designing and implementing optimization solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on production experience with OR-Tools (CP-SAT), or a comparable constraint-programming / mixed-integer-programming solver.
  • Strong foundation in linear programming, integer programming, or stochastic optimization.
  • Direct experience modeling and solving workforce or resource scheduling problems.
  • Experience working with large datasets and solving large scale optimization problems.
    Proficiency in Java, Python, or C++.
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into mathematical models and optimization objectives.
  • Strong software engineering skills with the ability to build production-ready services and validation frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of WFM domain.
  • Experience building optimization solutions for workforce planning, scheduling, logistics, transportation, or resource allocation.
  • Knowledge of forecasting and decision-support systems.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development or AI-enabled solutions, including tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot.

We offer:

  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. About The Team

At Bermex, we put value on our customer relationships. We’re always looking for ways to delight our customers by going the extra mile. We are always looking for motivated individuals who enjoy working independently and leading teams in dynamic environments.


About the Role

The Regional Operations Director East reports to the Vice President of Meter Services and serves as a key operational leader responsible for overseeing multiple operating units, projects, or geographic territories. This role provides strategic and tactical direction to Operations Managers and Supervisors to drive operational excellence, financial performance, customer satisfaction, and employee development.

This position bridges frontline operational management and senior leadership, ensuring company initiatives, safety standards, and financial objectives are effectively executed across assigned regions or projects. The Regional Operations Director must demonstrate strong leadership, business acumen, organizational discipline, and the ability to influence performance across multiple teams.

jobs.description:
Overview:

The Director Corporate Finance & Assistant Treasurer will report to the VP, Corporate Finance and Treasury. The candidate will have substantial interaction with the CEO and CFO along with other leaders in the organization. This role will lead investor relations activities, support the organization’s treasury functions, and support the enterprise/corporate financial planning and analysis activities. The candidate will lead a team of two individuals and can work remotely; however, less travel will be required if the candidate lives in Chicago, IL or Tacoma, WA.

Location: Remote

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Financial Analysis & Modeling
    • Support shared service functional leaders in the creation of business plans that connect to the strategic plan, assumptions and building blocks. Includes the development of KEI’s and KPI’s that will be tracked to measure initiative success.
    • Apply financial modeling expertise to support the organization’s efforts to drive performance and improve cash flow. The candidate will own the enterprise level financial models.
    • Exhibit the ability to manage a fully integrated financial model (income statement, balance sheet and statement of cash flows) for TBI at the enterprise and business levels.
    • Support capital planning by performing ad hoc and periodic scenario analyses.
    • Partner with finance leaders to manage liquidity to improve working capital and manage risk.
    • Support the development and implementation of the company’s financial planning and analysis activities.
    • Provide thought leadership and related reporting of the “numbers behind the numbers,” providing insightful and actionable perspective on underlying trends and metrics.
    • Work on corporate projects and initiatives that impact the entire organization.
    • Independently perform ad-hoc analysis for CEO/CFO and provide executive level summary of findings along with recommendations.
    • Provide thought leadership and develop materials to be used in Board of Director meetings as well as executive board memos (CFO/CEO memos).
  • Investor Relations
    • Partner with CFO/SVP/VP to lead Investor Relations function, including the preparation of earnings and investor materials, timing of key events, understanding and conveying internal and external factors influencing TBI’s stock price.
    • Lead quarterly/annual earnings process including providing guidance recommendations, creating external documents (press releases, earnings presentations, roadshow materials), writing CEO/CFO transcripts and managing earnings call logistics.
    • Communicate with investors (prospective and current) and shareholders in conjunction with the CFO.
    • Ensure the accuracy and validity of all information that is disseminated to investors and that only information already in the public domain is conveyed.
    • Oversee the arrangement and implementation of investor meetings / non-deal roadshows / investor conferences and events for TrueBlue.
    • Work closely with the Communications team to ensure the company website and investor relations page is up to date.
  • Treasury Management:
    • Manage the company’s liquidity position, including cash flow forecasting, working capital management, and short-term/long-term borrowing.
    • Ensure adequate liquidity to meet the company’s operational needs.
    • Develop and execute strategies for managing the company’s debt and investment portfolios.
    • Ensure compliance with financial covenants and optimize financing arrangements.
    • Maintain relationships with banks, rating agencies, and other financial institutions.
    • Assist in managing the company’s investment portfolio, including evaluating investment opportunities and risks.
    • Partner closely with VP of Risk on capital needs and treasury activities related to the self-insured Workers Comp and Captive Program Management
    • Monitor the performance of investments and report on returns.
    • Assist in developing and maintaining treasury policies and procedures.
    • Ensure compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
    • Implement best practices in treasury management.
  • Technology
    • Collaborate within a team of administrators to co-manage the end-to-end administration, security, and maintenance of the Oracle EPBCS platform, sharing responsibilities for updates, business rule optimization, data integration monitoring, and support continuous financial planning cycles
    • Partner with technology team to evolve our forecasting, budgeting, and planning applications by improving our customer’s accessibility to financial information.
    • Promote and pilot new tools, such as predictive analytics, RPA, and machine learning, to bring more efficiency and insights into the financial decision-making process.
    • Demonstrate advanced skills with Oracle reporting and forecast tools to identify opportunities across brands that will drive process efficiencies to reduce forecasting effort. Develop sufficient back up capabilities and knowledge on the corporate FP&A team to effectively administer Oracle EPBCS.
    • Manage and maintain treasury management systems and software.
  • Leadership Development & Culture
    • Quickly develop strong working relationships with key personnel in the various business units around the company.
    • Experience in managing cross-functional teams and working collaboratively with other senior executives.
    • Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and lead a high-performing treasury team.
    • Attract, retain, and develop the team by providing career development, feedback and sharing employee engagement results that will be turned into action plans.
    • Lead technology, culture, and people development initiatives for the FP&A organization.

CORE KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • High-level of knowledge and insight on current business and economic trends with an ability to link these trends to the business model to improve decision making and create value.
  • Deep understanding of RPO and staffing business model and drivers. Demonstrate an operational orientation, with a keen ability to independently drive results and improvements across the business through partnership with the Executive Leadership Team.
  • Strong skills in strategy development, corporate finance, forecasting, and financial analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience in leveraging technology to arrive at creative, value enhancing solutions.
  • Experience in multi-location, distributed environments with global operations and a sizeable blue- collar workforce.
  • Advanced enterprise (P&L, cash flow, and balance sheet) and business investment modelling capabilities

Business Acumen and Operational Aptitude

  • Strong customer-oriented solution and advocacy mindset.
  • Astute understanding of technology, and a willingness and ability to leverage data and analytics to derive creative, thoughtful solutions at an enterprise level.
  • Ample knowledge of an international operating environment and the suite of functional areas within the TrueBlue organization. Expert knowledge of financial planning and analysis activities.

Executing for Results

  • A personal bias towards action and results.
  • The ability to align the resources of the financial planning function to support business objectives and partner with business leaders on tactical and strategic initiatives.
  • Capable of making decisions with consideration of financial priorities and internal and external conditions.

Leading Teams

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire and lead a high-performing treasury team.
  • Ability to identify and analyze organizational needs with solid problem-solving abilities.
  • Experienced at providing mentorship in establishing vision and goals with a track record of developing high-caliber professionals. Works across the entire finance organization to develop talent providing meaningful development experiences for employees and advancing the collective caliber of human capital within the finance organization.

What you bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, business, accounting or a related area. An MBA and/or CPA is highly preferred.
  • 10+ years of operational and financial experience in a combination of customer-facing professional services and a corporate environment, with a preference for B2B.
  • Experience working with executive leadership teams with an impressive track record of results from his or her personal leadership involvement.
  • High level of commitment to quality work product and organizational ethics, integrity and compliance.
  • Superior attention to detail and ability to successfully manage multiple competing priorities while maintaining a view of the big picture.
  • Experience working with senior leadership and executive management combined with commensurately advanced communication, presentation, and relationship skills.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Employee is frequently required to stand, sit, talk, and/or hear for long periods of time. Requires up to 25% travel.

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 6 paid holidays, 1 paid floating holiday and up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per year, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Company-matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Purchase Program, in addition to other programs and perks. About the role

The Senior Salesforce Developer role is focused on designing, developing, and delivering scalable, secure Salesforce solutions that support the evolving needs of Public Sector organizations.

As part of FormativGroup's Salesforce Practice, you'll contribute to enterprise implementations across Salesforce Government Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud, helping public sector clients modernize processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the services they provide.

You'll bring deep technical expertise across Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, integrations, and Salesforce configuration while collaborating with architects, business analysts, delivery teams, and client stakeholders. This role combines hands-on development with technical solutioning, client engagement, and Agile delivery within complex, regulated environments.

We're anticipating future openings and are connecting now with great talent who'd like to be considered when the time comes.

What You'll Work On

As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you will:

  • Design, develop, enhance, and deploy scalable Salesforce solutions across Government Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and related Salesforce technologies.

  • Develop and maintain Apex classes, triggers, batch and scheduled jobs, Queueable Apex, and asynchronous processing solutions.

  • Build and optimize Lightning Web Components (LWCs) using JavaScript, Apex, and Salesforce platform services to create responsive, user-friendly applications.

  • Configure and enhance Salesforce functionality using Flows, validation rules, approval processes, dynamic forms, record types, page layouts, and custom metadata.

  • Apply both programmatic and declarative development approaches to deliver efficient, maintainable solutions.

  • Design, develop, and maintain integrations between Salesforce and external enterprise systems using REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, and web services.

  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and deployment validation activities while maintaining Salesforce coding standards and appropriate test coverage.

  • Configure and maintain Salesforce security controls, including Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Sharing Rules, and Organization-Wide Defaults.

  • Support data migration, transformation, cleansing, and bulk data management using Data Loader, Workbench, and related integration tools.

  • Maintain technical documentation, development estimates, solution specifications, and project delivery records.

  • Ensure development practices align with Salesforce standards for security, scalability, performance, governance, and compliance within government and regulated environments.

What You'll Bring

You will likely be successful in this role if you have:

  • Active and valid Salesforce certifications, with Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I required.

  • 5–8+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience supporting enterprise applications and complex implementations.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering Salesforce solutions for Public Sector clients, including Government Cloud implementations.

  • Experience participating in Agile/Scrum delivery environments and collaborating across technical and functional teams.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage confidently with client stakeholders, technical teams, and business users.

  • Ability to combine hands-on technical execution with thoughtful solution design and consultative problem-solving.

How You Work

The ideal candidate will:

  • Take ownership of development activities, bringing a proactive and solutions-focused approach from requirements through implementation.

  • Navigate complex technical challenges with sound judgment, creativity, and a strong understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities.

  • Collaborate effectively across distributed delivery teams, client stakeholders, and technical disciplines while maintaining clear communication and accountability.

  • Balance development speed with quality, security, maintainability, and long-term platform performance.

  • Adapt comfortably to evolving requirements, competing priorities, and the delivery expectations of government and regulated client environments.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II or additional Salesforce Developer, Consultant, or Architect certifications.

  • Cannabis industry experience, particularly within regulated programs or government environments, is highly preferred.

  • Experience delivering Salesforce solutions within a consulting firm, systems integrator, or professional services organization.

What Success Looks Like

Application Window:

Job Description:

Senior Cyber Investigator


TaskUs partners with pioneering technology companies to build the safety, intelligence, and human-in-the-loop operations powering next-generation artificial intelligence.


In this role, you will join a specialized cyber investigations pod supporting one of the world’s foremost frontier AI research and safety companies. Their Safeguards mission is clear: prevent state-of-the-art AI systems from being leveraged by malicious actors to cause harm. While automated detection systems catch abuse at scale, seasoned human investigators provide the crucial analytical ground truth.


As a Senior Cyber Investigator, you will take ownership of complex, high-consequence misuse escalations and threat actor profiling. You will evaluate sophisticated cyber abuse, distinguish malicious intent from benign dual-use security research, mentor Junior Investigators, and deliver high-fidelity labels that train automated safety classifiers.


What you will do:

  • Tackle High-Severity Escalations: Investigate complex abuse cases and appeals escalated by automated detection systems and Junior Investigators across priority threat areas:
    • Ransomware and malware authoring / obfuscation
    • Local and remote exploit discovery and weaponization
    • Large-scale data scraping and automated exfiltration
    • Offensive operations, recon, and intrusion staging
  • Threat Actor & Campaign Analysis: Pivot across accounts, telemetry, and external threat intelligence to uncover coordinated adversarial campaigns and profile actor tradecraft (TTPs).
  • Evaluate Dual-Use Scenarios: Make sound, defensible determinations separating legitimate defensive security tasks (e.g., authorized auditing, academic research) from active malicious intent.
  • Review & Mentor: Review Junior Investigators’ casework, provide actionable feedback, and lead calibration sessions to maintain rigorous labeling standards across the pod.
  • Data-Driven Threat Hunting: Use SQL, Python, or investigative tooling to analyze usage telemetry, identify anomalous behavior, and surface emerging abuse trends across large datasets.
  • Reporting & Escalations: Author concise intelligence briefs and enforcement recommendations for the Principal Investigator and client safety leads; elevate critical threats and zero-day discoveries promptly.

What you bring:

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).
  • Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.

  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked.
  • Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution.
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.
  • Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
