  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.

Growth Marketing Specialist

About Bedrock Facility Solutions

Bedrock Facility Solutions helps companies with multiple locations manage repairs, maintenance, assets, service providers, and facility operations.

Our Pebble platform gives facility teams one place to manage work orders, communication, estimates, invoices, response times, assets, and location history.

About the Role

Bedrock needs someone who can turn what we know about facility operations into marketing that gets the right companies interested.

This is not a role built around posting content just to stay active. The work should help owners, operations leaders, and facility teams understand the problems Bedrock solves and give our sales team more qualified conversations.

You will create and manage campaigns across content, email, search, social media, landing pages, and other channels. You will also track what brings in the right audience, what turns into meetings, and what needs to change.

What You Will Do

  • Build growth campaigns for Bedrock Facility Solutions and Pebble.
  • Create marketing that speaks directly to companies operating multiple locations.
  • Research the needs of owners, executives, operations leaders, facility managers, and finance teams.
  • Write and improve website pages, landing pages, emails, articles, case studies, guides, and sales materials.
  • Manage Bedrock’s organic LinkedIn content and help company leaders develop useful industry content.
  • Improve Bedrock’s search visibility through practical SEO research and content.
  • Create email campaigns and lead nurturing workflows using HubSpot, Brevo, or similar platforms.
  • Build landing pages and calls to action that turn website visitors into conversations.
  • Plan and manage paid search or paid social campaigns when they support a clear business goal.
  • Work with Sales to understand which messages are starting conversations and which are being ignored.
  • Work with Operations and Customer Success to turn real facility problems and client results into useful marketing.
  • Support product marketing for Pebble, including feature announcements, demonstrations, use cases, and launch materials.
  • Maintain accurate campaign, source, and lead information in HubSpot.
  • Track website conversions, qualified leads, booked meetings, campaign performance, and pipeline influenced by marketing.
  • Test different messages, audiences, pages, and offers instead of relying on assumptions.
  • Review competing facility management and CMMS companies to understand how Bedrock can communicate its differences more clearly.
  • Help coordinate Florida events, partnerships, and local marketing opportunities when needed.

What We Are Looking For

  • Three or more years of experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation, digital marketing, content marketing, or a related role.
  • Experience creating and running campaigns across more than one marketing channel.
  • Strong writing skills and the ability to explain an operational problem without filling the page with buzzwords.
  • Experience with email marketing, landing pages, SEO, social media, and campaign reporting.
  • Experience using a CRM and marketing automation platform such as HubSpot or Brevo.
  • Ability to connect marketing activity to qualified leads, meetings, and pipeline.
  • Comfort working with website analytics, conversion rates, campaign metrics, and spreadsheets.
  • Ability to manage campaigns from the initial idea through launch, reporting, and improvement.
  • Experience marketing B2B software, professional services, facility management, property technology, or multi location operations is helpful.
  • Experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, HubSpot, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Canva, or similar tools is helpful.
  • You must currently reside in Florida and be available for occasional company meetings or events within the state.

A college degree is not required. We care about the quality of your work, your judgment, and whether you can show how your marketing contributed to a business result.

Compensation

This is a full time W2 position with a competitive base salary and a target performance bonus. The base salary range is displayed on this posting.

Equal Opportunity

Bedrock Facility Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Space-1 is NVIDIA's first Orbital Data Center (ODC) module — a Vera Rubin–class compute platform engineered for low-Earth orbit mission. It is the first step in a multi-generation orbital roadmap to speed up AI adoption. We are looking for a strong technical architect to own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor orbital platforms. You will architect the full stack — application to libraries, from data center stack to BMC and BIOS firmware, manageability, and telemetry through the host OS, GPU and CPU drivers, and CUDA — to deliver a production-ready inference platform that operates reliably in the radiation, thermal-cycling, and remote-operations environment of LEO. You will partner closely with the orbital hardware system architecture team, drive customer use cases with constellation operators, align architecture with mission requirements, and bring the best orbital AI products to market. Join us at the forefront of technological advancement.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own system architecture for inference stack and other applications running on this class of products and make it resilient to any fault happening in space.

  • Co-architect with the orbital hardware system architecture team to define interfaces, partitioning, and trade-offs across silicon, board, firmware, OS, and AI workload layers for 5-year LEO missions.

  • Own end-to-end system software architecture for Space-1 and successor Orbital Data Center modules — covering data center stack, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, GPU/CPU drivers, CUDA, DCGM, and manageability telemetry as a single integrated stack.

  • Define the manageability architecture for an unreachable, autonomous data center: remote bring-up, in-orbit firmware update, dual-module redundancy, fault containment, recovery from SEU/SEFI events, and telemetry for fleets ranging from tens to millions of nodes.

  • Architect rad-tolerant system software behaviors — ECC handling, memory scrubbing, latch-up mitigation, deterministic recovery, and graceful degradation through 5 years and up to ~8,000 thermal cycles in dawn–dusk sun-synchronous orbit.

  • Drive Redfish, MCTP, PLDM, and constellation-level management protocols across BMC, BIOS, and host software so customers can operate orbital fleets with the same tools they use on the ground.

  • Define minimum BMC feature set, pin budget, boot architecture (rugged M.2 / VPX-class options), and dual-module redundancy strategy in partnership with platform and mechanical engineering.

  • Partner with cloud and constellation customers (SpaceX, Blue Origin, Starcloud, Planet, Cowboy Space, and others) to translate mission requirements — orbit, duty cycle, NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking (CX9), inference SLAs — into actionable platform software architecture.

  • Drive reliability and optimization in the system software architecture from an orbital data center viewpoint, including correct operation through eclipse periods and idle-power retention strategies.

  • Work closely with the bring-up team and resolve issues at Speed of Light from first silicon through first launch.Own quality, reliability, and telemetry performance of the system software delivered with each ODC module shipped to customers.

What we need to see:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in server/platform system software — spanning compute libraries, BMC firmware, BIOS, host OS, drivers, and manageability

  • BS, MS, or PhD in EE/CS or related field of education (or equivalent experience).

  • Solid understanding of hardware management interfaces (USB, SMBus/I2C, PCIe) and proficiency with modern management protocols including Redfish, MCTP, and PLDM.

  • Strong and demonstrable skill in C/C++ and Python.

  • Experience programming and debugging server platforms, including pre-silicon and platform bring-up environments.

  • Experience in SCM (e.g. Git, Perforce) and project management tools like Jira.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, good work ethics, high sense of team-work, love to produce quality work, and commitment to finish your tasks every single day.

  • You are a self-starter who loves to find creative solutions to complicated problems and hands on with coding.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience architecting platform software for space, aerospace, defense, or other radiation, thermal, and vibration-constrained environments — including SEU/SEFI mitigation, ECC strategy, TID/SEE qualification, and rad-hard design partitioning. Being a part of a start up or initiative directly related to space data centers.

Hands-on with x86 or ARM (Grace/Vera) system architecture and the NVIDIA AI software stack (CUDA, DCGM, DOCA/OFED, GPU drivers, DGX OS).

  • Familiarity with NSA PHIPs security, post-quantum networking, and aerospace standards (VPX, MIL-STD shock/vibe, NASA EEE-INST-002).

  • Proven technical leadership driving large complex programs with 50+ engineers across firmware, OS, driver, and AI stack teams.

Today, we are increasingly known as “the AI computing company.” We're looking to grow our company and establish teams with the most thoughtful people in the world. NVIDIA is seeking exceptional individuals like you to help us drive the next wave of artificial intelligence.

Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

  • Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

  • Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

  • Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

  • Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.

  • A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

  • Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Senior Software Engineer (Rust)

Team: Engineering
Reports to: Tech Lead
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Opportunity

Nodeworthy is supporting a Web3 technology company that helps blockchain projects execute large-scale token-distribution and ecosystem-growth campaigns.

The company builds and operates digital-asset infrastructure for its clients. Projects are delivered through short, parallel engagement cycles involving firm deadlines and real commercial consequences. Its systems must therefore remain accurate, responsive and reliable under heavy workloads.

The team is also conducting research and development for a new blockchain intelligence and data product.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to own the company’s backend services throughout their lifecycle—from architecture and implementation to deployment and operation in production.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor position. It does not involve people management, sales or product design. The ideal candidate is proactive, comfortable working autonomously and willing to take full ownership of complex technical problems.

What You’ll Own

Backend Services

  • Design, build and operate production backend services primarily in Rust.

  • Make architectural decisions that balance performance, reliability and maintainability.

  • Monitor services and resolve issues throughout their production lifecycle.

On-Chain Data Infrastructure

  • Develop indexers and event-processing pipelines for blockchain data.

  • Ensure internal data remains consistent with upstream blockchain states.

  • Design systems that handle retries, duplicate events, partial failures and blockchain reorganisations correctly.

APIs and Data Services

  • Build and maintain the APIs powering internal tools and client-facing dashboards.

  • Design reliable interfaces for accessing and processing large volumes of on-chain data.

  • Maintain clear and well-structured data models.

Data Accuracy

  • Take ownership of the accuracy and consistency of figures generated by your services.

  • Investigate discrepancies and explain how reported figures were derived.

  • Implement appropriate validation, reconciliation and monitoring processes.

Production Releases

  • Support client launches, production deployments and short-notice releases.

  • Diagnose and resolve live production issues under time pressure.

  • Create runbooks and improve operational processes following incidents.

Smart Contract Integration

  • Build services that interact with smart contracts across supported blockchain networks.

  • Work alongside smart-contract engineers and support contract deployment and maintenance when required.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

Required Experience

  • Strong production experience with Rust, particularly asynchronous services, APIs and data-ingestion systems. This is the primary technology stack and the most important requirement.

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems, concurrency, data modelling and SQL.

  • Experience building data-intensive or high-throughput systems where correctness is critical.

  • Understanding of blockchain fundamentals, including EVM and/or Solana, RPC providers, event logs and indexers.

  • Familiarity with smart contracts, including Rust-based development frameworks such as Anchor.

  • Ability to diagnose production systems and make sound decisions under time pressure.

  • Clear written English and the ability to produce runbooks and technical documentation.

  • A proactive and accountable working style, with the ability to operate independently in a distributed team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in digital assets, trading, DeFi or financial infrastructure.

  • Exposure to multiple blockchain ecosystems or cross-chain infrastructure.

  • Experience building or operating blockchain indexing infrastructure.

  • Experience supporting time-sensitive client or production launches.

What This Role Does Not Cover

  • People management or formal team leadership.

  • Business development or client acquisition.

  • Product design or marketing responsibilities.

Interview Process

1. Rust Technical Deep Dive

You will discuss a production service you have built, including:

  • Its architecture and data model.

  • How it handled failures and retries.

  • How you verified the accuracy of its output.

  • The technical trade-offs you made.

2. Practical Exercise

You will complete a focused Rust implementation exercise together with a data-processing problem.

3. Production Judgement

You will be presented with a scenario involving a live service reporting incorrect figures and asked to explain what you would investigate, in what order and why.

4. Technical Communication

You will be asked to share or discuss a runbook, technical document or engineering write-up you have authored.

Application

This is a confidential search managed by Nodeworthy.

To apply, please submit:

  • Your CV.

  • GitHub profile or technical portfolio.

  • A short description of a production Rust service you have built.

  • Any relevant blockchain, indexing or data-infrastructure projects.

Shortlisted candidates will receive further details about the company and opportunity directly from Nodeworthy.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: About RiskExecRiskExec provides regulatory compliance, lending analytics and increasingly AI-enabled intelligence to financial institutions operating in one of the most demanding regulatory environments in the economy.
jobs.description:
About RiskExec

RiskExec provides regulatory compliance, lending analytics and increasingly AI-enabled intelligence to financial institutions operating in one of the most demanding regulatory environments in the economy.

What We’re Building

Our next phase of growth requires deeper penetration of larger financial institutions: organizations with complex regulatory obligations, multiple stakeholders, established technology environments and buying processes that extend across Compliance, Lending, Risk, IT, Security, Procurement, Legal and executive leadership.

Role Overview

This is a strategic new-logo role with responsibility for a defined portfolio of high-value accounts. You will determine where RiskExec has the strongest right to win, build relationships across those institutions, create opportunities where none exist today and orchestrate complex evaluations from first engagement through signature.

This is not an inbound order-taking role, and it is not a volume-prospecting role with a larger quota.

You are expected to combine account strategy, executive-level selling, regulatory credibility, disciplined deal management and persistent pipeline creation.

As RiskExec expands its AI-native capabilities, including Integrity, you will also help sophisticated financial institutions understand where AI can improve compliance workflows while maintaining appropriate human judgment, governance and control.

We are currently considering remote candidates based in Eastern and Central time zones.

What You Will Own

Enterprise new ARR. You are accountable for winning new strategic customers and delivering your annual bookings commitment.

Named-account strategy. For each priority institution, you will develop a clear view of organizational structure, business priorities, regulatory pressures, incumbent solutions, competitive position, relevant stakeholders and realistic paths to entry.

Pipeline creation within your portfolio. BDR, Marketing and executive resources will support you; responsibility for creating enough enterprise pipeline to make the territory successful remains yours.

Complex deal orchestration. You own the opportunity from initial engagement through discovery, evaluation, security and diligence processes, business case, procurement, negotiation and signature.

Executive and multi-threaded relationships. You will build relationships beyond a single champion and engage compliance executives, business leaders, technology stakeholders and economic buyers at the appropriate stages of the process.

Strategic platform selling. You will position RiskExec as a platform rather than a collection of isolated modules, connecting HMDA, CRA, Fair Lending, Redlining, Fair Servicing and AI-enabled capabilities to the institution's broader operating priorities.

Commercial strategy and negotiation. You will make thoughtful decisions about packaging, sequencing, stakeholder engagement and use of internal resources while protecting long-term account value.

Pipeline and forecast data in HubSpot. Opportunity structure, stakeholder maps, next steps and close dates live in HubSpot and stay current. A forecast is only as credible as the record behind it.

Customer Success owns implementation, adoption and account health following handoff. You will remain strategically involved where executive relationships, expansion strategy or commercial action requires it.

Selling Integrity, RiskExec's AI-Native Module

Enterprise institutions will scrutinize Integrity harder than any other part of the platform, and that scrutiny will come from Risk, Legal, IT and Security rather than from your compliance champion. You own that conversation in the deal.

Develop a working command of what Integrity does, what data it uses, how its outputs are produced and where human review sits. No AI or ML background is required, and claiming more technical depth than you have will cost you credibility with the people who evaluate it.

Position Integrity inside the platform conversation rather than as a standalone product, connecting it to the institution's existing HMDA, CRA, Fair Lending and Redlining work and to the compliance capacity a lean team is trying to protect.

Carry Integrity through model risk management and third-party AI governance diligence. Larger institutions increasingly run this as a formal review track, and it will slow or stop a deal if you are not prepared for it.

Answer practical questions on data handling, explainability and human review points in front of technical and legal stakeholders. Route anything that requires a definitive commitment to Product or Legal rather than improvising an answer under pressure.

Bring what you hear back to Product. Enterprise objections to Integrity are the earliest signal of what the module needs next.

How You Will Drive Impact

Enterprise productivity comes from focus. Your job is not to treat every institution in your portfolio equally. You will segment your portfolio, concentrate company resources on accounts with meaningful potential and pursue them with a deliberate point of view.

You will:

  • Build and maintain strategic account plans for priority institutions.
  • Create customer-specific hypotheses before outreach rather than relying on generic sequences.
  • Develop relationships across the buying organization before and during active opportunities.
  • Qualify rigorously and disengage from opportunities that do not have a credible path to a decision.
  • Build quantified business cases around risk reduction, operating efficiency, analytical capability and customer value.
  • Navigate security, legal, procurement and AI-governance diligence without losing commercial momentum.
  • Mobilize RiskExec executives, Product, Solutions, Customer Success and subject-matter experts when their participation changes the probability or size of a win.
  • Maintain evidence-based forecasts with transparent risks, dependencies and next actions.
  • Run account research and meeting preparation on the tools RiskExec has deployed: Waypoint for account and contact intelligence, Clay and LinkedIn Sales Navigator for enrichment and stakeholder mapping, Nooks for outbound dialing and call intelligence, and Claude for research synthesis, call preparation and drafting. Use HubSpot Notetaker and Claude to turn calls into logged summaries and next steps in HubSpot. The expected result is better-prepared executive conversations and less administrative drag, not a higher activity count.

Performance will be measured by enterprise ARR, quota attainment, qualified pipeline, strategic account penetration, conversion, forecast accuracy and the quality and durability of new customer relationships.

Cross-Functional and Executive Interfaces

You will work closely with:

BDR: You set account priorities and penetration strategy; BDR resources extend your coverage and execution.

Marketing: You partner on account-based campaigns, executive programs, events and regulatory narratives that create access to priority institutions.

Product and Solutions: You bring them into opportunities where product depth, regulatory expertise, data architecture or AI capabilities materially influence the outcome.

Security and Legal: You coordinate customer diligence and contracting while maintaining clear commercial ownership.

Customer Success: You establish a disciplined handoff and remain involved in strategic commercial opportunities without taking over account-management responsibility.

Executive Leadership: You use CEO, President and executive relationships selectively to advance strategic opportunities and deepen RiskExec's position in major accounts.

Enterprise sellers at RiskExec are expected to use internal resources deliberately. Escalating everything is not enterprise selling; knowing when senior involvement changes the outcome is.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of successful quota-carrying B2B software or technology sales experience, including meaningful enterprise responsibility.
  • Demonstrated success closing complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities with substantial contract value and extended buying processes.
  • Proven ability to create enterprise pipeline through account development, executive networking, referrals and disciplined outbound, not solely through inbound or SDR-generated opportunities.
  • Strong account-planning, discovery, negotiation and executive-presentation capability.
  • Experience navigating security, legal, procurement and other enterprise diligence processes.
  • Strong commercial judgment and a history of accurate forecasting.
  • Ability to learn complex regulatory and technical concepts and communicate them credibly without overstating expertise.
  • Working fluency with HubSpot or a comparable enterprise CRM, and daily use of AI research and outbound tools as part of how you sell. Experience with our specific stack is not required; working this way is.
  • Willingness to travel for high-value customer meetings and industry events.

Preferred

  • Experience selling into banks, credit unions, lenders or other regulated financial institutions.
  • Experience in RegTech, lending technology, data/analytics, governance, risk or compliance software.
  • Familiarity with HMDA, CRA, Fair Lending, model governance or related compliance disciplines.
  • Direct experience with Claude, Clay, Nooks, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or comparable tools in a daily outbound and account-research workflow.
  • Experience selling enterprise platforms with multiple modules, use cases and expansion paths.
  • Experience competing against established incumbents and displacing legacy workflows or consultants.
Traits That Win at RiskExec

You think in accounts, not leads. You understand how organizations make decisions and how influence moves through them.

You create demand. You can build an opportunity before a formal buying process exists.

You are patient without being passive. Enterprise cycles take time; enterprise sellers still create momentum every week.

You are credible with executives and practitioners. You can move between strategy and operating detail without pretending to know what you do not know.

You protect company resources. You know which deals deserve executive, technical and product investment.

You use AI as leverage. Better intelligence and preparation should translate into higher-quality selling, not simply more automated activity.

You forecast with integrity. You distinguish what you want to happen from what the evidence says will happen.

You own the number. Territory, pipeline, deal execution and results are ultimately your responsibility.

Compensation and Benefits

A competitive compensation package with a 50/50 base and variable split, plus benefits including group health, dental and vision plans and a 401(k) with company match.

Why this Role Matters

Enterprise growth is strategically important to RiskExec.

Larger institutions create substantial revenue opportunity, expand the platform's market position and pressure-test RiskExec against the most demanding regulatory, technical and operational requirements in financial services.

The strongest Enterprise AE will do more than close several large transactions. You will help RiskExec establish durable executive relationships with major institutions, expand adoption of our platform and AI capabilities, and build a repeatable model for winning complex enterprise business.

RiskExec is a private-equity-backed software company with high expectations for growth, efficiency and execution. The opportunity is substantial, but so is the accountability.

RiskExec's Core Values

We Put Clients First: We earn trust through responsiveness, expertise and a focus on meaningful customer outcomes.

We Innovate With Purpose: We apply technology, including AI, to real customer problems rather than innovation for its own sake.

We Are Fast: We move with urgency and precision.

We Act With Integrity: We tell the truth, make responsible commitments and protect the trust our customers place in us.

We Succeed Together: We operate as one company and solve problems across functional boundaries.

We Grow as a Team: We learn quickly, address issues directly and improve the system rather than assigning blame.

The Senior Medical Scientist will provide technical leadership to help ensure that the best available evidence supports quality and continuous improvement in safe abortion, contraception, and gender-based violence management across development and humanitarian contexts. This role will strengthen abortion availability, accessibility, acceptability and quality through formal health systems and self-care pathways by establishing and enhancing global technical tools, standards, processes, monitoring mechanisms, and partnerships that contribute to a sustainable abortion ecosystem.

Summary of Responsibilities

The Senior Medical Scientist is a subject matter expert, using clinical expertise, evolving evidence and strategic partnerships to advance Ipas’s mission at the global level. In collaboration with key staff across the organization, Senior Medical Scientist will advance innovative initiatives and provide strategic guidance and technical assistance on safe abortion, contraception and GBV care quality and access. The Senior Medical Scientist disseminates new evidence through publications and presentations; conducts training; represents Ipas externally, advocating for the organization’s mission within the broader reproductive health field; and builds partnerships with colleague organizations to maximize impact.

Organizational Leadership and Strategy:

  • Provides technical leadership to develop and test innovative approaches to improve quality abortion and contraception care (e.g., global quality indicators, quality improvement processes) and to integrate safe abortion and postabortion contraception into SRHR programming for Ipas support programs and in emergency crisis settings

Program, technical, or functional content of the job:

  • Provide and/or analyze evidence based technical content used for advocacy opportunities related to safe abortion for Ipas supported programs and external coalitions
  • Develop technical tools and resources translating evidence based clinical updates into health services
  • Provides technical leadership on quality and regulatory processes pertinent to the Ipas MVA product line, as well as infection prevention and MVA processing
  • Supports training of Ipas supported sites and partners on content such as VCAT, clinical management of abortion and contraception care, trauma-informed care, legal risk assessment, etc.
  • Leads and/or significant participation in clinical/technical research and technical evidence dissemination for abortion/contraception clinical practice improvement
  • Prepare and/or analyze service delivery data and issue clinical recommendations for continuous improvement of quality of care across the pathways to care.

Resource mobilization:

  • Supports fundraising initiatives by contributing to donor proposals and preparation/review of donor reports

Communications & representation:

  • Write periodic evidence summaries for internal communications with technical staff across the network
  • Provides external leadership, Ipas representation, and advocacy as required at national, regional and international conferences and events
  • Disseminates evidence externally through presentations and publications

Position Requirements

  • A deep commitment to sexual and reproductive health and rights, especially abortion, contraception and GBV care access
  • Demonstrated contribution to the development of technical tools, standards, guidelines, and SRHR research.
  • Professional-level fluency in English (speaking, reading, and writing)
  • Proven ability to support and strengthen the capacity of teams, including through training, supportive supervision, strong communication, nonhierarchical leadership approaches, and modeling the Ipas core values.
  • Demonstrated capacity and commitment to good stewardship of funds, including strong skills in work planning, budgeting, financial monitoring, and data-driven problem solving.
  • Proven ability to build positive working relationships in a multicultural and complex implementation contexts with diverse internal teams and external partners

Education

  • Advanced clinical degree (e.g nursing, midwifery)

Experience

  • 10+ years’ experience in clinical practice including reproductive health care and experience applying scientific clinical information to practical training and programs
  • Substantive experience with evaluation of quality in clinical care and quality improvement.
  • Substantive knowledge and experience of international reproductive health programs and systems in low-resource and humanitarian settings
  • Knowledge of key partners and influencers in our field
  • Experience working in multicultural teams

  • Strong clinical background
  • Experience working in humanitarian contexts and/or working with humanitarian implementing agencies
  • Established relationships with non-profit organizations and advocacy groups
  • Proficiency with at least one Ipas working language, such as French, Portuguese, or Spanish.

jobs.description:
Based in the US and reporting directly to the CEO, the Manager, Global Engagement will shape how Aceli tells its story to international audiences, including funders, investors, development finance institutions, policymakers, and sector peers. The Manager will be a writer, editor, project manager, and thought partner to the CEO and Executive team, identifying, producing, and presenting the many layers of Aceli's story. Working closely with the Kenya-based Communications team, the Manager will keep Aceli’s communications strategy aligned with the organisation’s overall strategy, while owning Aceli’s messaging framework and brand. The role will also lead the thought leadership calendar and digital channels, and shape the narrative for Aceli’s fundraising. It works in close partnership with Aceli's Communications team, which focuses on communications with Aceli’s partners in Africa and handles in person and virtual events in our focus countries, internal communications, and capacity building on communications for the Aceli team.

The ideal candidate is a skilled writer and project manager with experience in thought leadership and communications for international development, impact investing, philanthropy, and/or financial services. S/he must be able to translate complex, data-rich work into narratives that resonate with senior global audiences, especially donors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Thought Leadership & Editorial

  • Draft and co-author thought leadership content, including articles, op-eds, reports, speeches, and talking points, and serve as a writing thought partner to the CEO and senior leaders as they develop and refine their ideas.
  • Own Aceli's thought leadership calendar, planning and sequencing publications around key organizational milestones and international sector events.
  • Help team members shape narratives around their work (e.g., climate, economic opportunities for women and youth, nutrition) that can be developed into thought leadership pieces for international audiences.
  • Advise the CEO on the narrative approach for Aceli's publications; review final drafts and provide copyedits and recommendations to make messaging clear and compelling to a general audience.
  • Manage design partners from procurement through publication, leading feedback cycles and owning final quality control.
  • Work with the regional Communications team to build internal skills through training and templates, in line with Aceli’s writing style, tone, and editorial conventions.

2. External messaging and brand

  • Lead the development and maintenance of a set of clear, consistent key messages that staff should use to tell Aceli's story; in partnership with Communications team, ensure Aceli staff are familiar with these messages and provide capacity building as needed
  • Partner with the regional Communications team to maintain Aceli's visual brand standards and ensure all public-facing collateral reflects a consistent, professional identity.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to the Executive team and the regional Communications team on key decisions about Aceli's external brand and messaging.
  • Build on existing engagement analytics to assess how key messages and stories land with funders, partners, and other priority international audiences, and refine the key messages based on what resonates.

3. Fundraising

  • Partner with the fundraising team to shape the narrative in funder proposals, reports, and pitch materials so Aceli's data and human impact reinforce each other for an external audience.
  • Provide input and writing support for funder proposals and external materials as needed
  • Maintain a close partnership with the regional Communications team to ensure collateral such as quotes, photography, and videos meet the needs of international and funder audiences.
  • Support the regional Communications team to identify and develop high quality and effective collateral for sharing the human stories behind Aceli's data that will be most compelling to funder audiences and provide editorial support so these stories work for both local and international audiences.

4. Digital Platforms

  • Execute website content updates and oversee technical maintenance to ensure security and an optimal user experience.
  • Design quarterly newsletters and publication announcements, and execute campaign delivery optimized to Aceli's audiences.
  • Develop and disseminate messaging and content optimized for LinkedIn, working closely with the regional Communications team to maximize audience engagement.
  • Track analytics across the website, newsletter, and LinkedIn to measure audience engagement and inform Aceli's broader communications strategy.
  • Support regional Communications team with digital communications relating to events e.g. invitations using MailChimp
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, International Development, Economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in strategic communications, thought leadership, editorial, or brand roles, of which at least 3 years in international development, impact investing, philanthropy, or financial services.
  • Familiarity with agricultural finance, SME finance, or blended finance, ideally in African markets.
  • Demonstrated track record writing and publishing thought leadership (reports, articles, op-eds, briefs) for senior international audiences.
  • Exceptional English writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex financial and data-heavy content into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Experience advising senior executives on messaging, positioning, and narrative strategy.
  • Experience developing messaging frameworks, style guides, or brand standards, and managing external design and creative partners.
  • Proficiency with website content management systems, email marketing platforms, LinkedIn, and web and social analytics tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple publications and priorities simultaneously.
  • Team player with a collaborative spirit and strong work ethic, able to work effectively and independently within a remote, multi-country team.
  • Willingness to travel to East Africa, Europe, and Washington, DC.

Preferred

  • Experience developing fundraising communications for bilateral and philanthropic donors.
  • Experience with data storytelling and data visualization.
  • Experience building communications or storytelling capacity across distributed teams.
  • Working knowledge of design tools for producing on-brand collateral.

Aceli is an equal opportunity employer. Please share an updated CV, cover letter, and two writing samples by 10 November 2026. Applications without a Cover Letter and writing sample will not be considered.

Aceli Africa is a market catalyst that unlocks private sector lending for agricultural enterprises. Drawing upon new data that explains the credit gap for small- and medium-enterprises (SMEs) in the agriculture sector, Aceli offers financial incentives to a marketplace of 50+ commercial banks and innovative finance companies to share in the risk and defray the high transaction costs of lending to agricultural SMEs.

Since launching in 2020, Aceli has mobilized $585M in lending to 7,000+ agricultural enterprises providing market access for 2.7M smallholder farmers across Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, and Zambia. With access to finance, agricultural SMEs are accessing loans for the first time, growing their businesses, increasing their purchases from farmers, and creating more jobs. Building on learning to date, Aceli plans to mobilize $2 billion in financing for agri-SMEs and improve livelihoods for 5 million farmers and workers by 2030.

Veeam is seeking a technically strong, customer-focused Strategic Partner Solutions Architect – Securiti.ai to accelerate Securiti.ai business through the established Veeam partner ecosystem. Veeam Channel and Technical Alignment

jobs.excerpt: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions.
jobs.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Job Summary


We are seeking a quality or industrial engineering professional with hands-on experience in metal fabrication, welding inspection, metal stamping, and laser cutting. This role will evaluate supplier manufacturing capabilities, establish quality requirements, and drive process improvements to ensure fabricated metal parts and assemblies meet engineering specifications and customer expectations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Assess and qualify suppliers for metal fabrication processes, including welding, stamping, laser cutting, forming, and assembly.
  • Conduct supplier process audits to evaluate manufacturing controls, equipment capabilities, inspection methods, and quality systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), material specifications, and customer requirements to identify critical dimensions, features, and functions.
  • Inspect welded assemblies for dimensional accuracy, workmanship, weld discontinuities, and conformance to applicable drawings and acceptance criteria.
  • Evaluate stamping processes for dimensional consistency, tooling condition, burr control, cracking, springback, and surface defects.
  • Assess laser cutting processes for cut accuracy, edge quality, dross, distortion, and repeatability.
  • Develop and review inspection plans, control plans, process flow diagrams, and process failure mode and effects analyses (PFMEAs).
  • Support new product introduction, first article inspections, and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions.
  • Verify material composition, mechanical properties, traceability, and supporting material certifications.
  • Evaluate paint, coating, plating, and surface finish requirements, including appearance and thickness criteria.
  • Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions using methods such as 8D, 5 Whys, and fishbone analysis.
  • Partner with sourcing, engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers to improve quality, process capability, yield, and delivery performance.
  • Track supplier performance and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions and development plans.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • At least three years of relevant quality, manufacturing, industrial engineering, or supplier quality experience in metal fabrication.
  • Practical experience with welding inspection, metal stamping, and laser cutting.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, weld symbols, and technical specifications.
  • Experience using dimensional inspection equipment, such as calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and coordinate measuring machines (CMMs).
  • Working knowledge of quality management systems, statistical process control (SPC), measurement system analysis (MSA), and process capability analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to work across functions and directly with suppliers to resolve manufacturing and quality issues.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Certified Welding Inspector (CWI), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Six Sigma certification, or equivalent credentials.
  • Experience with MIG, TIG, resistance, or robotic welding processes.
  • Familiarity with applicable AWS welding codes and nondestructive testing methods.
  • Experience with large metal enclosures, cabinets, racks, chassis, or other complex fabricated assemblies.
  • Experience leading supplier qualification, supplier development, and manufacturing readiness reviews.
  • Familiarity with Lean manufacturing, tooling and fixture validation, and design for manufacturability.

Travel Requirements


Ability to travel to supplier and manufacturing locations as business needs require.

Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.

Passionately driven

We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.

Insightful leaders

We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

jobs.description:
Are you a U.S.-licensed psychologist passionate about leveraging technology to provide accessible, high-quality mental health care? We are a premier telehealth platform dedicated to connecting skilled psychologists with individuals, couples, and families seeking professional support. We are seeking compassionate and autonomous professionals to join our expanding network.

Our platform is designed for practitioners who value independence and flexibility. We handle the client acquisition, so you can dedicate your energy to what you do best: fostering healing and growth. Build your ideal private practice from anywhere in the U.S., on your own terms.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide High-Quality Teletherapy: Conduct evidence-based psychological services for individuals, couples, or families via a secure, HIPAA-compliant video platform, consistent with your scope of licensure and clinical expertise.
  • Maintain Compliant Clinical Records: Ensure all clinical documentation is accurate, comprehensive, and completed in a timely manner, adhering to HIPAA standards and the regulations of your licensing state(s).
  • Uphold Ethical & Legal Standards: Strictly adhere to the APA's Ethical Principles of Psychologists and Code of Conduct, all applicable state and federal laws, and best practices for telehealth confidentiality and security.
  • Manage Client Relationships: Foster a professional therapeutic environment by clearly communicating your practice policies, session fees, and scheduling directly with your clients.
  • Direct Financial Management: Independently establish your session rates, and manage all aspects of billing and payment directly with your clientele.

Requirements:

  • Education: A Doctoral degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) in Clinical, Counseling, or School Psychology from a program accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA).
  • Licensure: A current, unrestricted license to practice psychology independently in at least one state within the U.S. You are responsible for maintaining compliance with all inter-state telehealth laws and regulations.
  • Experience: A minimum of two years of post-licensure experience delivering psychotherapy and/or psychological assessments.
  • Telehealth Proficiency: Demonstrated competence in using secure telehealth technologies (e.g., SimplePractice, Doxy.me, Zoom for Healthcare) and experience with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
  • Professional Liability: Must maintain an active professional liability (malpractice) insurance policy with coverage appropriate for your practice.
  • Independent Contractor Readiness: Must be prepared to operate as an independent contractor, managing your own schedule, taxes, and business-related expenses.

Required Skills:

  • Exceptional clinical, diagnostic, and case conceptualization skills.
  • Superior interpersonal and communication skills, with an emphasis on building therapeutic rapport remotely.
  • Deep empathy, cultural humility, and unwavering professionalism.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • A strong commitment to continuous professional growth and ethical practice.

What We Offer:

  • Complete Autonomy: You are in full control. Set your own schedule, determine your caseload, and work the hours that fit your life (from 5 to 30+ hours per week).
  • Financial Control: Set your own session fees based on your expertise and market. Clients pay you directly, ensuring you retain 100% of your earnings. We take no commission.
  • Steady Stream of Referrals: Gain access to a diverse pool of clients actively seeking therapy. Our marketing efforts connect you with clients who are a good fit for your specialties, at no cost to you.
  • Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the freedom to work from your home or office, as long as you are located in a state where you are licensed to practice.
  • Focus on Clinical Excellence: We reduce your administrative burden by managing client outreach and platform technology, allowing you to concentrate on providing outstanding clinical care.
  • Free & Transparent Partnership: There are no sign-up costs, membership fees, or hidden charges. Our goal is to support your practice, not profit from it.

How to Join Our Network:

  1. Submit Your Application: Complete our online application form and create your professional profile, highlighting your qualifications, specialties, and therapeutic approach.
  2. Credential Verification: Upload your verification documents, including your doctoral degree, state license(s), and proof of liability insurance, for review by our credentialing team.
  3. Onboarding: Once verified, you will be invited to an onboarding session to familiarize yourself with the platform and best practices.
  4. Start Connecting: Set your availability and begin receiving client requests. You will manage all communications, scheduling, and payments directly.

If you are a driven, licensed psychologist ready to embrace the future of mental healthcare and build a thriving remote practice, we encourage you to apply and join our community of dedicated professionals.

Salary: $50 – $100 / hour

jobs.description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a Virtualization / Automation Engineer to operate, maintain, automate, and improve the virtualization and Software-Defined Data Center (SDDC) platforms supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager (SRM), and associated Infrastructure as Code capabilities.

The role focuses on the hypervisor and SDDC platform layers across production, development, test, COOP, disaster-recovery, and hybrid-hosting environments; guest operating systems, applications, databases, and cloud workloads remain with their respective teams. The engineer also supports the transition of applicable services to centralized DISA-hosting platforms through discovery, migration support, validation, and stabilization.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    • Configure, administer, and maintain virtualization clusters, including vSphere HA, DRS, resource pools, hosts, datastores, and distributed switches, and manage ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, and certificates.
    • Monitor platform capacity, availability, performance, and compliance, and recommend scaling, balancing, or remediation actions.
    • Configure and support vSAN clusters, storage policies, and fault domains, and troubleshoot vSAN performance, resynchronization, and policy-compliance issues.
    • Configure and support NSX segments, transport zones, gateways, routing, and distributed security controls, coordinating changes with network and cybersecurity teams.
    • Administer SRM protection groups and recovery plans, execute and document failover and failback tests, and support quarterly COOP exercises and continuity events.
    • Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, PowerCLI, or APIs, with version control, peer review, testing, rollback, secrets protection, and drift detection.
    • Coordinate with workload owners on resource requirements, placement, templates, and snapshots, preserving the division between platform and workload ownership.
    • Provide advanced engineering support for cross-platform incidents, isolate platform faults during outages, and collect evidence for root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
    • Maintain platform configuration backups, apply DISA STIGs and security baselines, and support RMF evidence, vulnerability remediation, and vendor-advisory reviews.
    • Support technology refreshes and modernization; contribute to capacity, lifecycle, and modernization assessments.
    • Support DISA-hosting transitions through discovery, dependency documentation, readiness assessment, test and rollback plans, cutover, and post-migration stabilization.
    • Maintain architecture diagrams, as-built documentation, SOPs, and recovery procedures, and provide platform metrics and modernization status for program reporting.

Education & Experience

    Required:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the labor category.
    • Minimum of six (6) years of relevant experience in virtualization, systems engineering, data-center infrastructure, platform engineering, or infrastructure automation.
    • Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter and with vSAN, NSX, SRM, or comparable software-defined storage, network-virtualization, and disaster-recovery technologies.
    • Experience developing or maintaining infrastructure-automation solutions and troubleshooting issues across compute, storage, network, virtualization, and automation layers.
    • Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, capacity management, and lifecycle practices.
    • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

      • Preferred:

      • Formal Terraform and Ansible training.
      • Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation or VMware Aria, and PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, or REST APIs.
      • Experience supporting federal or DoD virtualization environments and migrations to DISA enterprise-hosting platforms.
      • Experience with DISA STIGs, RMF controls, vulnerability remediation, and configuration compliance.
      • Experience developing Infrastructure as Code within CI/CD and Git workflows with automated testing and code scanning.

Certifications

    • Required: None.
    • Preferred: VMware Certified Professional, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation, ITIL 4 Foundation, or relevant cloud, security, storage, or network certification.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance or higher is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

    Work Environment / Travel:

    • Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred.
    • Occasional on-site support, after-hours maintenance, disaster-recovery exercises, incident response, and travel may be required.

jobs.description:
Resumen

Buscamos un Ingeniero de Migración de Infraestructura, apasionado por acompañar a clientes de misión crítica en la evolución de sus cargas de trabajo hacia entornos Cloud Native. Te integrarás a nuestro equipo de Servicios Profesionales para liderar la transición de máquinas virtuales (VMware) hacia plataformas basadas en KVM. Valoramos perfiles rigurosos, con sólidas bases de administración Linux y diagnóstico en producción, pensamiento analítico y una búsqueda constante de las mejores estrategias para resolver problemas complejos de infraestructura y asegurar migración de alta disponibilidad sin downtime.

El rol requiere la capacidad de desenvolverse en entornos internacionales y multiculturales, así como el interés genuino por formar parte de una organización con una cultura técnica exigente, orientada a la excelencia arquitectónica y a la adopción de nuevas tecnologías.

La posición implica trabajar estrechamente con equipos técnicos de empresas líderes en los mercados chileno y peruano, participando activamente en la migración de cargas de trabajo desde entornos tradicionales de virtualización hacia plataformas Cloud modernas basadas en Kubernetes.

Si buscas desarrollar tu carrera en Cloud y proyectarte hacia un rol de Arquitecto de Soluciones, esta es una oportunidad concreta para acelerar tu crecimiento profesional, enfrentando desafíos reales y de alto impacto.

Modalidad remota, con base en las ciudades Santiago (Chile) o Lima (Perú), para poder asistir a reuniones presenciales con clientes según sus necesidades.

Responsabilidades

  • Trabajar estrechamente con los clientes, comprendiendo en profundidad las arquitecturas de sistemas de misión crítica actualmente desplegadas sobre VMware, y elaborando documentación de arquitectura clara y precisa.

  • Definir y ejecutar la estrategia de migración de las aplicaciones hacia nuevos entornos Cloud, considerando criterios de afinidad y anti-afinidad de máquinas virtuales, dependencias técnicas y requisitos operacionales. Esto incluye la ejecución de ensayos progresivos de migración utilizando la plataforma Whitestack Chrysara.

  • Liderar la ejecución de las migraciones de aplicaciones previamente validadas hacia los nuevos entornos, coordinando y operando dentro de ventanas de mantenimiento, asegurando continuidad operacional y mínimos riesgos.

  • Ejecutar procesos de validación automática de cargas de trabajo, analizando los resultados para confirmar el rollout o activar mecanismos de rollback automático, según corresponda.

  • Realizar troubleshooting avanzado de incidentes reportados durante el despliegue o la operación inicial de las aplicaciones, cuando estos estén relacionados con la infraestructura Cloud.

  • Diseñar y ejecutar pruebas de escenarios específicos requeridos por cada aplicación, tanto en ambientes pre productivos como mediante la adecuación de entornos en laboratorios propios.

  • Documentar, mantener y actualizar de forma continua la información de infraestructura y arquitectura Cloud asociada a cada aplicación migrada.

  • Proveer retroalimentación técnica a los equipos internos, proponiendo mejoras y optimizaciones que incrementen la eficiencia, repetibilidad y confiabilidad de los procesos de despliegue y migración de aplicaciones.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiencia

  • 3 años de experiencia en administración intermedia de Linux, administrando sistemas en entornos productivos.

  • Experiencia participando en discusiones técnicas con clientes, explicando decisiones arquitectónicas y operativas de forma clara y fundamentada.

  • Experiencia en la documentación de información técnica, incluyendo arquitecturas, procedimientos y planes de operación.

  • Formación

    • Título profesional en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería de Sistemas, Ingeniería Electrónica, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o carreras afines.

  • Conocimientos específicos (en orden de prioridad)

      • Buenos conocimientos de sistemas operativos, procesos y concurrencia, filesystems.

      • Importante haber hecho troubleshootings reales del filesystem o de la red (mtr, ip, ss, lsof, tcpdump, df, lsblk, iostat, strace)

      • Experiencia en scribir scripts de mantenimiento o automatización (Bash), recuperar password root, diagnósticos de carga básica, etc.

    • Virtualización Básico (20%)

jobs.description:
Updated/Reviewed 04.17.26

Interviewer

Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization

Position Name: Volunteer Interviewer for Dog Rescue - Volunteer (Unpaid)

Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States

Job Type: Part Time

Office Setting: Fully Remote

Remote: Yes

Compensation: Volunteer

Hours Per Week: 5 (flexible)

Role Mission

Path of Hope relies on volunteers heavily to achieve our mission. Due to the nature of volunteering, we have a high turnover of candidates. Your role is to support the continuous flow of qualified volunteers to fill open roles in the Rescue. You will interview candidates and assess whether they can integrate into the Rescue and effectively complete the role and duties as assigned.

What Winning Looks Like

Key Results Area #1 - Roles

  • Familiar with organization structure of the Rescue

  • Familiar with job descriptions and seeks to understand the purpose of each role in order to offer alternative roles, when it's determined that skills would be better suited to a different role

Key Results Area #2 - Self Motivated Work Ethic

  • Keep and update your personal schedule

  • Adherence to interview schedules with minimal rescheduling

  • Daily check ins with remote platform and leader

Key Results Area #2 - Interview Process

  • Conduct 30-minute phone interviews effectively, ensuring all key questions are covered while maintaining a professional and engaging experience for candidates.

  • Assess the suitability of candidates for specific volunteer roles based on their skills, availability, and alignment with the Rescue's Core Values and the role's Key Results Areas

  • Detailed interview notes and recommendations for each candidate.

  • Timely follow-up with team leads for role placement within 24 hours of the interview.

Needed Skills

  • Must love dogs and people. We can't save dogs without talented people.

  • Active listening with conversational style. Ability to listen for context clues on what type of role would be a good fit.

  • Self motivated without needing a leader to keep you on task

  • Manage your schedule and keep up to date. Daily check ins via remote chat

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

About First Due

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

Job Title: Enterprise Implementation Manager

Location: Remote - US Only
Country: United States
Department: Professional Services
Reports To: Sr Director, Enterprise Professional Services
Position Type: Full-Time
Salary: $100,000

Job Summary:

The Implementation Manager, Enterprise owns end-to-end delivery of First Due's Enterprise implementation programs, the largest and most complex engagements in the US customer base. These are multi-module, multi-phase deployments for large fire and EMS agencies, involving computer-aided dispatch integrations, significant historical data migration from legacy records management systems, and layered stakeholder environments spanning command staff, information technology, the dispatch center, EMS, fire prevention, training, labor representation, and municipal government.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The Implementation Manager coordinates a delivery team of Implementation Consultants and Technical Services resources, owns the program plan and the customer relationship, and is accountable for delivery quality, timeline integrity, and scope control across an assigned portfolio. The role is expected to run programs on formal project management discipline and to use AI tooling to remove routine work from delivery so that judgment, domain expertise, and executive presence carry the majority of the incumbent's time.

Key Responsibilities:

Program delivery and governance

  • Own delivery of an assigned portfolio of Enterprise programs from sales transition through configuration, integration, data migration, training, go-live, and Customer Success transition.
  • Build and maintain program plans in Rocketlane, including critical path, workstream dependencies, module-level exit criteria, level-of-effort actuals, and risk and decision records.
  • Sequence go-live events around agency operational readiness, and recover at-risk or stalled programs with a documented path to resolution or closure.
  • Publish weekly program status covering schedule health against plan, open risks with named owners and dates, and decisions required.
  • Own change control, and validate the sales transition ahead of kickoff so that scope, contract commitments, and go-live expectations are confirmed before the program starts.

Stakeholder and executive engagement

  • Lead engagements involving large, multi-department stakeholder groups, commonly including the fire chief and command staff, information technology and cybersecurity, the dispatch center, EMS and medical direction, the training division, the fire prevention bureau, labor representation, and municipal government.
  • Lead change adoption for constituencies that experience the platform differently, including shift-based personnel, represented workforces on scheduling and time capture, and volunteer or combination staffing models.

AI-enabled delivery

  • Apply AI-assisted analysis to program preparation, including legacy data assessment, first-pass migration field mapping, and agency-specific discovery sets, and act on Rocketlane forecasting signals to catch schedule slippage before a milestone is missed.
  • Own the accuracy of any AI-assisted output that reaches an agency, and handle customer data within First Due's data handling standards.

Commercial ownership and product partnership

  • Deliver against contracted services scope, hours, and fees, and bring a recommended commercial position to segment leadership when overrun risk appears.
  • Draft and negotiate change orders in partnership with segment leadership, Sales, and the agency, including effort justification and revised schedule impact.
  • Review statements of work and solicitation responses for delivery feasibility before commitment

Qualifications:
