Lead UX/UI Designer

Heptic Arena — Full-Time — Remote (Europe)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based game development studio making bold, player-first games. We're a small, cross-disciplinary team working remotely across Europe, with a culture built on ownership, trust and self-management. Our first title, Heptic Arena, is a third-person PvPvE arena shooter set in an intergalactic game show. We're now building it with our community through closed playtests on the road to Early Access.

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead UX/UI Designer to own the user interface and player experience of Heptic Arena across PC and console. You'll report to the Creative Director and set the UI vision, standards and direction for the game. You'll also stay hands-on: designing screens, building assets and working in engine day to day.

This is a player/coach role. There's no line management, but you'll mentor junior designers and freelancers, review their work and raise the quality bar across the team. You'll be the go-to person for UI and UX decisions, working closely with art, design, engineering and production.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, Manage, Define and maintain Heptic Arena's Players UX,UI visual language and design system (components, typography, iconography, colour, motion,accessibility guidelines.

Lead UI/UX across the full player journey: front end, HUD, menus, progression, store, social features and onboarding.

Propose, Concept, Design, prototype and deliver: wireframes, user flows, screen maps, mockups and final UI assets, from early concept through to polish.

Work closely with Game Design and Engineering on implementation in Unreal Engine, and resolve UX trade-offs and technical constraints early.

Use playtest feedback, analytics and A/B testing to find UX problems and iterate on solutions.

Mentor junior designers and freelancers through design reviews, feedback and clear briefs.

Estimate, plan and prioritise UX/UI work with Production, Execute and control development, create and distribute UX/UI tasks in Jira.

Own UX/UI documentation in Confluence and keep it the single source of truth for the team.

Set up review and QA processes so that the implemented UI meets our quality, consistency and accessibility standards.

Represent UI/UX in leadership and cross-discipline discussions, and advocate for the player's experience.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in game UI/UX design, including at least one shipped PC or console title.
  • A strong portfolio of PC/console game UI work (not mobile), showing both systems-level thinking and polished visual execution.
  • Deep knowledge of UI design principles, information hierarchy and usability, especially for real-time, action-heavy games.
  • Hands-on experience implementing UI in Unreal Engine (UMG/Common UI preferred)
  • Expert use of design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Axure, Adobe XD or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining a UI design system or style guide.
  • Proven ability to guide and mentor other designers and give clear, constructive feedback.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, and confidence presenting and defending design decisions to stakeholders.
  • Comfortable with Jira,, Confluence and Google Workspace
  • Self-driven and organized, able to thrive in a remote, self-managing team.
  • Based in or near the Central European time zone (CET ± 2 hours).

Nice to have

  • Experience with UI animation and motion design, such as After Effects, Rive or in-engine animation.
  • Experience with multiplayer, live-service or competitive shooter UI, including HUDs, scoreboards, matchmaking, stores and battle passes.
  • Knowledge of console platform UI guidelines.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards for games.
  • Experience running or analysing usability tests.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplined team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using near-real-time insights into the latest malicious actors, relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses. Founded in 2014, Intel 471 provides comprehensive intelligence and monitoring on threat actors. The company’s centralized TITAN platform enables intelligence and security professionals to access structured information, dashboards, timely alerts and intelligence reporting via web portal or API integration.

Our pedigree is unmatched and we count upon a team with experience operating in the intelligence services, military, law enforcement and private threat intelligence companies in nearly every continent on earth.

The Role:

You own the technical depth of our vulnerability intelligence practice. When a new CVE drops, you're the person who determines what's actually true and decides what our customers should do about it.

This is a team lead role where you'll set the technical standard for how we validate, assess, and communicate vulnerability risk. You'll also build and maintain the tooling that lets a small team cover the ever-growing world of vulnerability research.

What You'll Do:

Design, build, and deploy honeypot systems to monitor for exploitation activity. Acquire, test, and validate proof-of-concept exploits in virtual environments to confirm or refute claims about exploitability. Develop practical mitigations for cases where patching is delayed, impossible, or insufficient. These mitigations could include configuration hardening, network segmentation, ACLs, disabling features, or other controls. You'll devise techniques for detecting both attempted and successful exploitation by illuminating the artifacts defenders should hunt for. You'll write vulnerability reports that dive into the details about an exploit such as how it works, who is using it and who is being targeted. Automation is a key component of the role; you will build and maintain the systems we use to streamline vulnerability assessment and automate triage of vulnerability alerts.

Required Qualifications:

Every candidate must be able to:

- Validate and test PoCs to verify the validity of exploitation claims.

- Devise mitigation techniques beyond patching.

- Devise techniques for detecting exploit activity, attempted or successful.

- Write vulnerability reports such as Vulnerability Spotlights.

- Identify new sources of vulnerability intelligence.

- Train and mentor junior team members.

Technical foundation:

- Proficiency with at least one programming language (Python, Go, C/C++, or similar) sufficient to read exploit code, modify PoCs, and build tooling.

- Hands-on fluency with virtual machines, containers, and re-usable lab environments for safe detonation and analysis.

- Solid computer science fundamentals.

- Thorough understanding of computing and internet fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication and authorization models, and how real systems are actually deployed.

- Demonstrated subject-matter-expert-level depth.

- A working bias toward automation.

Strong candidates additionally bring:

- Experience building honeypot or sensor systems to monitor real-world exploitation activity.

- Experience building systems that streamline or automate PoC testing and validation.

- Demonstrated ability to integrate a new intelligence source end-to-end, from evaluation and ingestion to normalization, enrichment and delivery.

Also valuable: original vulnerability research or CVE credits; reverse engineering skills; detection engineering (Sigma, Snort/Suricata, YARA); SOC experience; familiarity with CVSS, CWE, EPSS, and the KEV catalog; public speaking or published writing.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote-friendly culture
  • Wellness programs
  • A variety of professional development opportunities
  • Inclusive culture focused on people, customers and innovation

Our Culture:

The Intel 471 team is constantly growing and is always on the lookout for talented professionals who seek to operate on the forefront of the fight against threat actors impacting our customers and partners. Our culture of humility and quiet professionalism is a core attribute of Intel 471 and everyone within it. Our culture is collaborative, supportive and fast-paced. We're a mission-driven company. We're looking for talented, 'can-do' minded people with a passion for always doing the right thing.

We believe in supporting a progressive culture that allows all our people to be themselves, enjoy exciting opportunities and grow with us. That's why our culture is founded on our core values of openness, inclusion, integrity and client focus, which set the tone for how we work together and treat each other in order to empower us all – and foster a unique team spirit.

Hi, I'm Paul, VP of Engineering at Customer.io. We're looking for a staff product engineer — not a generalist who happens to touch frontend and backend, but someone who thinks like a product owner and ships like an engineer.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

End-to-end ownership

You take on the problems nobody's claimed — the ones that span squads with no obvious owner — and carry them from a fuzzy first conversation to what's actually live. If it touches the customer, it's yours to chase down.

Comfort in ambiguity

Half-formed problems and conflicting signals are your starting material, not a blocker. You define the problem before you solve it, form a point of view on what's worth building, and move without waiting for someone else to de-risk the call.

Customer-first, always

You think from the customer's problem backward, not the codebase forward. Every technical call traces back to what it does for the person on the other end of the message — and you can explain that connection to people who don't write code. Given the choice, you ship the thing that changes their experience, not the thing that's merely elegant.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done"

You retire practices that have outlived their usefulness, including ones you helped build. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

Force multiplication

Shipping your part isn't the bar. You bring in the right people before a problem becomes theirs to clean up, and you leave enough behind — docs, patterns, delegation — that the team keeps moving without you in the room.

What You'll Do

  • Own important, ambiguous problems from initial framing through launch and iteration. Set direction, align partners, and stay accountable for the result.
  • Partner with product, design, and data to shape priorities, scope the work, and define how success will be measured.
  • Lead technical decisions across the stack, including architecture, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Lead work across teams and systems. Build alignment, resolve technical disagreements, and keep complex initiatives moving.
  • Improve engineering practices through mentorship, reusable patterns, and clear technical guidance.
  • Use AI throughout your engineering work, with sound judgment about where it helps, where it falls short, and how its output should be reviewed. Help the team improve by testing new workflows, sharing what works, and identifying useful opportunities for automation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation as required, supporting the systems the team builds.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of leading complex work across teams or systems and delivering meaningful customer, business, or engineering outcomes.
  • Strong backend engineering experience, with the ability to work across the stack and lead end-to-end technical decisions.
  • Strong product and technical judgment, especially when the problem or path forward is unclear.
  • The ability to influence experienced peers and align teams without formal authority.
  • Experience using metrics, experimentation, and observability to guide decisions and improve production systems.
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI across the software development lifecycle, with the judgment to adapt as tools change while remaining accountable for quality, security, and outcomes. Experience improving how a broader team uses AI is a strong plus.

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $200,000 - $280,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. This role also carries a 10% annual bonus target.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. Application - We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.
  2. Recruiter Call (30 mins) - Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Rootstock Capital is building a BTC capital markets business, and we're hiring a small, senior team of two to three people to shape, grow and deliver it. Its first product is an institutional-grade, BTC-denominated investment fund that lets institutional and private Bitcoin holders earn yield and manage credit risk through a mixed portfolio of strategies, bridging traditional institutional demand and Bitcoin-native yield.

As Director of Risk Management, you'll build and lead Rootstock Capital's risk function. You'll own the risk framework across market, credit, counterparty, liquidity, operational and protocol risk, spanning BTC, digital assets and traditional finance, and covering OTC, bilateral and exchange-traded activity. You'll be a founding member of the team, working alongside the VP Fund Management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Risk framework and governance

  • Design and own Rootstock Capital's risk framework: risk appetite; exposure, concentration and leverage limits; liquidity buckets; collateral haircuts; margin and drawdown triggers; and escalation procedures.
  • Take risk policies and limits through board approval, and report regularly to the board and investment committee.
  • Give independent risk sign-off on new strategies, products, venues and counterparties before launch.

Risk modelling and analysis

  • Build the models and analytics that measure market, credit, counterparty, liquidity and protocol risk across traditional and digital positions, including VaR, scenario analysis and stress testing.
  • Stress-test the portfolio against BTC price shocks, liquidity crises, venue or counterparty failure, depeg events, protocol exploits and liquidation cascades.
  • Model and evaluate complex transactions (secured lending, repo, basis and derivatives, structured products) and assess how risks interact and compound across on-chain and off-chain components.
  • Monitor positions and exposures daily, and flag early when outcomes drift from limits or assumptions.

Counterparty and credit risk

  • Lead counterparty, venue and protocol due diligence: creditworthiness, custody arrangements, and smart-contract, bridge, oracle and governance risk.
  • Set and monitor counterparty limits, collateral eligibility and margin terms.

Legal and transaction documentation

  • Review and negotiate the risk terms in fund, OTC and bilateral documents (ISDA/CSA, lending and repo agreements, collateral and margin terms, termination events and close-out provisions) with the Fund Asset Manager and legal counsel.

Operational risk, controls and compliance

  • Design operational risk controls across the trade lifecycle, settlement, reconciliation, custody and treasury that scale with both traditional and digital asset activity.
  • Shape the processes that connect risk, execution and finance across digital and traditional OTC, bilateral and exchange-traded transactions.
  • Work with compliance, legal, the fund administrator and auditors on regulatory obligations, audits and reporting.

Product delivery

  • Work with the Fund Asset Manager and commercial, technology, legal and compliance teams to take new products from idea to launch, making sure they are investable and structurally sound.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Postgraduate degree in Finance, Computer Science or Mathematical Finance, plus a professional qualification in finance or risk (CFA, FRM, PRM or equivalent).
  • 10+ years in risk management at asset managers, funds, banks, trading firms or digital asset businesses, including several years leading a risk function.
  • Deep capital, asset and risk management experience across BTC, digital assets and traditional finance, including DeFi protocol risk.
  • Strong financial modelling and risk analysis skills (stress testing, scenario analysis, VaR) across traditional and digital instruments, with hands-on Python, R or SQL.
  • Hands-on experience designing operational risk controls across the trade lifecycle, custody and treasury for OTC, bilateral and exchange-traded activity.
  • Experience reviewing and negotiating risk terms in fund, OTC and bilateral documents, and working within fund regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Proven leadership of high-performing teams, and the ability to explain complex risk clearly to boards, investors and regulators.

ROOTIES BENEFITS

At RootstockLabs, we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being.
  • 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces.
  • Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days
  • Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually.
  • Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team.

ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS

RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital.

  • What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies
  • Who we work with: Leading custodians, asset managers, and financial institutions

On a typical day you might:

  • Create a new intermediate table in our data lake to simplify the consumption of information;

  • Interact with the Data Scientists to improve the quality of the datasets they use;

  • Improve the data ingestion process, making it more cost-effective;

  • Develop and support a semantic layer for AI-driven data analyses.

Key outcomes for the role:

  • Within 1 month, you have a clear understanding of every step of our data pipeline (from ingestion usage in dashboards);

  • Within 3 months, you have spotted areas of improvements and cut costs or boosted time efficiency by 5%;

  • Within 6 months, you have deployed multiple changes on our data pipeline and can autonomously plan future work;

  • Within 12 months, you fully own our data pipeline and have successfully taken over the responsibilities from our Engineers.

What we offer:

  • Work with our elite engineering team of 15+ experienced engineers

  • A modern tech stack on a massive scale (over 300M gameplays per month across device types from users across the globe)

  • A lot of responsibility and freedom. We hire only experts and trust them to deliver excellent results.

  • Flexible working hours and location. The results are what counts!

  • 1-2 team weeks per year. We pay for flights and accommodation so you can have fun with the team.

  • The opportunity to play games and claim it's work.

Requirements

Reach out if:

  • You want to maintain and improve the infrastructure that collects, stores, and transforms our analytics data, ensuring it stays reliable and cost-efficient (including ingestion, cleanup, summarisation and aggregation of data).

    • Bonus points if you have experiencei in AWS infrastructure and especially Redshift.

About the job

We are seeking an Event Design Coordinator to manage the intake, production, and quality assurance of event-related creative requests coming from a wide range of teams across the business. This is a builder-and-gatekeeper role: you'll work hand-in-hand with designers to turn varied, often fast-turnaround requests into flawless deliverables, including booth graphics, signage, decks, digital assets, swag, and invites, while proactively spotting risks (timeline, brand, print spec, or logistical) before they become problems.

We are not looking for someone who simply routes tickets. We're looking for someone who understands both the creative process and the operational realities of live events well enough to catch a misaligned bleed line, a missing dieline, or a vendor deadline that's about to slip, and to fix it before anyone else notices.

Responsibilities

  • Request Intake & Triage

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for event-related creative requests coming from varied teams across Tether.

    • Scope each request clearly: deliverable type, format (print vs. digital), quantity, deadline, dimension, venue/vendor constraints, and brand requirements.

    Design Collaboration & Project Management

    • Brief designers with complete, unambiguous specs so work is right the first time.

    • Manage multiple concurrent event workstreams across different teams and deadlines without dropping details.

    • Track status across all active requests and proactively surface bottlenecks before they affect the event date.

    Quality Assurance (Print & Digital)

    • Review every designer deliverable before it goes back to the requesting team, checking brand consistency, copy accuracy, resolution, color mode (CMYK vs. RGB), bleed/trim/safe zones, file formats, and platform specs (e.g., booth panel dimensions, social crop ratios, slide aspect ratios).

    • Catch errors that would be costly or embarrassing to fix on-site or post-launch (typos, wrong sizing, low-res exports, broken links, outdated logos).

    • Maintain a QA checklist/process that scales across event types and gets sharper over time.

    Event Documentation & Knowledge Management

    • Document and file all assets, briefs, and final deliverables for each event in a shared drive, using a clear, consistent structure.

    • Organize files so the wider team can easily find past work, reuse assets, and cross-reference specs, timelines, or creative direction from previous events.

    • Keep a running record of vendor details, production specs, and lessons learned per event to speed up planning for future ones.

    Risk & Logistics Ownership

    • Anticipate what can go wrong, such as vendor lead times, print production windows, last-minute scope changes, and shipping delays, and build buffer and contingency plans into every project timeline.

    • Coordinate with vendors and print/production partners as needed to confirm specs and delivery windows.

    • Keep stakeholders across requesting teams and design aligned with clear, proactive status updates rather than reactive fire drills.

    Cross-Team Partnership

    • Act as a trusted liaison between business requesters and the design team, protecting designers' time from ambiguous briefs while protecting requesters from missed deadlines.

    • Continuously improve the intake and review process based on what goes wrong (or almost goes wrong) on each event.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in event marketing, event production, creative operations, or project management with a strong events component.

  • Proven experience managing print and digital production processes; you know what a dieline is, what "safe area" means, and why RGB assets can't go straight to print.

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills: demonstrated ability to manage several concurrent, cross-functional requests with competing deadlines.

  • Sharp attention to detail, comfortable being the last line of defense before a deliverable ships.

  • Experience reviewing and giving actionable feedback on creative work from designers, without needing to be a designer yourself.

  • A proactive, risk-first mindset: you naturally ask "what could go wrong here?" and build a plan around the answer.

  • Experience setting up shared drive structures or asset libraries for teams.

  • Fluent in English and Spanish / Italian is a plus.

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

We’re looking to hire a Senior Frontend Engineer located within Africa to join our fast-growing, fully remote team. You will join our Commercial Pod, the team that owns the systems our commercial business runs on: trade execution, treasury operations, commercial operations, and the internal tooling our operations teams use every day.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will own significant surfaces of our B2B suite and contribute to the shared design system that other pods build on. You will collaborate closely with our Technical Lead, Product Managers, designers, and backend engineers to deliver interfaces that hold up under money-movement scrutiny.

Candidates with experience in FinTech or Crypto products are strongly preferred. We value clear communication, strong ownership, and engineers who are passionate about delivering exceptional user experiences.

Our technology stack includes: Vue 3 (Composition API), TypeScript, Pinia, Vite, Vitest, Storybook, SCSS with Figma-derived design tokens, our internal design system published to AWS CodeArtifact, Node.js, Serverless Framework, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, AWS SQS, SNS, EventBridge, EKS, Valkey, Datadog, GitHub Actions, and more.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of frontend features across the internal tooling products, from design doc through to production and post-release monitoring
  • Build and extend components in our Vue 3 design system, caring about the API surface other engineers consume and not just the pixels
  • Integrate against REST APIs fronting our serverless and EKS services, designing for real-world async behaviour: eventual consistency, retries, idempotent submissions, and partial failure states a user has to understand
  • Instrument what you ship, so frontend work is observable in Datadog and carries correlation IDs through to the backend
  • Write and review design docs, take part in our design doc review sessions, and run Knowledge Sharing Sessions for the wider engineering org
  • Provide clear and concise communication and updates regarding feature development statuses to the team and stakeholders
  • Adhere to internal coding standards, development processes, and design best practices, and help shape them as our engineering standards mature
  • Ensure quality through thorough testing and peer review of your work and the work of cross-functional teams
  • Take part in the Commercial dev support rota, roughly once every five weeks
  • Embrace and demonstrate our values: humility, creativity, and independence
  • Write and maintain clean, maintainable, and well-tested code for the future (and present) of the company’s platform

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience as a Frontend Engineer (full-stack experience is a plus but not required)
  • Expert-level proficiency with Vue 3, the Composition API, and TypeScript. Strong React or Svelte engineers who can make a credible case for picking up Vue 3 quickly will be considered
  • Deep understanding of modern JavaScript, component-based architecture, and state management patterns such as Pinia
  • Strong experience with modern CSS and SCSS, token-based styling, responsive design, and cross-browser compatibility
  • Proven experience building and optimising scalable, high-performance UIs, including data-dense surfaces such as tables, dashboards, and forms with hard validation rules
  • Real experience building or maintaining a shared component library or design system, including versioning, breaking changes, and consumer migration paths
  • Strong experience working with RESTful APIs and integration patterns, and comfort reasoning about distributed backends and failure
  • Solid understanding of frontend application security, including XSS, CSRF, content security policies, and secure client-side data handling
  • Experience working with AWS, especially in contexts relevant to frontend (CloudFront, S3, Cognito, CodeArtifact)
  • Experience with testing tools such as Vitest, Jest, Vue Test Utils, Cypress, or Playwright, and with Storybook for component development

What Would Make You Stand Out

  • Experience in FinTech, Crypto, or other highly regulated environments, especially anything involving FX rates, trading, or money movement
  • Exposure to African markets or other multi-currency, multi-regulator environments
  • Knowledge of serverless architectures and how frontend apps interact with them
  • Familiarity with performance monitoring and observability tools, particularly Datadog RUM, logs, and traces
  • Understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA) and best practices
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for frontend deployments, and with automated release tooling such as release-please and Conventional Commits
  • Experience deprecating and migrating off a legacy frontend without freezing product delivery
  • Practical use of AI coding tools in your daily workflow

Team

  • Exude your upbeat energy and enthusiasm every day to motivate your team to be the best they can be in every aspect of what they do
  • Celebrate the success of others by recognising the contributions of committed team members and their achievements
  • Clear and accurate written and verbal communication is a must
  • Collaborate with your peers to collectively think of innovative ideas that drive business through technology
  • Build and utilise working relationships with internal business partners across the organisation and external business contacts
  • Keen interest in learning and sharing current trends and advancements in modern web and back-end frameworks

What We Offer

  • Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive compensation and meaningful health coverage, and all full-time employees are participants in our stock option plan.
  • Learning & Development: Access to resources, support, and autonomy to grow professionally.
  • Remote-First Flexibility: We embrace a fully remote work environment.
  • Mental Health Support Services: Your mental well-being matters to us.
  • Global & Diverse Team: You will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals from 24+ countries across the world, in a multicultural and collaborative environment.
  • Global Impact: You’ll be part of a team shaping the future of global FinTech and stablecoin accessibility.

Ready to Join Us?

Are you up for the challenge? Apply today and be part of shaping the future of FinTech. Let's innovate, disrupt, and lead together!

jobs.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.

You will:

- Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
- Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
- Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
- Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
- Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

Requirements

  • Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.

  • Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.

  • Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.

  • Experience working with a remote team

  • Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.

  • Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Our Professional Services team partners closely with customers to solve complex engineering and knowledge-management challenges. jobs.excerpt: Team: Growth, part of the Revenue organization · Reports to: Director of Growth · Location: Remote Who we areTime Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance.
jobs.description:
Team: Growth, part of the Revenue organization · Reports to: Director of Growth · Location: Remote

Who we are

Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organizations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. We built a durable business on customer revenue rather than venture capital, and we are now focused on growing it.

About the role

We're looking for a Growth Product Manager to drive product-led growth across the customer lifecycle: acquisition, conversion, retention and expansion. You'll sit in our Revenue organization and own the product levers behind our self-serve motion, with an impact that reaches across the wider customer base.

This is a product management role with a growth focus. You'll work with the leadership team to set measurable goals, build and run the growth roadmap, and work closely with engineering, design and data to ship experiments and product changes that move revenue metrics.

What you'll do

  • Partner with the Director of Growth and Chief Revenue Officer to shape the growth strategy, and translate it into clear priorities and plans.

  • Own the growth roadmap and the metrics it is meant to move, from conversion through to retention and expansion.

  • Identify and prioritize high-impact growth opportunities using product data, funnel analysis and user insight.

  • Design, run and analyze A/B tests and other experiments, and turn the results into clear decisions.

  • Use LLMs and AI tools to prototype and demo ideas quickly, then write clear product requirements and partner with engineering and design to take initiatives from discovery through launch and post-release optimization.

  • Define, track and report on growth KPIs, explaining what is driving movement and what it means for priorities.

  • Bring a point of view on the biggest opportunities across the customer lifecycle, from conversion through to retention and expansion, and make the case for larger bets backed by evidence.

  • Collaborate across product, engineering, design, data, marketing and customer-facing teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

What success looks like

  • Clear ownership of growth metrics. Core KPIs across conversion, retention and expansion have agreed definitions and a regular reporting rhythm, and you can explain not just how they moved but why.

  • A disciplined experimentation program. Experiments run on a steady cadence, each with a clear hypothesis, success criteria and a documented readout that leads to a decision.

  • Reliable delivery. You consistently ship what you commit to and keep stakeholders aligned along the way.

  • Evidence-backed bets. You make the case for larger bets, take them through to delivery, and measure their impact against what was predicted, including the misses.

  • Measurable business impact. Improvements in conversion, retention and expansion can be traced to the work you led.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Product management experience in B2B SaaS, with a focus on growth.

  • A proven track record in a product-led growth or self-serve organization, owning KPIs such as trial-to-paid conversion, retention and expansion.

  • Hands-on experience designing A/B tests and iterating based on what you learn.

  • Strong analytical skills: you can define KPIs, analyze funnels, and turn data into a clear recommendation.

  • Experience with product analytics tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar.

  • Clear written communication, from product requirements to stakeholder updates.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and designers, and leading cross-functional work through influence.

  • Fluency with AI tools and LLMs, including using them to prototype and demo ideas quickly, and a habit of using them in day-to-day product work: research, analysis, specs and delivery.


Our values

Time Doctor is fully remote and async-first. Three values shape how we work, and they matter even more in a role that sits across so many teams.

  • Remote Rockstar. You thrive in a remote setting. You communicate clearly in writing, keep your work visible, and stay focused and productive without an office around you, so the team stays aligned across time zones.

  • Self-guided Missile. In a remote team, work only keeps moving when people can drive it themselves. You set direction, make decisions with the information you have, and push initiatives forward without waiting to be told.

  • Teamwork Titan. Growth depends on product, engineering, design, data and revenue teams pulling together. You build strong partnerships, share context and credit, and bring people along to deliver results as one team.


Why this role

  • You own the product levers behind our self-serve motion, with a direct line from your work to revenue.

  • You shape the growth strategy with the Director of Growth and the Chief Revenue Officer, not just execute it.

  • You work AI-first, on a team where prototyping, analysis and specs with LLMs are already part of how product work gets done.

  • We are profitable and bootstrapped. Your budget comes from customers, not from a burn rate.

  • Fully remote and flexible, working with talented people in 30+ countries.


Our hiring approach

Because experimentation and AI are core to this role, our process asks you to show us real work rather than describe it. Expect to walk us through a growth experiment you designed, what you learned and the decision it led to, and how you have used AI tools to prototype, analyze or ship product work faster.

This is a full-time, 100% remote role. We are an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability.

We hire globally. Our Talent Attraction team will walk you through the details during your first conversation.

jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

Auto insurance on paid social is one of our highest-potential channels and you would own it end to end taking it to the next level.

This is a hands-on seat. You are in Ads Manager daily, pulling your own numbers, setting the testing agenda with the creative team, and staying with a test through launch, read, and post-mortem. If you are looking to hand a strategy deck to someone else to execute, this is not it.

The honest trade: the channel has proven scale and a real ceiling. Creative fatigues fast, attribution is noisy, and regulation reshapes what you can say and where you can send traffic. Those problems are yours. Nobody is going to solve them above you.

Why This Seat

You own a vertical, not a slice. Meta and TikTok spend for auto insurance, end to end, from budget and bid strategy to the creative roadmap to live margin performance. One owner, and it is you.

Margin is the metric. Not impressions, not a ROAS number handed down without context. You decide when to push into a lower ROAS for contribution dollars and when to pull back, and you are trusted to make that call.

The mandate is scale, not maintenance. The plan is to grow this channel to roughly 2.5x its current monthly spend without giving up margin. That is the job. If you want a channel that is already solved, this is the wrong one.

The interesting part is unsolved. Creative fatigue cycles, attribution noise, and compliance constraints on a vertical with real headroom. You will not be maintaining someone else's playbook. You will be writing the one the rest of the team runs.

Short line to the people who decide. You work directly with the Senior Director who owns paid marketing, the GM of Auto Insurance, compliance, and product. No layers to route a recommendation through.

Profitable and bootstrapped. Spend decisions here get made on margin, not against a burn plan set by someone else's timeline.

What You'll Bring

  • Paid social bought at scale in performance marketing, affiliate, or leadgen. Not brand work and not agency-of-record media planning.
  • Deep hands-on Meta expertise: campaign structure, bid and budget strategy, audience and placement testing, and diagnosing a performance shift caused by a platform or attribution change rather than by your campaigns.
  • Real TikTok scale, not test budgets. You have managed meaningful spend through allowlisting, vertical restrictions, and landing page requirements.
  • Direct accountability for CPA, ROAS, or contribution margin on monthly spend of $250,000 or more.
  • Experience in a compliance-heavy vertical such as insurance, lending, credit, or health, where creative and landing page claims are constrained.
  • Fluency with tracking and attribution: pixel and server-side event setup, postbacks, conversion QA, and the judgment to spot when the data is lying to you.
  • Four or more years in a hands-on, in-the-weeds buying role with direct margin accountability.

How we work, and what we look for in how you work:

  • Focus and Win. You start from the P&L and the metric, not the tactic, and you are relentless about why performance moved. You do not stop at the first explanation.
  • Better Every Day. You seek feedback and turn it into visible change, and you write down what you learn so the next buyer does not relearn it.
  • Stronger Together. You brief the creative team clearly, give specific feedback, and treat them as partners in the testing agenda rather than a request queue. You surface a problem early with a recommendation attached instead of waiting to be asked.
  • Embrace Change. When a platform policy or a compliance constraint moves, you find the compliant path to scale rather than stopping at no.

Nice to Have

  • Auto insurance, or another regulated leadgen domain
  • Advertorial or direct-response landing page funnels and conversion rate testing
  • Working knowledge of AI creative generation tooling
  • Familiarity with Looker

What You'll Own

  • Meta and TikTok spend for auto insurance, end to end, with measurable margin impact. You have a teammate on the buying team who can support execution when volume calls for it, and the ownership stays with you.
  • Pacing and margin targets, including the judgment call on when lower ROAS is the right trade for contribution dollars.
  • The creative testing roadmap, built with the Creative Strategist and the creative team and turned into shipped concepts at high velocity.
  • A documented, repeatable playbook other buyers on the team can run.
  • Direct relationships with Meta and TikTok reps, and the allowlisting, beta access, and escalation paths a restricted vertical depends on.
  • The working partnership with the GM of Auto Insurance, compliance, and product on funnel, landing page, and offer strategy.

What Great Looks Like

By the end of your first year:

Security Engineer

Overview: Supply Chain Security and Compliance

The Security Engineer is a critical role responsible for implementing and enforcing robust security practices across our entire integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. You will safeguard e-commerce transactions, secure internal tool integrations, and establish the trust framework for our AI agent operations, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards like PCI-DSS and GDPR.

Internship Details

  • Duration: 3 months (extendable based on performance and project scope)

  • Start Date: Immediate

  • Location: Remote

  • Stipend: Unpaid initially; may convert to a paid internship, full-time role, or even direct client absorption (FTE) based on your performance

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will secure all layers of the application, from the Next.js frontend to the NestJS modular monolith and the cloud infrastructure.

  • Security Architecture & Threat Modeling: Perform vulnerability assessments, code reviews, and threat modeling for all new features and systems, focusing on the critical MES $\rightarrow$ WMS $\rightarrow$ OMS business process flow.

  • Compliance Enforcement: Lead the implementation and auditing of security controls necessary for PCI-DSS compliance (for Payment module) and GDPR compliance (for user/tenant data handling).

  • Access Control & Authentication: Implement and manage secure API authentication methods, including OAuth 2.0 and SAML, utilizing Authentik/Ory Kratos and leveraging PostgreSQL's Row-Level Security (RLS) for tenant isolation.

  • Secrets & Encryption: Manage secrets and key rotation using Vault, define and enforce encryption protocols for data both in transit and at rest, and manage certificates via Traefik.

  • Abuse Prevention: Implement and monitor controls for API rate limiting, Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, and traffic monitoring to prevent abuse and denial-of-service attacks.

  • Incident Response: Develop and practice incident investigation and response protocols. Conduct security awareness training for development and operations teams.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess hands-on security experience with our core stack and compliance tools:

  • Platform Security: Node.js/NestJS security best practices, Next.js/React security, PostgreSQL RLS.

  • Compliance Focus: Experience with PCI-DSS and GDPR controls and auditing.

  • Authentication & Access: OAuth 2.0, SAML, JWT, Authentik/Ory Kratos.

  • Secrets & Infrastructure: HashiCorp Vault, Docker, Terraform.

  • Monitoring & Assessment: Tools for Static/Dynamic Application Security Testing (SAST/DAST).

AI Agent Security

You will be responsible for securing the emerging AI ecosystem.

  • Agent Trust Framework: Establish security boundaries for the AI agent interfaces, ensuring agents (built with LangChain/AutoGen) operate within strict permissions when accessing supply chain data (WMS, OMS).

  • Prompt Injection Prevention: Implement validation and sanitization techniques to mitigate prompt injection and data exfiltration risks in user-facing LLM interactions.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Security Scorecard: Reduction in identified vulnerabilities from assessments and code reviews (SAST/DAST).

  • Compliance Audits: Successful passing of regular PCI-DSS and GDPR audits.

  • Incident Handling: Speed and effectiveness of security incident investigation and remediation.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Solution Architect or Head of Technology, working closely with the development and DevOps teams to embed security into the CI/CD pipeline.

jobs.excerpt: Hi, I'm Brian, Senior Director of Engineering at Customer.
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Brian, Senior Director of Engineering at Customer.io. We're looking for experienced engineers who want to own a channel end to end — from the infrastructure that delivers billions of messages reliably, to the product surfaces our customers use to build, send, and analyze their campaigns. You'll work across the stack, bringing both systems thinking and product craft to one of the most technically rich problem spaces in the industry.

You don't need email experience to apply. We can teach you the email domain. The engineers who thrive here are the ones who love learning a deep problem space, not only the ones who arrive already knowing it.

About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive.

We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. Under the hood: Go, React, Ember and AI help us ship fast and scale with confidence.

What We Value

Ownership You own problems end to end. You move fast, act like an owner, and thrive in ambiguity. You've led complex projects before, whether officially or not, and you're ready to do it again.

Engineers with product taste You think like a user, not just an engineer. You care how your systems power real customer value — and how to make them better.

A healthy skepticism for "the way things are done" You bring rigor and creativity. Best practices matter — but never more than forward motion.

What You'll Do

  • Build and evolve the frontend experiences customers use to create, preview, and analyze campaigns — editors, configuration, and analytics dashboards
  • Design and scale backend systems that process high volumes of messages and events: queue management, retry logic, rate limiting, and real-time event pipelines
  • Build automated systems that respond intelligently to feedback signals from external providers — classification, suppression, throttling, and health scoring
  • Partner with in-house domain experts to turn their knowledge into automated tooling — you bring the systems skills, they bring the email depth
  • Instrument and monitor channel health end to end: signal detection, anomaly alerting, and observability
  • Own problems end to end — from architecture and schema design to testing, deployment, and monitoring
  • Share knowledge and raise the bar through short videos, thoughtful writing, and mentorship
  • Use AI agents to make multi-file changes by scoping the work, writing the prompt, and verifying the output

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience building scalable, distributed systems in Go (or similar statically typed languages)
  • Experience building product-facing frontend features in React or similar frameworks, with attention to UX quality and polish
  • Experience building or consuming APIs that handle high-throughput async workloads — event streams, queues, and systems that degrade gracefully under load
  • Comfort integrating with external systems you don't control — third-party APIs, rate limits, opaque failure modes — and designing for resilience around them
  • Comfort working in cloud-native environments (AWS, GCP)
  • Familiarity with relational databases (we use MySQL primarily) and an understanding of performance tradeoffs
  • Experience with observability tooling and operating production systems
  • A bias for action over perfection, and pride in owning technical decisions

Nice to have: Familiarity with email infrastructure — deliverability, authentication standards (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), sender reputation, or high-volume sending

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions — just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • Application — We review everyone with care. Tell us why you're interested.
  • Recruiter Call (30 mins) — Let's chat about what you're looking for and how we work.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins) - Talk with one of our hiring managers about your working style and a project you've owned end-to-end, plus a short AI-assisted coding exercise.
  • Technical Interview (60 mins) — A collaborative system design conversation focused on scaling challenges.
  • Take-Home Assignment — Complete a short, realistic task similar to what you'd work on here.
  • Assignment Review Call (60 mins) — Walk us through your work and discuss tradeoffs, priorities, and how you'd iterate.
  • Project Deep Dive (60 minutes: A focused conversation on a technical project you've owned end-to-end, and how you balance planned work against urgent, customer-impacting issues.

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Join us!

This position is responsible for protecting Bio-Rad’s data and cloud estate and for leading high-severity security incident response outside US hours. jobs.description:
Credit Decision Scientist

CRNCY · Senior · Remote · USD contractor

Why this work matters

Across the developing world, access to credit still depends on paperwork most people can't produce. A teacher six years in the same job. A vendor who has run the same stall for a decade. Creditworthy, both — and illegible to a system built for someone else.

CRNCY exists to close that gap, using technology to open doors for the people who need them most. Every rule you write here decides who gets through.

Mission

Help CRNCY become the world's best underwriter of credit risk using unstructured and alternative data. We operate in markets where customers often have limited traditional credit information. Our objective is to make better lending decisions under uncertainty and continuously improve risk-adjusted profitability.

What You'll Do

•Analyze portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability through credit strategy.

•Model the probability of repayment, default and fraud from incomplete and alternative data, and build the statistical inference behind it.

•Turn that analysis into the credit rules themselves: approval strategy, underwriting requirements, first-loan sizing and customer segmentation.

•Optimize underwriting requirements and reduce unnecessary customer friction.

•Design and assess experiments to improve lending outcomes.

•Quantify trade-offs between growth, risk, customer experience and profitability.

•Translate analysis into practical underwriting and portfolio recommendations.

You do this work yourself. There is no analytics team to delegate to. You frame the question, build the analysis, and own the decision that comes out of it.

What We're Looking For

Experience in at least one of: portfolio strategy or analytics, underwriting strategy, lending strategy, risk management, or another analytical role involving high-consequence decision-making under uncertainty.

Experience in consumer lending or credit is not required. We are far more interested in exceptional decision-makers than in experience in any particular industry.

We are interested in candidates who have:

•Used data and probabilistic reasoning to make or influence important business decisions.

•Evaluated trade-offs between competing objectives under uncertainty.

•Applied analytical judgment rather than relying solely on predefined rules or models.

•Translated analysis into practical business decisions and recommendations.

•Been accountable for the business outcomes of those decisions, not simply the quality of the analysis.

Working capability, hands-on: statistical inference and probability; causal reasoning and selection bias; practical modeling — logistic regression, scorecards, gradient boosting — with clean validation discipline and no data leakage; experiment design and power; expected-value analysis; segmentation. Python and SQL at analysis-and-modeling level. You write your own code.

Required Academic Background

A degree from a strong university in a quantitative discipline: Decision Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, or Computer Science with significant quantitative coursework.

Your training should have covered probability and statistics, decision-making under uncertainty, optimization, mathematical modeling, econometrics, operations research or risk analysis.

Above all, we are looking for someone who naturally thinks probabilistically — comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, weighing uncertainty, and updating their judgment as new evidence becomes available.

Language: fluent English and Spanish. Both required.

What This Role Is Not

This is not:

•A Machine Learning Engineer role

•A Data Engineering role

•An AI Infrastructure role

•A Machine Learning Research role

•A traditional Data Scientist role focused primarily on model development

Candidates whose experience is primarily centered on building models, pipelines, platforms or technical infrastructure will not be considered.

What we are screening out is the candidate whose output is a model. Here, the output is a decision — you simply have to build the analysis yourself to get there.

How We Work

•Honest and direct. Feedback here is unvarnished and immediate. You'll get it, and we expect it back.

•Unafraid to fail. Most of what you test won't work. We would rather run the experiment and find out than defend a rule nobody has questioned.

•Committed to excellence. High standards, applied to ourselves before anyone else.

•Dedicated to the customer. The person on the other side of the decision is the reason the work matters.

The Setup

•USD contractor. Fully remote, location-flexible, with meaningful daily overlap with the Americas.

•You'll work directly with our credit and finance leadership and with the founder. Short path from analysis to decision.

•Real ownership from day one, across multiple markets.

At Miaplaza, we build homeschool platforms that kids aged 4–18 actually want to use — Miacademy, MiaPrep, and our Online High School are serving over 150.000 students today. Our product foundations are strong. What we want next is a step change in how our products feel: more expressive illustration, more purposeful motion, more moments of craft that turn a lesson into something a kid remembers.

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer whose craft anchor is illustration and motion. Our design team is small and senior, five designers when you join, and each brings a distinct strength: brand, design systems, research, and now yours

The role

You'd own product design for the student learning experience end-to-end: from problem framing through delivery, in a Product Trio with a PM and EM who have strong opinions and expect yours. This is product work with real trade-offs — pedagogical, technical, and business — and you're accountable for how it lands, not just how it looks.

Beyond Curriculum, you'd set the illustration and motion bar for all of Miaplaza: the standards, motion principles, and character direction that the other designers and the design system build from.

A defining part of the role is art-directing AI-assisted production. You'd build the prompts, references, and review process that let a small team produce quality illustration and motion at a scale hand-crafting alone can't reach. We don't expect you to know every current tool — we expect the taste and judgment to direct output rather than accept defaults.

You'd report to the Head of UX, with regular 1:1s covering craft, product, and career growth. The direction is upward: deeper craft leadership, cross-product influence, or both.

Requirements

You must have all of these to be considered:

  • A portfolio of shipped digital product work — not only concepts or standalone pieces

  • At least 2 years working inside a product team, collaborating with PMs and engineers

  • Strong illustration or motion skills, with at least 1 year focused on either as a primary craft

  • Proficiency in Figma

  • Some experience directing or guiding visual work produced by others — freelancers, junior designers, or AI tools

You’ll stand out if you also have:

  • Deep motion skills in product contexts: interactions, transitions, onboarding, character animation

  • Experience using AI image or motion tools as production accelerators

  • Confidence running your own usability research, not just receiving findings

  • Multi-brand or education-focused design experience

  • Accessibility practice, especially for neurodivergent audiences

This probably isn’t right for you if:

  • Your work hasn't yet lived inside a live product with real constraints

  • You prefer well-scoped tasks over shaping ambiguous problems

  • You see AI tools as either a threat to craft or a shortcut around it

Our hiring process

As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us.

  1. Application and eligibility check — work authorization, timezone, availability

  2. Async assessment — 12 scenario-based, multiple-choice questions (~30 min) + when qualifying; 3 open questions (max. 45 min)

    1. If you pass the multiple choice section, you will asked to complete 3 open written questions (max. 45 min)

  3. Portfolio review — the design team will review your best work and thinking

  4. Behavioral interview — a conversation with our People team about how you work

  5. Take-home design task — ~60 minutes, scoped for this role, AI tools encouraged

  6. Hiring team interview — with a design team member and the Head of UX

  7. Skip-level conversation — with executive leadership

  8. Reference checks

We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don't want to make yours harder.

Compensation and setup

The pay range for this role is €60,000 - 90,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area.

Miaplaza is a growing, self-funded EdTech company. We're an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need accommodations at any point in the process, just let us know.

About us

Founded in 1996, Argos Multilingual is a global provider of technology-enabled language, AI and data solutions. We combine human expertise, technology and AI to help organisations communicate, operate and grow across markets.

We work with some of the world’s most recognised companies, from global technology leaders and e-commerce innovators to major organisations in life sciences and manufacturing.

We are an international organisation with 400+ people across 42 countries. We continue to expand our capabilities in AI and data alongside our established language and localisation expertise, building on a strong foundation while embracing the opportunities created by new technology.

About the role

The Sourcing Specialist is responsible for identifying, attracting, qualifying, and onboarding freelance contributors to support AI data and annotation projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring the business has access to a scalable, diverse, and project-ready workforce capable of meeting evolving client and operational demands.

Working closely with the Engagement Team, Project Managers, and Operations stakeholders, the Sourcing Specialist will build and maintain talent pipelines, manage candidate onboarding activities, and ensure newly sourced contributors’ transition smoothly into the active workforce community.

The ideal candidate will have experience in talent sourcing, recruitment operations, crowdsourcing, or freelancer management and be comfortable operating in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.

What you'll do

Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development

  • Develop and maintain qualified talent pipelines to support current and future project requirements.
  • Source freelance contributors across multiple channels, including job boards, social media platforms, freelancer marketplaces, referrals, and sourcing databases.
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for a variety of AI data services, including annotation, transcription, evaluation, search relevance, content moderation, data collection, and linguistic projects.
  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies to support project-specific hiring requirements.
  • Identify and engage candidates with specialised skills, languages, demographics, or subject matter expertise.
  • Monitor sourcing performance and recommend new channels to improve workforce acquisition outcomes.
  • Support large-scale recruitment and workforce expansion initiatives.

Candidate Qualification & Assessment

  • Ensure candidates meet project requirements and quality standards before onboarding.
  • Conduct candidate screening and qualification activities.
  • Review applications, assess suitability, and verify eligibility requirements.
  • Schedule assessments, qualification tests, and screening activities.
  • Evaluate candidate skills and experience against project requirements.
  • Coordinate with Project Managers and Operational teams regarding qualification criteria.
  • Manage candidate progression through the sourcing and onboarding pipeline.
  • Ensure candidates receive a positive and professional experience throughout the recruitment process.

Onboarding & Workforce Preparation

  • Support the successful onboarding of new contributors into the workforce community.
  • Coordinate onboarding activities for newly approved contributors.
  • Prepare onboarding documentation, contracts, and project-related requirements.
  • Ensure all required compliance, documentation, and account creation activities are completed.
  • Guide contributors through onboarding platforms and project readiness processes.
  • Work closely with the Engagement Team & Project Management Team to ensure seamless handover following onboarding.
  • Maintain onboarding trackers and ensure workforce readiness targets are achieved.
  • Support onboarding for new projects, programme launches, and workforce ramp-ups.

Workforce Operations & Administration

  • Maintain accurate sourcing records and operational systems.
  • Manage candidate records and maintain data accuracy across sourcing platforms.
  • Administer and update Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and workforce databases.
  • Maintain vendor portals and workforce management platforms.
  • Process contracts, agreements, and documentation as required.
  • Produce regular sourcing and pipeline reports for stakeholders.
  • Ensure sourcing activities adhere to company policies, compliance requirements, and data protection standards.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Owner Relations Team Lead to lead our Owner Relations Specialists across Latin America. This role is responsible for overseeing the team's daily activities, ensuring excellent owner communication, managing escalations, and maintaining high standards of service and accountability.

The ideal candidate is a strong leader with excellent communication and problem-solving skills, experience managing client relationships, and the ability to coordinate effectively with multiple departments to ensure owner satisfaction and retention.

Goal of the Position

To lead and develop the Owner Relations team, ensuring timely communication, effective resolution of owner concerns, consistent service standards, and strong long-term relationships with property owners across LATAM.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, supervise, and support the Owner Relations Specialists, ensuring clear priorities, accountability, and consistent performance.
  • Monitor team productivity, response times, resolution times, and other established KPIs.
  • Ensure owners receive timely, professional, and proactive communication regarding their properties, requests, and concerns.
  • Oversee owner inquiries and escalations, ensuring issues are followed up on and resolved efficiently.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with property owners to improve satisfaction, trust, and retention.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Accounting, Revenue Management, and other departments to resolve owner concerns and improve service delivery.
  • Identify recurring issues, communication gaps, and potential risks to owner satisfaction, implementing corrective actions when needed.
  • Conduct regular team check-ins, provide feedback, and support team members' professional development.
  • Establish and improve processes, communication standards, and follow-up procedures across LATAM markets.
  • Ensure owner requests, conversations, and outstanding issues are accurately documented and tracked in the company's systems.
  • Prepare regular reports on team performance, owner feedback, escalations, and operational challenges.
  • Identify opportunities to improve owner engagement, service quality, operational efficiency, and owner retention.
  • Provide management with updates on team performance, significant owner concerns, and recommended improvements.

Performance Goals (KPIs)

  • Owner Satisfaction: Maintain strong owner satisfaction and address negative feedback promptly.
  • Response Time: Ensure owner inquiries receive timely responses in line with established service standards.
  • Resolution Time: Ensure owner concerns and requests are resolved or appropriately escalated within agreed timelines.
  • Escalation Management: Monitor outstanding cases and ensure effective follow-up until resolution.
  • Owner Retention: Proactively identify and address owner dissatisfaction and potential retention risks.
  • Team Performance: Ensure Owner Relations Specialists meet their individual targets and service expectations.

  • Previous experience in team leadership, account management, customer success, client relations, property management, or hospitality.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong relationship management, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Experience handling escalations and coordinating solutions across multiple departments.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience tracking KPIs, preparing reports, and monitoring team performance.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented, and comfortable making decisions within established guidelines.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced, multicultural environment.
  • Professional proficiency in English and Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms, project management tools, and property management systems is an advantage.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate is a proactive and accountable leader who can motivate a team, build trust with property owners, and ensure that requests and concerns are handled efficiently. They should be comfortable managing escalations, analyzing performance, improving processes, and collaborating with different departments to achieve operational goals.

Success in this role means having a well-organized and high-performing Owner Relations team, satisfied property owners, timely issue resolution, and consistent service standards across Corporate Stays' LATAM operations.
