jobs.title: Transportation Logistics Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for an experienced Transportation Logistics Specialist to manage the full scope of IT hardware logistics across the APAC region — including racks, servers, GPUs, and other data center equipment. The role focuses on air freight and road transport across APAC, with a primary emphasis on shipments originating from or transiting through Taiwan, and deliveries into key APAC markets including Singapore, India, South Korea, Japan, Malaysia, and additional destinations as the business expands.

You will be responsible for day-to-day execution of inbound and outbound shipments, RMA and RMS flows, cross-border customs coordination, and inter-facility transfers within the region. This is a hands-on, operationally focused role requiring deep knowledge of APAC freight markets, strong carrier and forwarder relationships, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced, global environment.

Key Responsibilities

Logistics Operations

  • Manage end-to-end transport of IT hardware — rack systems, servers, GPUs, and other data center equipment — across all APAC lanes, including inbound shipments from Taiwan, inter-regional moves, and outbound flows as required.
  • Coordinate air freight and road transport scheduling, carrier and freight forwarder selection, and delivery execution to ensure on-time, damage-free arrival at APAC data center sites.
  • Handle all RMA and RMS shipments within the APAC region, including coordination with vendors, carriers, and internal teams to ensure accurate and timely processing.
  • Manage equipment transfers between company warehouses and data center facilities across the region, optimising routes and minimising handling risk.
  • Maintain full visibility over active shipments across all APAC lanes and proactively resolve transit issues, delays, or exceptions.
  • Develop contingency plans and alternative routing strategies to ensure business continuity.
  • Manage time-critical air freight shipments where required, including carrier selection, booking, and end-to-end tracking to ensure expedited delivery of hardware.

Coordination & Documentation

  • Coordinate closely with data center operations teams across APAC to support staging, buffering, and just-in-time hardware deployment.
  • Maintain accurate in-transit inventory records and ensure proper chain-of-custody documentation for all shipments.
  • Manage all shipment-related documentation in relevant systems (Jira, TMS, or equivalent), ensuring records are complete, accurate, and audit-ready.
  • Manage customs documentation and clearance processes for all cross-border shipments within APAC, including imports into Singapore, India, South Korea, Japan, and Malaysia.
  • Process and reconcile logistics invoices; manage payments for transportation operations, including ZIP payments to the appropriate vendors and partners.
  • Work with the security team to establish and maintain secure shipment protocols for high-value hardware across the region.

Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure all shipments comply with applicable regulations across APAC jurisdictions, including country-specific import/export requirements, customs procedures, and trade compliance obligations.
  • Manage duties, taxes, and customs declarations for inbound and outbound shipments across the region, ensuring correct classification and valuation of high-value IT hardware.
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation for all logistics activities, supporting internal (SOX) and external compliance requirements.
  • Establish and enforce SLAs and KPIs with freight carriers, forwarders, and 3PL partners; drive accountability through regular performance reviews.
  • Identify and escalate compliance gaps or process deviations, implementing corrective actions as needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with hardware engineering, procurement, finance, and data center operations to align APAC logistics execution with deployment timelines and business priorities.
  • Collaborate with OEM suppliers based in Taiwan to coordinate international shipping windows, batch tracking, customs documentation, and inbound scheduling into APAC facilities.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for transport-related issues across the APAC region.
  • Work closely with the global transport team to ensure regional operations align with global standards, processes, and reporting requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives through KPI tracking, root cause analysis, and process standardisation.

Planning & Cost Management

  • Forecast transportation demand across APAC based on data center expansion plans, hardware deployment schedules, and capacity needs.
  • Identify cost optimisation opportunities through carrier consolidation, routing improvements, and smarter scheduling across APAC lanes.
  • Track and report on regional logistics costs, flagging variances and recommending corrective actions.
  • Support data-driven decision-making through regular reporting, dashboards, and operational analytics.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in transportation, freight, or logistics management, with a strong focus on international shipping within the APAC region.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of APAC freight markets, air freight lanes, and road transport operations — particularly routes involving Taiwan, Singapore, India, South Korea, Japan, and Malaysia.
  • Proven experience managing high-value, time-critical IT hardware shipments — server racks, GPUs, data center equipment, or similar cargo.
  • Strong understanding of customs regulations, import/export procedures, and trade compliance across multiple APAC jurisdictions.
  • Experience managing and negotiating with carriers, freight forwarders, and 3PL partners across the APAC region.
  • Hands-on experience with RMA/RMS shipment processes and reverse logistics flows.
  • Familiarity with TMS platforms, Jira, or similar systems used for shipment tracking and documentation.
  • Excellent organisational and documentation skills with a high standard for accuracy and completeness.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to work cross-functionally across technical and non-technical teams in a global environment.
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to operate independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.
  • Based in the APAC region; Singapore, India, or South Korea preferred. Must be eligible to work in the country of residence.
  • Fluency in English required; additional Asian languages (Mandarin, Korean, Hindi, or similar) are a strong advantage.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a hyperscaler, cloud provider, or large-scale data center build-out environment.
  • Familiarity with ATA Carnet processes and temporary import/export mechanisms for repair and return shipments.
  • Experience with Taiwan-origin shipments and familiarity with Taiwanese export procedures and OEM supplier logistics coordination.
  • Background in supply chain analytics, reporting, or continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Familiarity with physical security protocols for high-value hardware shipments.
  • Experience supporting logistics operations across emerging APAC markets such as Indonesia, Vietnam, or Thailand.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Independent Consultancy - Technical Planning and Coordination
jobs.excerpt: Terms of Reference: Independent Consultancy - Technical Planning and Coordination for the Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA) Background:The Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA) is an open energy data partnership between the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA), Ember, Global Energy Monitor (GEM), Open Energy Transition (OET), and TransitionZero.
jobs.description:
Terms of Reference: Independent Consultancy - Technical Planning and Coordination for the Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA)

Background:The Open Energy Research and Analytics Consortium (ORA) is an open energy data partnership between the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air (CREA), Ember, Global Energy Monitor (GEM), Open Energy Transition (OET), and TransitionZero. Through a shared governance structure and a Secretariat currently housed at GEM, the consortium is working to build an open energy intelligence system based on trusted data, open-source tools, and collaborative analysis.

ORA’s members have already developed the expertise to build every component needed for a shared open data infrastructure as well as reproducible modeling, data pipelines, versioned and citable data, quality metadata, exploration tools, and aggregate data for validation. These components have not yet been coordinated in a cohesive system, and many of the ORA organizations have built similar supporting infrastructure separately. This leaves users and partners to repeatedly reconcile definitions, identifiers, formats, and methodologies, which limits interoperability, auditability, and reuse. The growing use of AI systems for energy questions adds urgency: the standardization, versioning, and source documentation needed to integrate data across ORA are also needed to make open, verified, citable data legible to AI systems.

ORA is entering a 12-month foundational phase to turn the consortium’s vision into an agreed technical and governance blueprint for an open energy data platform and orchestration system, including its audiences, governance, shared standards, and technical architecture for integrating member datasets, open models, and analyses. ORA is committed to ensuring that its core datasets, shared infrastructure, and collaborative tools remain open-source and publicly available.

Objective: ORA seeks an independent consultant, serving as Technical Coordinator, to facilitate and project manage the technical planning of building a shared data infrastructure across the five member organizations. The consultancy includes the interviews and research needed to develop concrete, detailed proposals for how members’ data can be integrated and supports members in agreeing on shared standards, a recommended architecture, and a roadmap for the next phase of the platform and the flagship product, the Open Energy Outlook. The result will be a consortium plan co-authored with the members.

Scope of Work: The Consultant will provide facilitation, project management, and technical analysis for ORA’s defined 12-month foundational planning phase. The Consultant will carry out the following work:

  1. Facilitation and Consortium Engagement:
  • Facilitate the planning process with all five ORA members, preparing agendas and materials, guiding discussions, building consensus among members with different practices and priorities, and documenting decisions and next steps.
  • Interview the data leads at each member organization to assess data assets, systems, workflows, and priority user needs.
  • Facilitate a shared definition of the platform’s priority users (for example, energy modelers, policy analysts, journalists, civil-society researchers, planners in developing geographies, and AI systems) and the access patterns, tools, and guarantees each needs.
  • Lead members through review of, and decisions on, the proposed shared protocols, architecture options, and data hub scope, ensuring all members have meaningful input.
  1. Project Management:
  • Develop and manage an integrated workplan for the foundational phase, with milestones, dependencies, and responsibilities across the five member organizations.
  • Track progress, risks, decisions, and action items.
  • Coordinate with the ORA Secretariat on communication with members and ORA leads.
  • Coordinate with GEM on the data hub proof of concept. The Consultant will define its requirements with the members, and GEM will manage the build.
  1. Technical Planning and Analysis
  • Develop a centralized map of the datasets, scrapers, and in-house data held across the five members, and identify gaps and opportunities for greater interoperability.
  • Develop proposed common schemas, identifiers, and metadata documentation, including a framework for a jointly governed identifier crosswalk linking each organization’s records.
  • Guide the members to develop shared approaches to automated validation and open, machine-readable documentation.
  • Analyze and recommend a design for the data platform (whether hosted, federated, or hybrid, and potentially varying by data product), ensuring datasets are clearly versioned and provenance is traced to primary sources.
  • Work with GEM’s Chief Data Officer to contribute to a strategy for presenting the consortium’s trusted datasets to AI systems as a preferred source for energy and climate queries, and a structured learning exchange on AI-assisted research methods.
  • Scope and define requirements for a limited proof of concept showing how a centralized hub/platform could serve particular user groups, and assess the prototype, which will be built by data engineering contractors working under GEM’s direction.
  • Co-author the consortium plan with the five members and prepare an implementation-ready technical and governance roadmap for the next phase.

Deliverables

The Consultant will produce the deliverables below. The inception workplan will set out agreed delivery dates, review responsibilities, and acceptance criteria for each deliverable.

  • Changes to scope, deliverables, or milestones require mutual written agreement between GEM and the consultant, following consultation with the ORA Secretariat
  • Inception report and integrated work plan
  • Assessment report on members’ data assets, systems, and priority user needs
  • Cross-member data map and gap analysis
  • Agreed priority audiences and use cases
  • Draft shared approaches to metadata, identifiers, validation, and data documentation
  • Options paper on platform architecture
  • Architecture recommendation and draft shared data protocols
  • Requirements and scope for the data hub proof of concept, handed over to GEM
  • Final consortium plan, including the roadmap for the next phase
  • Meeting agendas and notes, and monthly progress reports

Timing and Payment Structure

The consultancy is expected to begin in mid-December and will run for 12 months from the agreed start date. Any extension will require a separate written agreement covering scope, duration, and fees subject to funding availability.

The estimated level of effort is equivalent to approximately 20 hours per week over the assignment. This is a planning estimate rather than a requirement to work a fixed weekly schedule. The consultant will organize their time to meet agreed milestones and participate in mutually scheduled consortium meetings.

The proposed budget allocation for this consultancy is approximately US$135,000. Services will be provided on a time and materials basis at an hourly or daily rate agreed before execution. The consultant will submit monthly invoices showing time worked and services provided, along with a brief progress report against the workplan. The Consultant manages their own schedule and working arrangements and is responsible for their own taxes, insurance, equipment, and benefits.

Contract Oversight and Coordination

GEM, as the current host of the ORA Consortium, will be the contracting party and administer the consultancy. GEM’s Chief Data Officer is the primary technical and contract contact, confirms milestones with the consultant, and approves deliverables against the agreed scope and acceptance criteria. This oversight concerns project requirements and outputs; the consultant remains responsible for how the services are performed.

The Consultant will coordinate with the Chief Data Officer, GEM’s director of Product and the ORA Secretariat Coordinator to obtain member input, arrange reviews, and support delivery. The Secretariat Coordinator will review deliverables in partnership with the Chief Data Officer, and GEM will make payments under the terms of the contract.

Minimum Qualifications and Preferred Qualifications: The successful candidate will be evaluated based on the following minimum and preferred qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • A minimum of 8 years of working experience in data architecture, data management, or data product development, preferably in climate and energy data.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating and managing technical projects or working groups across multiple organizations in English.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong facilitation skills and experience building consensus among organizations with different practices and priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience designing or implementing data integration and interoperability, such as common schemas, identifiers or entity resolution, metadata standards, and data documentation.
  • Knowledge of the open energy data ecosystem, including open datasets, open-source energy modeling tools, and reproducible data pipelines.
  • Experience with platform architecture choices (hosted, federated, and hybrid), versioned data releases, and APIs.
  • Understanding of how AI systems consume data, including machine-readable metadata, APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
  • Experience working with open-source, open-data, digital public goods, research, or mission-driven organizations, including governance, licensing, and data stewardship.
  • Based in Europe, to support time zone overlap with consortium members. Eligibility for an independent consultancy will be assessed in the country where the services will be performed before a contract is offered.

Application Submission Details

Interested candidates must submit their CV and cover letter through GEM’s Careers Page no later than November 11, 2026. Please provide:

  • Resume or CV.
  • Cover letter: a brief letter addressing (1) your experience related to the assignment - including past experience with data integration, interoperability standards, and facilitation across multiple organizations; (2) your availability and earliest start date; and (3) your location and time zone.
  • One or two examples of relevant work, such as a data architecture proposal, interoperability framework, technical roadmap, or report developed through collaboration across organizations. Please briefly describe your contribution to each example. Links or anonymized excerpts are welcome; please do not submit confidential materials.
  • Your proposed hourly or daily rate in US dollars. If quoting a daily rate, please indicate the number of hours included.

References may be requested from shortlisted candidates.

The evaluation committee will evaluate applications based on the preferred skills and experience outlined above and availability to undertake the assignment.

GEM reserves the right to request clarification, conduct interviews with shortlisted candidates, negotiate the final scope and terms, or decline to make an award.

  • Technical Literacy: Solid fundamental understanding of back-end systems, complex, fully automated data flows, and computing technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to incident management, production support, or operational troubleshooting environments.

Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

jobs.description:
About Tarteel

Tarteel was founded with one mission: to strengthen the relationship Muslims have with the Quran. This goal has been at the very heart of Tarteel since its creation, and we continue to strive to provide the proper tools to empower the Muslim ummah to better connect with the words of Allah SWT, nourishing their faith in doing so. Inspired by the Islamic Golden Age, we saw untapped potential in the area of religious technology. We built Tarteel to help Muslims improve their Quranic study using the best digital tools. The Quran is a journey, and Tarteel is your companion.

The Tarteel app has more than 20M downloads and is powered by our state of the art models. As a company we've established relationships with leading AI companies such as Nvidia, who has us as a featured customer: . We currently have a core team of 20 exceptionally talented individuals.

What we're looking for

In this role, you will help design, build, and maintain our mobile application. Our mobile app is primarily built with React Native, including some native modules. We’ve also integrated Kotlin Multiplatform for certain performance-critical tasks. Because we build most features in Tarteel to work offline, the kind of challenges you will get to solve will push the limits of your skillset and expose you to challenges you haven’t previously encountered. If you have a strong background in mobile development (especially with React Native) and a passion for building high-quality software, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain mobile applications using React, React Native, Kotlin, and SQL
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features
  • Complete medium to large features (each with many tasks) independently without guidance
  • Execute on pixel-perfect responsive designs and animations with a high degree of polish and an eye for detail
  • Strong alignment towards creating functional and delightful user experiences for the intended audience
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, adhering to best practices
  • Proactively identify and drive changes as needed across all product areas
  • Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues
  • Participate in code and design reviews, ensuring adherence to coding standards and product quality
  • Provide strategic insight and technical guidance on how to architect our code base to support our user base as we scale product features

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in mobile or full-stack development
  • 1+ years of experience in React Native development
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, with relevant experience using React and React Native
  • Strong understanding of mobile and web application architecture, design patterns, and best practices
  • Solid knowledge of version control systems (e.g. Git)
  • Familiarity with continuous integration and deployment tools and processes
  • Experience with feature flagging and A/B testing
  • Experience with development and maintenance of products serving 1M+ users
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment
  • Availability for meetings from Monday to Thursday between 8am and 12pm Eastern

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with native (iOS, Android) code development using Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, or Java
  • Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform
  • Experience with SQL

Benefits

  • Fully remote work - Work anytime, anywhere
  • Dunya + Akhira — Islamic work week + Islamic Holidays and culture
  • Unlimited time off with manager approval
  • Yearly team retreats and off-sites
  • Ability to work in your thobe/abaya or traditional clothes in the comfort of your own home
  • Work directly with the core founding team, reporting to the CTO

Interview Process

Our interview process for this role consists of three stages:

  1. 60-minute technical screener, including a live coding problem
  2. 60-minute technical interview diving into more depth than the screener and also including a live coding problem
  3. 60-minute culture fit interview focused on situational scenarios and personal perspectives

jobs.description:
Overview: Multi-Tenant Cloud Infrastructure Design

The Cloud Architect is responsible for designing, managing, and optimizing the entire multi-tenant cloud infrastructure that hosts our integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. While our current stack utilizes Oracle Cloud Free VMs, this role requires expertise in major public clouds (AWS/GCP/Azure) to architect scalable, resilient, cost-optimized, and compliant solutions that handle fluctuating e-commerce traffic, stable internal tool usage, and intensive AI agent compute demands.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will design and govern the platform's foundation, ensuring scalability and compliance across all environments.

  • Cloud Architecture Design: Design and evolve the target cloud infrastructure (utilizing AWS, GCP, or Azure best practices) for maximum scalability, security, and high-availability, ensuring the platform can reliably support the MES $\rightarrow$ WMS $\rightarrow$ OMS flow.

  • Capacity Planning & Optimization: Plan and optimize resource allocation to effectively handle unpredictable e-commerce traffic spikes and the specific compute requirements for AI agent training and inference, driving cost efficiency.

  • High Availability & Disaster Recovery (DR): Implement multi-region/multi-AZ high-availability architectures and define comprehensive Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies for all core services, including PostgreSQL 15 and Redis.

  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) Governance: Establish and enforce best practices for Terraform usage, ensuring configuration consistency, security compliance, and auditable infrastructure changes.

  • Security & Compliance: Conduct regular security reviews of cloud configurations (e.g., IAM, VPC/VNet, Storage) and ensure architecture aligns with data residency and compliance requirements relevant to our multi-tenant operations.

  • Service Integration: Architect the network and service mesh overlay that integrates the containerized applications (Docker/Traefik) with external cloud services and the overall monitoring solution (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess deep architectural experience with public cloud providers and infrastructure automation:

  • Cloud Providers: Expert-level proficiency in at least one major public cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Mandatory expertise in Terraform for cloud resource provisioning.

  • Containerization: Deep knowledge of Docker networking, security, and orchestration principles.

  • Networking & Edge: Experience configuring load balancing, service mesh, and ingress controllers (e.g., Traefik).

  • Data & Storage: Architecting scalable database services (PostgreSQL) and object storage (MinIO).

  • Security: Cloud security best practices, IAM policy design, and network segmentation.

AI Agent Focus

You will optimize the cloud layer for our emerging AI capabilities.

  • Compute Optimization: Design elastic and cost-effective compute clusters (e.g., GPU instances) to efficiently handle the variable demands of LLM fine-tuning and multi-agent system orchestration.

  • Data Residency: Architect the data pipeline and storage solutions to ensure that training data and model artifacts adhere to strict data residency requirements across tenants.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Cost Efficiency: Demonstrable reduction in cloud operational costs (FinOps) while maintaining performance.

  • Availability: Achieving defined SLAs/SLOs for infrastructure uptime and performance.

  • Compliance: Successful implementation and auditing of cloud security and data residency controls.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Solution Architect or Head of Technology, collaborating closely with the SRE and DevSecOps teams to operationalize cloud strategy.

As a Senior Software Engineer at Emetlab, you will design and build the systems that power elite AI training data infrastructure serving frontier laboratories, Fortune 500 enterprises, and sovereign AI programmes worldwide. Emetlab is an AI data infrastructure company delivering expert-produced, rigorously validated datasets and end-to-end AI solutions that transform good models into exceptional ones.

Design, build, and maintain scalable services, APIs, and data pipelines that power Emetlab's global data production and delivery infrastructure. Own features and systems end-to-end, from technical design and implementation through to testing, deployment, and monitoring. Lead architectural decisions that ensure platform reliability, security, and scalability as our contributor network and client base grow. Mentor and elevate junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pairing, and architectural guidance. Collaborate cross-functionally with data operations, AI/ML, and product teams to deliver infrastructure that meets the precision demands of frontier AI development. Contribute to infrastructure and DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, and cloud deployment at scale.

What You'll Need to Succeed

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in one or more languages such as Python, C#, Java, TypeScript, or Go. Proven experience designing and building production-grade APIs, services, and distributed systems that operate at scale. Experience working with databases (relational and/or NoSQL), caching layers, messaging systems, and data pipeline tooling. A strong engineering mindset, comfortable navigating ambiguity, making pragmatic trade-offs, and delivering with quality under pace. Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to engineering culture through technical leadership and collaboration. Welcome to Perena: Your Risk Layer on Solana

Perena is a decentralized financial protocol on Solana that offers USD STAR (USD*), a yield-bearing asset. USD* is fully collateralized and earns yield from diversified, real sources such as delta-neutral strategies and secured borrow-lend market positions. Its value grows automatically, making it a simple, secure way to save on-chain.

USD* is fully collateralized by a diversified portfolio of yield-generating assets and positions, including:

Delta-neutral hedged positions on centralized and decentralized exchanges (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL)

Secured borrow-lend market positions involving on-chain stablecoins

Real-world assets, such as the reinsurance fund by OnRe

Perena actively manages asset allocation and diversifies across multiple strategies to reduce single points of failure and optimize for sustainable, consistent yield performance.

Built on Solana's high-performance blockchain, Perena is creating a liquid, yield-bearing digital dollar that anyone can access with a sustainable, risk-managed approach.

Looking ahead, Perena is building a full suite of on-chain stablebanking products to expand access to real yield across crypto and traditional finance. The goal is a sustainable financial experience for anyone to transact, save, and invest on-chain.

Perena is founded by a team of builders from the Solana ecosystem with backgrounds in TradFi and DeFi. We believe deeply in pushing financial architecture forward — and in doing it with transparency, resilience, and speed.

We're backed by some of the best in the world, including:

Solana co-founders Anatoly Yakovenko and Raj Gokal

Investors from Citadel, Jane Street, IMC, and Susquehanna

Borderless Capital, Binance Labs, Primitive Ventures, Maelstrom, Anagram, Breed, and others

Perena was a sponsor of the Colosseum Hackathon Stablecoin Track, helping fund the next generation of stablecoin projects on Solana. Our growing community spans over 20,000 developers, users, and builders aligned around one goal: reinventing how money works.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the frontend applications that bring Perena's financial products to life, from minting and redeeming USD* to portfolio dashboards, yield analytics, and on-chain transaction flows, using Next.js and TypeScript as the core stack

  • Design and implement a scalable component library and design system that ensures consistency, accessibility, and reusability across all Perena surfaces, including public-facing apps, internal operations tools, and documentation

  • Integrate directly with on-chain data and wallet infrastructure, building seamless interactions with Solana programs, wallet adapters, and real-time blockchain state to create intuitive user experiences around complex DeFi primitives

  • Collaborate closely with protocol engineers, designers, and product to translate sophisticated financial concepts (yield strategies, collateral flows, risk metrics) into clear, trustworthy interfaces that inspire user confidence

  • Own frontend performance, reliability, and observability, including optimizing load times, implementing error boundaries, building monitoring and analytics pipelines, and ensuring the app performs under real-world conditions across devices and regions

  • Drive data-driven iteration by instrumenting user flows, analyzing engagement and conversion metrics, and shipping improvements that make Perena's products easier and more compelling to use

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with a strong emphasis on Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript in production environments

  • Deep understanding of React patterns, server components, client/server rendering strategies, caching, and data fetching in modern Next.js applications

  • Experience building and maintaining component libraries or design systems (e.g., using Tailwind CSS, Radix, Shadcn, or similar) with a strong eye for craft and detail

  • Familiarity with wallet integration and on-chain data in a frontend context (Solana wallet adapters, RPC calls, transaction signing) or clear ability to ramp fast

  • Track record shipping user-facing products in fast-paced environments where you owned features end-to-end, from design handoff through deployment and iteration

  • Strong instinct for UX in high-stakes financial contexts: you think about trust, clarity, error states, and edge cases before they become problems

  • Experience with frontend testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E) and CI/CD pipelines to maintain quality at speed

  • Comfort working with designers in Figma, translating visual specs into pixel-perfect, responsive, and accessible implementations

  • Familiarity with DeFi or fintech products is a strong signal, but not required. What matters is you can learn fast and reason about how users interact with money

Earlier in your career? Apply anyway if you can show real ownership of shipped products, clean code, and a sharp eye for design and usability.

Why Perena?

Stablecoins are transforming how the world stores, moves, and grows value — and we're still early. This is a once-in-a-generation shift: from legacy money to programmable, accessible, internet-native finance. Building here isn't just technically interesting — it's globally meaningful.

We own our future — we trust each other to take initiative. Voices are heard and outcomes matter.

We treat our work as craft — thoughtful, opinionated, and precise. Many of us come from design, art, or cultural backgrounds.

We think from first principles — Perena is a reimagining of financial infrastructure. That starts with reimagining how we build.

Puzzleplay at Tripledot Studios is looking for a data analyst to own the fraud side of its user segmentation work. You'll work with the analyst responsible for gameplay signals, alongside product and data colleagues, to keep that system useful as fraud patterns change.

Fraud patterns keep changing, so you'll regularly revisit the signals behind the segments and help the product team decide which verification methods make sense in each market.

  • Review fraud signals regularly, adding, removing and refining them to distinguish suspicious activity from legitimate users. Signals under consideration include IP spoofing, VPN use and unusual play patterns.

jobs.description:
About Discovered Labs

Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher (Ben Moore) and demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR (Liam Dunne).

We're a team of ML engineers, data scientists and senior marketers trusted by fast-growing B2B SaaS companies including Instantly, Granola and Composio to help generate leads and customers through Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT.

We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing).

View recent case studies at

High-level overview of our approach:

  • AI-powered operations: Our ML team builds internal tools that remove repetitive work and give marketers more time for judgement and execution.

  • Senior judgement: Experienced marketers set the strategy and quality bar; automation supports the work rather than replacing it.

  • Full-stack execution: We work across content, technical SEO/AEO and off-site amplification to give clients better outcomes.

Note: If you want to stand out, please include a Loom video showing a tool, system or deliverable you've produced and are proud of. We'd love to see it!

This role

We’re hiring for a SEO/AEO Lead. You’ll manage our team of analysts and strategists, constantly raise the bar across client work and collaborate closely with product and engineering to turn client and market insights into better tools and workflows for the team.

You’ll be accountable for client health, making sure the department’s quarterly net revenue retention (NRR) goal is hit and coaching the team to become best-in-class marketers who are progressing in their careers.

This is not a typical management role where your value is measured by team meetings. It will be operationally intense: high context, high communication and the application of unreasonably high standards across everything we do for clients.

It is fully remote, ideally within +/-4 hours of GMT, though we can be flexible for the right person.

What you'll do

  • Improve the delivery methodology. Identify better ways for us to find, diagnose and act on SEO/AEO performance opportunities that help clients win. Turn successful changes into playbooks and workflows that don’t rely on heroics.

  • Set and maintain delivery standards. Improve how we structure deliverables, run QA, communicate with clients and collaborate as a team so clients receive a world-class experience and we maintain a culture of excellence.

  • Coach and train the team weekly. Use structured work, call and communication reviews to give feedback, practise improvements and check that subsequent client work meets the standard.

  • Manage performance and development. Run structured fortnightly 1:1s, quarterly reviews, and maintain individual development plans so team members are progressing in their careers and feel incentivised.

  • Own NRR and client health. Report on retention, expansion and account health; spot risks early and work with strategists on save plans for red accounts.

  • Build the talent bench and hire well. Build a pipeline of capable analysts and strategists for future capacity needs. Run structured assessments and interviews to evaluate ability and help close candidates.

  • Build effective onboarding. Build and improve an onboarding curriculum so analysts and strategists reach our delivery standards faster.

  • Sponsor product and workflow improvements. Work with product and engineering to build new tools and workflows that make your team more effective and gives clients unfair advantages.

The ideal person for this role

  • You’ve led teams before. You know how to run performance reviews, handle hard conversations and get the most out of those who work with you.

  • You can challenge a search strategy. You can judge whether a content plan targets the right clusters, a technical recommendation deserves priority or an AEO experiment will deliver the right commercial outcomes.

  • You operate with radical candour. You proactively provide feedback and are comfortable having difficult conversations without being an asshole. People know where they stand with you.

  • You are detail-oriented. You spot details that others miss and you unapologetically hold yourself and everyone around you to a high standard.

  • You can diagnose the real problem. If a strategy is underperforming, you are able to quickly identify the issues and resolve it using data.

  • You develop judgement in others. You can explain why a plan or deliverable falls short, give useful feedback and help the person produce better work next time.

  • You think in systems. Disconnected work drives you crazy. You connect work into clear frameworks, shared definitions and standards.

Requirements

  • Experience formally managing SEOs with evidence of improved performance, candid feedback and difficult people decisions.

  • Strong practical SEO judgement across content, technical and off-page work.

  • Evidence that your SEO decisions improved client business outcomes.

  • Evidence of prioritising across client accounts or equivalent stakeholder portfolios when performance, retention risk and delivery capacity compete.

  • Ability to define requirements and acceptance criteria for delivery improvements, and validate solutions with product or engineering.

  • Excellent written and verbal English and availability for a working day that overlaps meaningfully with GMT.

This role is not for you if…

  • You’re not exceptional at SEO. We believe great leaders must first be great operators.

  • You’d rather operate in the shadows. This is a high-visibility role interacting with clients every day and collaborating with the team.

  • You aren’t comfortable with data. We’re a deeply technical team who prefers data over opinions.

  • You’d rather sit at 50,000 feet in diagrams and planning docs. You’ll be expected to also be in the weeds pushing work forward.

Culture fit

You'll thrive here if:

  • You like small teams, direct feedback and a high degree of autonomy.

  • You’re comfortable challenging others’ thinking and also having yourself challenged.

  • You are comfortable making a recommendation and explaining the data and rationale behind it.

You won't thrive here if:

  • You need heavy management or wait for perfect instructions.

  • You rely on “that’s how it’s always been done” to defend an approach.

  • You leave concerns unspoken because the conversation might be uncomfortable.

  • You intend to view Discovered Labs as another client amongst other projects and clients.

What's in it for you

  • Compensation: $50K to $85K USD, DOE

  • Fully remote: work from where you do your best work, with meaningful overlap with GMT.

  • Progression: A clear path towards head of client delivery or associate director.

  • Flexibility: You can have flexible working hours with the expectation of 40 hours of meaningful work per week.

  • Real autonomy: you will have a voice, be trusted to do your work and make improvements to our systems.

  • A small, senior team: work directly with experienced operators, with direct feedback and quick decisions.

  • Annual company off-site: We get together once a year at a nice destination to relax, reset and plan.

Interview Process:

  • Async assessment (15 minutes)

  • 30 minute call with founder

  • 90 minute deep-dive into career history and work

  • 3 hour paid assessment

  • Reference checks with former peers and managers.

To apply:

Please complete the short form on the platform where you see this job ad. Be specific as possible when answering questions - we love detail.

Please do not use sloppy AI to auto-apply for this role. It’s obvious and will result in us not progressing with your application for this role and future roles.

jobs.title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
jobs.excerpt: The ChallengeWe connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes.
jobs.description:
The Challenge

We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next.

A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow.

Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. That means this role has real scope from day one: no layers between you and the decisions that matter, and no shortage of things worth tackling.

This is a remote opportunity.

What You'll Do

  • Own call quality holistically: hold the full picture of call quality end to end, working with the team on both the daily grind and the long-term view, moving fluidly between quick fixes and structured experiments.

  • Manage zones, codes, and origins: own and continuously refine our zone, dialing code, and call origin management, keeping the underlying structure clean and accurate across all 900 zones.

  • Update routing continuously: change routing several times a day, from immediate fixes to longer-running tests of new suppliers.

  • Work cross-functionally by design: partner daily with Ozcan, who owns supplier account management and deal creation, and Mahmoud, who runs hourly monitoring and support-team escalations to suppliers. Work with Ewan on automating the processes behind routing, and with Product and CRM to improve the experience for our end users.

  • Move routing toward automation: work toward (semi) automated routing and pricing, reducing how much of this still runs on manual, single-person work.

Requirements

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience with international A-Z calling and telco routing: zones, codes, LCR, and SIP response codes, built at a telco, carrier, or comms platform with real cross-border calling experience.

  • NOC or technical support background: comfortable troubleshooting live voice traffic and reading call detail records and quality metrics like ASR and ACD.

  • Exposure to a routing/testing platform such as iTest or an equivalent tool. Familiarity with Digitalk Cloud Carrier (DCC), our current routing platform, is a plus.

  • Nice to have: working technical literacy in SIP signalling and SBC concepts

Who You Are

  • Process driven and meticulous: you build the audit trail as you go, not after something goes wrong. You are methodical and analytical by nature, and you would rather have a clean, repeatable process than a clever one-off fix.

  • Hands-on: you do the routing work yourself, day to day, not just direct others to do it.

  • A strong communicator: equally at ease explaining a routing issue to Product or Marketing as debating a fix with a supplier's NOC team.

  • Ownership without a script: you see a bottleneck and you fix it rather than wait to be asked.

  • Genuinely commercial: you understand a dropped call or a bad route costs Talk360 real money and a real user's trust, not just an SLA breach.

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter screening

  2. Hiring manager screening with COO

  3. Technical interview

  4. Case study

What you get

Learning and growth

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.

Time to recharge

  • 25 vacation days

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview)

Work from anywhere

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.

A team you'll actually want to be part of

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday

  • Regular team moments and outings

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond

Set up for success

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

An environment to grow and make impact

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission

About Talk360

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.

Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.

Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

Here’s what our users say:

“I like Talk360 because it saves me a lot of money. I used to call from Zimbabwe for 15 rands a minute. Talk360 came to the rescue. Now I can call my mother for hours.” — Google Play, South Africa ★★★★★

“Talk360 is a simple and reliable app for cheap international calls. It works even if the receiver has no internet, offers good call quality, and has transparent pricing.” — Google Play, United States ★★★★★

“It is a flawless experience with no hustles at all and the tariffs are more than just fair.” — Trustpilot, United Kingdom ★★★★★

Overview: Building Autonomous AI Agents

The AI/ML Engineer with an AI Agent Focus is a specialized role dedicated to designing, building, and deploying autonomous AI agents that handle complex business processes independently. You will be at the forefront of integrating cutting-edge Large Language Models (LLMs) and reasoning frameworks into our e-commerce and supply chain ecosystem, driving efficiency and innovation through intelligent automation.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of agent development, from initial design to production optimization and monitoring.

  • Agent Architecture & Development: Design and build autonomous AI agent architectures utilizing LLMs, advanced reasoning frameworks, and decision-making systems to achieve specific business goals (e.g., customer support automation, sales assistance, workflow optimization).

  • Business Process Automation: Create agents that integrate directly into the platform to automate critical supply chain and administrative tasks, such including:

    • Customer Support Agents integrated into the e-commerce storefront.

    • Internal Workflow Automation agents (e.g., Slack integration, Jira automation).

  • Multi-Agent Systems: Implement and orchestrate multi-agent systems where specialized agents collaborate to solve complex, multi-step problems across different modules (MES, WMS, OMS).

  • Advanced Agent Capabilities: Develop and implement memory systems, sophisticated context management, and tool integration strategies (allowing agents to use internal APIs, search, or code execution) to enhance agent efficacy.

  • Model Optimization: Implement techniques for agent improvement, including fine-tuning of LLM models and applying concepts from Reinforcement Learning for optimal decision-making.

  • Safety & Monitoring: Implement safety guardrails, define ethical usage guidelines, and build robust monitoring systems (collaborating with MLOps) to track and analyze agent behavior and performance in production.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess deep experience in machine learning, LLM technology, and production deployment:

  • LLM/Agent Frameworks: Mandatory hands-on expertise with agent construction frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AutoGen.

  • Programming & ML: Expert proficiency in Python and standard ML/Deep Learning libraries (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow).

  • Data & APIs: Experience preparing data for model fine-tuning and integrating agents via API endpoints into production services (Node.js/NestJS).

  • Deployment: Familiarity with MLOps concepts (versioning, deployment) and containerization (Docker) for agent deployment.

  • Databases: Understanding of vector databases and retrieval augmented generation (RAG) techniques.

Supply Chain Integration (Domain Focus)

You will integrate intelligent agents directly into our core supply chain and data systems.

  • Data Analysis Agents: Build agents capable of complex data analysis and insight generation using aggregated data from MES, WMS, and OMS.

  • E-commerce Integration: Deploy agents that assist users directly within the e-commerce platform by accessing real-time catalog and inventory data.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Agent Autonomy: Measurable increase in the percentage of business tasks handled end-to-end by autonomous agents.

  • Business Impact: Quantifiable improvements in metrics driven by the agents (e.g., reduced customer support response time, increased sales conversion).

The Solution Architect is a strategic leadership role responsible for defining the complete, end-to-end technical architecture for our integrated supply chain e-commerce platform. You will translate complex business requirements across Manufacturing (MES), Warehouse (WMS), and Order Management (OMS) into secure, scalable, and compliant technical blueprints. Your designs will ensure seamless integration between all core systems and our next-generation AI agent infrastructure.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will design the technical vision for our critical business flow: MES → WMS → OMS → Payments → Invoices.

  • Architecture & Design: Define the architecture (modular monolith/microservices) and API contracts for core modules (OMS, WMS, MES) built on Node.js 22/NestJS using TypeScript.

  • Multi-Tenancy & Security: Define the strategy for tenant isolation using PostgreSQL 15 with Row-Level Security (RLS) and architect the JWT-based licensing and feature metering system.

  • Infrastructure (IaC): Blueprint the deployment standards using Terraform and Docker with orchestration handled by Traefik on Oracle Cloud Free VMs.

  • Compliance & Observability: Ensure adherence to compliance (HS codes, export controls) and design the monitoring and tracing strategy using Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.

Required Technologies & Tools

  • Data/Storage: PostgreSQL 15 (RLS), Redis, Meilisearch, MinIO

  • DevOps/Infra: Terraform, Docker, Traefik, pgBackRest

  • Security/Auth: Authentik/Ory Kratos, Vault

AI Agent Focus

You will architect the platform for integrating advanced AI capabilities into our operational systems.

jobs.description:
At ZIGChain, we're designing the next generation of blockchain infrastructure, leveraging decentralized technologies for enhanced security, scalability and interoperability. Our mission is to empower people everywhere through transparent, decentralized systems that drive financial freedom. ZIGChain is a Layer 1 blockchain focused on unlocking financial opportunities for everyone, regardless of their income, location or level of knowledge.

We're looking for a junior-to-mid systems and infrastructure engineer to take on the day-to-day operation of our Linux, AWS, and blockchain-node infrastructure. You'll start by owning routine administration and monitoring, and grow into more of our infrastructure-as-code and node-operations work over time. This is a hands-on operations role with a clear path to broader responsibility, and a great fit for someone with solid fundamentals who wants to deepen their cloud and infrastructure skills in a real production environment.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Operate and maintain our Linux, AWS, and blockchain-node infrastructure on a day-to-day basis.

  • Own routine administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of services and networking.

  • Contribute to our infrastructure-as-code work with Terraform, growing your ownership over time.

  • Support blockchain node operations across our ecosystem.

  • Automate recurring tasks and diagnostics through scripting.

  • Help keep our systems secure, patched, and running smoothly.

Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • Linux administration: CLI fluency, systemd, package management, log analysis, and troubleshooting of services and networking.

  • Shell scripting (Bash) for automation and diagnostics.

  • Working knowledge of core AWS services: EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, and load balancers (ELB/ALB). You should be able to operate and debug them, not necessarily architect them.

  • Terraform at a working level: you have authored and applied configurations and understand state and the plan/apply cycle. Prior Terraform experience on any cloud is fine, it doesn't need to be AWS.

  • Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SSH, firewalls and security groups.

  • Git: comfortable with the everyday branch/commit/PR workflow.

  • Sound credential and access hygiene: proper SSH key handling, least-privilege IAM, keeping secrets out of code and repositories, and keeping systems patched.

Cool-to-Haves:

  • Terraform beyond the basics: modules, remote state, multi-environment setups.

  • Blockchain node experience, whether with Cosmos specifically or another chain.

  • Docker; Kubernetes exposure is a plus.

  • Monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

  • Python for tooling beyond Bash.

  • CI/CD exposure.

Soft Skills

  • Accountability: you own your work and communicate openly when something goes wrong, focusing on fixing it rather than explaining it away.

  • Honesty and candor: you speak up for what's good for the team, even when it's not the easiest thing to say.

  • A self-taught instinct: you're comfortable figuring things out on your own and genuinely enjoy learning, since much of this role is grown into rather than known on day one.

  • Collaborative team player, self-directed and comfortable working autonomously in remote environments.

What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary ranging from $40,000.00 to $50,000.00 (USD) depending on seniority.

  • 15% extra to the salary in ZIGs tokens as part of the compensation package.

  • Fully remote work environment.

  • Opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry.

  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture.

  • Professional growth and development opportunities.

Why Join ZIGChain?

  • Impact, help operate and strengthen the core infrastructure that powers a decentralised, interoperable financial future,

  • Innovation, work with a cutting-edge tech stack in a space that rewards experimentation and creativity,

  • Ownership, take real responsibility for systems that matter from your first weeks, with a clear path to more,

  • Growth, join a team that values learning, autonomy and technical excellence at every level.

Our Core Values

At ZIGChain we don't just build blockchain technology, we build a culture rooted in five values that shape how we work every day.

  • Extreme Ownership: we close the loop. Work ends shipped, killed, or explicitly handed off, and we escalate when blocked instead of going silent,

  • Heroes Don't Scale: we step up when the moment demands it, then build the processes, workflows and agents that prevent the next crisis,

  • Excellence: excellence is what ships. Quality and time are fixed, scope flexes, and we aim to deliver work that becomes the reference others measure against,

  • Strategic Intelligence: we think in second and third orders, naming downstream consequences before committing and choosing speed or depth as the moment requires,

  • The Org Is AI: AI executes work and holds the system while we give it direction. Building and orchestrating agents is basic literacy here.

These values drive how we work, grow and make an impact, and we're inviting you to be part of it. Apply now!

Highlights

Own the day-to-day of ZIGChain's Linux, AWS and node infrastructure, and grow into IaC and node operations. Fully remote, real production environment, real responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About seQuraseQura provides innovative, flexible and easy-to-use payment technologies that help merchants acquire, convert and retain more customers.
jobs.description:
About seQura

seQura provides innovative, flexible and easy-to-use payment technologies that help merchants acquire, convert and retain more customers.

We make a difference in sales performance by tailoring our solutions to different sectors, to address their unique pain points and deliver superior results in Retail, Education, Eyewear, Repairs and Travel.

We also empower smart shopping to consumers who seek more value, convenience, and flexibility in their shopping, with new payment experiences that allow them to save, access interest-free credit, or pay in small, comfortable installments of up to 24 months.

Born in Barcelona, seQura is a privately-owned fintech, currently expanding throughout southern Europe and Latin America, growing above 50% CAGR.
Over 6000 businesses, almost 3 million shoppers, and almost 400 employees continue to rate us as one of the most loved and trusted fintechs out there, with an NPS of 87%, a Trustpilot rating of 4.7/5, and a Glassdoor rating of 4.1/5.

About the role 🤓

We're looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our Platform team and help us build the platform that lets every engineer at seQura ship safely, quickly, and on their own.

seQura is expanding into new international markets, and the platform has to grow with it without growing its cost at the same pace. At the same time, AI is changing how infrastructure is built and run. We already put AI agents to work on our everyday platform work, from reviewing infrastructure changes and explaining plans to helping engineers resolve incidents on their own. Our goal is to go much further: independent agents working across the whole scope of the platform, with engineers who decide what matters and own the outcome.

You'll work in a cloud-native AWS environment, in a regulated fintech, where security, compliance, and reliability are part of the product we offer to the rest of engineering.

How we build at seQura 🤖

AI-assisted development is how our engineers work every day. We use AI agents to think through problems, write, review and iterate on code, and we're looking for engineers who already work this way, or are actively making the shift.

What matters to us isn't whether you know the syntax and idioms of your preferred programming language or tech stack by heart. It's whether you understand the problem you're solving, can explain the business logic behind it, and own every line you ship, no matter who (or what) wrote it first.

AI helps you move faster, challenge assumptions, explore different approaches and improve your solutions. But knowing which questions to ask, making sound technical and product decisions, and taking responsibility for the outcome is always up to you.

Our technical interviews reflect this approach: you'll use your own AI tools, and we'll ask you to walk us through your solution, both the business reasoning and the code.

If you're only interested in technical challenges without engaging in the product decisions behind them, or you'd rather not work with AI, this probably isn't the right role for you.

About the Platform team 🧩

Team Mission

To empower engineers with secure, efficient, and compliant infrastructure, while continuously improving through automation and collaboration.

What we own

  • Our multi-account AWS foundation and the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where seQura's products run

  • Infrastructure as Code with Terragrunt, delivered through pull requests and Atlantis

  • Deployment and GitOps tooling: Helm charts, shared deploy configuration, and CI/CD pipelines

  • The observability stack used across engineering: metrics, logs, traces, and alerting

  • Security and compliance foundations: secrets management, access control, PCI DSS, and the controls required to operate regulated entities across multiple countries under regulations such as DORA, NIS2 and those still to come.

  • Internal developer tooling, including the AI agents and Claude Code plugins that engineers use to work with our platform on their own

How we work

  • We're enablers: internal teams are our customers, and we measure success by how much they can do without us

  • We're autonomous end-to-end: we code, deploy, observe, improve, and document what we build

  • Everything as code, everything through a pull request, everything reviewed, and every important decision written down in an ADR

  • Strong opinions, held weakly; collaborators over rock stars; blameless by default

  • We plan by quarter and choose initiatives by their impact on users and on the business

We work closely with every product engineering team, with Security, with the Data Platform team, and with Compliance.

What challenges you'll be solving 🚀

  • International expansion: help seQura launch in multiple new markets, with the isolation, compliance, and reliability each one requires

  • AI-native platform: move from AI that assists us to independent agents that operate across the whole scope of the platform, from infrastructure changes to support and incident response

  • Keeping up with open source in the AI era: define new strategies to adopt, upgrade, and secure the open source software we depend on, now that it moves faster than ever

  • Scale without raising our baseline cost: design the strategies that let the business keep growing while our base infrastructure cost stays flat

What to expect in the next 90 days 🏁

Month 1: Learn the terrain 🧭

You'll join initiatives the team already has in motion, pairing with your teammates and shipping your first changes to production. You'll learn how we work, why we made the decisions we made, and what the rest of engineering expects from us.

By the end of the month: you've shipped to production and you know who to ask for what.

Month 2: Own your first mission 🎯

We'll hand you an opportunity the team has already identified, and it's yours: from the technical design to running it in production. You'll keep discovering seQura along the way, and we'll be there whenever you need context.
By the end of the month: you've delivered an initiative end-to-end and you have your own opinion on where the platform should go next.

Month 3: Shape what comes next 🚀

With more context, you'll be the one finding the opportunity. You'll talk with other teams to understand their friction, lead a cross-team initiative, and bring your own proposals to the planning of next quarter.

By the end of the month: part of next quarter's roadmap has your name on it.

What we are looking for🤝

Must have:

  • You've designed and operated highly available distributed systems in production, and you've lived through what happens when they fail: incidents, post-mortems, and the changes that made sure it didn't happen again

  • Proven experience scaling infrastructure at a global scale

  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform in production

  • A product mindset: you put users and the business at the center of your decisions, and you can explain why one initiative matters more than another

  • Hands-on experience working with AI agents in your daily engineering work

  • Agency: you don't wait for a ticket. You spot the problem, decide it's worth solving, bring people along, and own it until it runs in production

  • Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

Nice to have:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments (PCI DSS, DORA, or similar)

  • Experience with Terragrunt, Atlantis, or GitOps workflows

  • Scripting or programming in Python, Go, or similar

  • Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, the Elastic stack, or Tempo

  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling

  • Experience building your own AI agents, skills, or automations for engineering teams

  • Experience being part of an on-call rotation

  • Spanish

Tech stack🛠️

AWS (multi-account), Kubernetes (EKS), Terragrunt, Atlantis, Helm, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, SOPS, Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, Elastic, Tempo, Python, and AI coding agents such as Claude Code as part of our daily workflow.

What we offer 😎

We have a strong and sustainable foundation, where we provide a secure and reliable workplace. You have the freedom and trust to make the best contribution possible.

One of our most valued strengths by our employees is our fellowship and supportive culture, which fosters a sense of belonging by working closely with our values. With us, you will have challenging projects to work on and push your skills and knowledge.

In addition, we are very proud of the unique office we have, which offers a comfortable and inspiring environment to work in with everything you need.

  • 23 vacation days + 2 days of free disposal per year.

  • Flexible compensation plan for transportation, restaurants, and kindergarten with Cobee.

  • Health insurance discounts

  • Flexible working hours.

  • A personal budget for professional development.

  • Hybrid or fully remote work.

  • Office workshops and meet-ups to encourage community participation and career growth.

Moreover, we have a Wellness Programthat embraces a holistic approach by covering 6 areas (occupational, physical, financial, emotional, social, and environmental consciousness). Each area will include a variety of activities, and you'll be able to choose from 34 different activities that best meet your needs to configure a plan that best works for you.

Which are the next steps? 🙌

  1. Interview with our People Team.

  2. Technical challenge (async), solved with your own AI tools

  3. Live session with the team, where you walk us through your decisions and your solution

  4. Meet the Hiring Manager

We promote equal opportunity to all, regardless of age, color, gender identity, medical condition, physical or mental disability, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We have an inclusive environment, and respect is above all.

Website ownership, maintenance and support
