jobs.title: Product Manager - Anti Fraud
jobs.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We run a large-scale GPU cloud and AI infrastructure platform. Fraud and abuse — stolen payment cards, fake sign-ups, compute mining, credential abuse, and coordinated free-tier exploitation — directly threaten platform economics, capacity availability for legitimate customers, and our standing with payment providers and cloud partners.

As Product Manager, Anti-Fraud, you own the product roadmap for the systems that detect, prevent, and respond to fraud and abuse across the customer lifecycle — from onboarding and payment through to ongoing consumption. You sit at the intersection of Trust & Safety, Payments/Billing, Risk, Data Science, and Product Engineering, and you balance two goals in constant tension: stop bad actors and keep friction near zero for real customers.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own the end-to-end anti-fraud product roadmap: signup/KYC checks, payment fraud detection, account takeover protection, and compute-abuse (e.g., crypto mining, resource reselling) prevention.
  • Own the rules and risk-scoring surfaces — the tooling that lets analysts and data scientists define, test, and deploy detection rules and ML models with clear guardrails and audit trails.
  • Own the manual review and case-management experience for the Trust & Safety operations team, including queues, evidence views, and action workflows (block, limit, step-up verification, release).
  • Own customer-facing friction points — verification flows, step-up challenges, and appeals — designed to minimize false positives and protect the legitimate user experience.
  • Identify fraud and abuse incidents early — define the signals, alerts, and thresholds that surface incidents before they scale, and own the detection surface that flags them.
  • Participate in incident reviews and post-mortems, capturing root causes and turning each finding into concrete improvements to detection rules, models, and the roadmap.
  • Ensure timely response to active incidents — drive fast triage, clear ownership, and mitigation, working alongside Trust & Safety, Engineering, and Data Science to contain impact.
  • Write clear PRDs and specs that translate fuzzy risk problems into shippable engineering and data-science work.
  • Partner with Analytics team on detection models — defining the problem, labels, and success criteria, and deciding where rules vs. ML are the right tool.
  • Run experiments and monitor rollouts, watching both fraud-catch metrics and false-positive / customer-friction impact.
  • Work with Legal/Compliance to keep detection and enforcement aligned with payment-network rules, KYC/AML expectations, and data-privacy requirements.
  • Track and report on fraud loss, chargeback rate, false-positive rate, review throughput, and time-to-detection.

We expect you to have:

  • Proven product management experience in fraud, risk, trust & safety, or payments.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable with data, SQL or equivalent, and reasoning about precision/recall trade-offs and metrics.
  • Ability to make decisions under ambiguity and to balance security, business, and customer-experience priorities.
  • Solid collaboration with engineering and data science; you can hold a technical conversation about signals, features, and model behavior.
  • Exposure to cloud, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, or infrastructure products.
  • Understanding payment fraud, chargebacks, KYC/AML, or device/network signals (fingerprinting, velocity, IP reputation).

It would be an added bonus if you have:

  • Familiarity with ML-based detection systems and their operational lifecycle (drift, retraining, monitoring).
  • Experience with abuse patterns specific to compute or GPU platforms (mining, credential stuffing, free-tier farming).

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.excerpt: About UsThere are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright.
jobs.description:
About Us

There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore.

We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That's not a policy. It's just who we are. It is working, with tens of thousands of families trusting us.

We are looking for an executive partner on people: a peer to the co-founders who owns talent, culture and recruiting across the company. There is plenty still to build here, but this is not an HR business partner role. You will co-author, with the co-founders, who we hire, who we keep and grow, who we part ways with, and what it feels like to work here. If building the team that brings peace of mind to millions of seniors and their families is how you want to spend the next few years, we'd love to talk.

What you'll own

Hire the top 1%

  • You know what extraordinary looks like. You can explain why someone is exceptional rather than merely good, and hold every hiring manager, including the co-founders, to that bar.
  • You'll build and lead the recruiting team: at least two recruiters, one for technical and senior roles and one for high-volume customer-facing roles. Initially you run searches yourself while you build out your team. Down the line, you may be hands on recruiting for executive roles.
  • You'll grow us to about 150 to 160 people by the end of 2027, adding 12 to 20 non-rep roles and 25 to 30 reps. You'll run your recruiters to tight funnel metrics like pass-through rates and time to hire, and you'll also measure the quality of hires after they start: are the people your team hired still here and excelling a year later?
  • You'll make sure we hire the right people at the right time, not just the roles hiring managers announce they need, and that the people we hire are connected to our mission and likely to grow and succeed here.
  • You'll be well-networked and able to deliver world-class hiring, not just high-volume recruiting. You bring in people we couldn't otherwise reach, you know what sells the best people on Community Phone and what keeps them here, and you make sure every candidate hears it.

Keep extraordinary people, and only them

  • You'll be the primary voice of culture alongside the co-founders. You'll make sure everyone understands the mission, what part of the system they're in, what their work feeds into, how their performance is evaluated, and why it matters.
  • You'll make sure our most remarkable people stay: that they have the space, control and authority to do great work, that they feel pushed, capable and cared for, and that they get bigger scope before someone else offers it.
  • You'll make sure we don't keep the people we shouldn't. You'll run a talent review with every leader each quarter (who is exceptional, who is solid, who should not be here in six months), track regretted and non-regretted attrition by team, and push managers to part ways when they need to, fairly and clearly, coaching them through direct feedback, clear expectations, performance plans and well-documented exits.
  • You'll tell any leader, including the CEO, when they're hiring below the bar, protecting a weak performer, or avoiding a hard conversation.
  • You'll ensure our culture scales as we scale globally. You believe in the value of international and remote work. Our team is distributed across 12+ countries.

Build the leadership bench and the systems behind it

  • You'll partner with the executive team to build a bench of phenomenal leaders. We're building our leadership bench; your job is to make sure that in 18 months we have the leaders we need, whether we grow them or hire them.
  • You'll keep the leadership team on the same page: what stage each department is in, what it needs most right now, and where we need to align.
  • You'll make our four (typically international) offsites per year count. You'll understand why we're there, what each department would benefit most from, and how we make the most of our time together. The executive assistant, who reports to you, runs the logistics.
  • You'll make onboarding phenomenal, especially for leaders, so new people are effective and feel the mission in their first weeks.
  • You'll build the strategies and systems that let us do all of this at scale: how we level and compensate people, replacing case-by-case decisions; how we review performance; and how we part ways fairly, predictably and without delay. Our recruiters, our executive assistants, and our (now-fractional) HR Business Partner will report to you.

What we're looking for

  • You have 8+ years in people leadership, including a seat at the executive table at a company of 250+ people, where you owned talent and culture rather than administered them.
  • You can identify extraordinary talent and explain what makes it so. You've personally brought in people other companies couldn't get, you're well-networked enough to do it again, and you've hired and managed recruiters who could too.
  • You're an author of culture, and you take that responsibility seriously. You know what a strong culture feels like from the inside, you can name the handful of things that make it so, and you hold the company to them. You're direct, firm and hard to talk out of a position, and you want to push and be pushed by the co-founders as a peer.
  • You're a strategic, systematic executive, not an HR business partner. The ATS, HRIS and payroll are already running; your work is the thinking behind compensation, leadership, performance and retention, and the judgment to make clear calls and see them through. You've designed comp philosophies, grown first-time managers into real leaders, and made exits fair and fast.

How we work

We're a fast-growing, YC-backed company built on curiosity, a bias toward action, and a founder mindset. We'd rather ship something small and learn than debate it for a month. You'll report directly to Ellie Lasater-Guttmann, a cofounder. You will sit on the leadership team.

Job Overview:

The Database Engineering Team at ExploreK12 is looking for a Senior Database Engineer to be responsible for providing database support and strategy for our database ecosystem. Database administration includes production support, upgrades, performance tuning, disaster recovery as well as helping set and enforce database level controls and standards for the applications team.


This is an individual contributor role with significant technical influence, you'll set database standards and best practices that application engineering teams follow, without direct reports. This role reports to the Systems Manager and will often collaborate with the engineering teams offering guidance.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Replication configuration and management
  • SQL query plan analysis and optimization
  • Backup and restoration management
  • Application query optimization
  • Enhances the effectiveness of database tools and services
  • Enhances the scalability and performance of existing database structures
  • Work with system engineers to maintain and monitor backup processes and test restorations including disaster recovery
  • Work with the infrastructure and other internal teams (e.g. developers and product managers) to identify system requirements
  • Monitor system performance and alerts to identify current and future problems
  • Ethical handling of private data
  • Minimize database downtime and maximize database reliability
  • Predict capacity requirements
  • Help review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback
  • Keeps up to date with technological developments

Job Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience with engineering and/or administering databases
  • Hands on, professional experience building and operating performance critical applications and databases, with significant experience in both MySQL/Linux and SQL Server/Windows environments
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases including normalization, indexing and SQL
  • Knowledge of data security and integrity
  • Knowledge of a high-volume SaaS database environment
  • Exceptional communications skills (verbal, written, illustrative/diagrammatic)
  • Ability to build strong relationships

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with student-data privacy frameworks (e.g. FERPA) strongly preferred given the nature of our platform
  • Knowledge of PHP or other scripting languages
  • Experience with NoSQL databases
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process
  • Recent experience with iPaaS and/or canonical data models
  • Experience leading or contributing to an on-prem to cloud migration, as this role may help shape ExploreK12's future cloud strategy specifically AWS

Why Work for Us

When you join ExploreK12™, you become part of a mission to help educators unlock brighter futures for every student.


As a trusted leader in educational technology, we serve more than 17 million students and educators across 150+ countries with innovative, research-backed learning solutions that truly make a difference. Our flagship products—Gizmos™, Raz-Plus®, and Reflex™—are beloved by educators and students alike for being as practical and effective as they are fun.


To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit .


Remote First Work Environment

Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren.
jobs.description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Hilf dabei, Shopware-Produkte sicherer zu machen, indem du während der gesamten Produktentwicklung Sicherheitsrisiken aufdeckst und reduzierst. Du arbeitest mit den Produktentwicklungsteams daran, Schwachstellen zu untersuchen, sichere Konzepte und Tests zu verbessern und praxisnahe Maßnahmen aufzubauen, die wiederkehrende Probleme in Commerce Core, Services und angrenzenden Produktbereichen verhindern.

Product Security Engineering ist eine Engineering-Funktion. Die Produktteams bleiben dafür verantwortlich, ihren eigenen Code zu korrigieren und zu testen. Dieses Team bringt gezielte Sicherheitsexpertise, eine gemeinsame Roadmap zur Prävention und eine klare Koordination für produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit ein.

Requirements

  • Untersuche Schwachstellenmeldungen, Sicherheitswarnungen, interne Findings und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen. Bewerte die technischen Auswirkungen und unterstütze dabei, bestätigte Aufgaben an die zuständigen Product Owner weiterzuleiten.

  • Arbeite direkt mit Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern an sicherem Design, Threat Models, Code Reviews, Ursachenanalysen, Fixes und Regressionstests für besonders risikoreiche Produktbereiche.

  • Entwickle und verbessere wiederverwendbare Sicherheitskontrollen, Leitfäden für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien und praxisnahe Automatisierung zur Erkennung und Behebung von Schwachstellen.

  • Unterstütze dabei, für Product-Security-Findings klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Schweregrade, Reaktionsziele, betroffene Versionen und Nachweise zum Abschluss festzuhalten.

  • Arbeite mit den Engineering-Teams von Commerce Core und Services an Sicherheitsaufgaben über verschiedene Repositories, unterstützte Versionen, APIs, Integrationen und das Extension-Ökosystem hinweg.

  • Unterstütze koordinierte Sicherheits-Releases: Ermittle betroffene Bereiche, prüfe technische Behebungen und stimme dich mit Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel ab.

  • Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases in konkrete Änderungen am Engineering, Tests oder Tools. Verfolge anschließend nach, ob diese Maßnahmen übernommen werden.

  • Kommuniziere bei zeitkritischen Aufgaben klar und dokumentiere Entscheidungen in den vereinbarten GitHub- und Confluence-Einträgen, damit Teams den Status nicht aus Slack-Verläufen rekonstruieren müssen.

  • Wirke an gemeinsamen Teampraktiken mit und vertrete bei Bedarf den anderen Produktbereich.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und Interesse an Produkt- oder Anwendungssicherheit.

  • Praktische Kenntnisse typischer Risiken in der Anwendungssicherheit, etwa Schwachstellen bei Authentifizierung und Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, Injection und Abhängigkeiten.

  • Die Fähigkeit, produktiven Code und Tests zu lesen und zu ändern, Risiken für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler verständlich zu erklären und wartbare Fixes mit umzusetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit Threat Modeling, Sicherheitstests, Schwachstellenanalysen oder Secure Code Reviews; in einigen Bereichen bringst du fundiertes Wissen mit, in anderen möchtest du dich weiterentwickeln.

  • Gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Einschätzung von Schweregrad, Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden und Ausnutzbarkeit sowie bei der Frage, wann ein Problem sofort eskaliert werden muss.

  • Klare schriftliche Kommunikation und die Fähigkeit, bei unklaren oder dringenden Aufgaben teamübergreifend zusammenzuarbeiten.

  • Kenntnisse von PHP sowie mit Shopwares Produkten, Services oder dem Extension-Ökosystem sind hilfreich.

  • Erfahrung mit Sicherheitsautomatisierung, etwa Dependency Scanning, SAST, Fuzzing oder Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien, ist ein Plus.

Woran du deinen Erfolg erkennst:

  • Findings werden einheitlich bewertet, schnell an die zuständigen Verantwortlichen weitergeleitet und mit einem sichtbaren Reaktionsziel und Abschlussnachweis versehen.

  • Produktteams erhalten zeitnah praxisnahe Unterstützung bei Sicherheitsthemen und behalten zugleich die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung.

  • Sicherheitsprüfungen und Tests erkennen relevante Risiken vor dem Release. Wo sinnvoll, enthalten Fixes passende Regressionstests.

  • Aus Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases entstehen konkrete, verantwortete Präventionsmaßnahmen statt ausschließlich einmaliger Patches.

  • Umfang von Sicherheits-Releases, betroffene Versionen, technische Verantwortliche und Validierungsbedarf sind für Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel klar dokumentiert.

  • Im primären Produktbereich des Engineers wächst die Sicherheitsexpertise. Gleichzeitig teilt das Team Standards und unterstützt sich bei Bedarf über Produktgrenzen hinweg.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Josephine Scheffler und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier.

Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: an HCP engagement product that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn events into a company’s most effective engagement channel.

This position is the ideal role for experienced talents in tech/services sales. With a self-driven resilient mindset, positive energy, and strong business acumen, you'll thrive in a fast paced environment. You will negotiate multi-year enterprise contracts, drive revenue and usage growth across our largest Fortune 500 accounts, and shape the long-term success of our most valued partnerships. Our top-performing Account Directors typically progress to sales leadership roles.

The Account Director role is key in our sales team and reports directly to the VP of Account Management. Following our Onomi launch, life sciences expansion pipeline is the #1 company objective, and driving revenue growth within existing customers is a key component.

As the account leader, you will be the primary point of contact for 7-15 key accounts with a total revenue of ~$3M and:

  • [40%] Identify and close expansion, upgrade and renewal opportunities.
  • [20%] Account retention and expansion plan execution: inserting Onomi into centers of excellence and delivery units, designing operating procedures for flawless execution, coordinating implementation and key integrations, evangelizing buying centers, functions and geo/affiliates with workshops and webinars, and partner engagement, briefing and certification.
  • [15%] Build relationships with key account stakeholders: engaging with new users, fostering trust-based relationships with champions and above-event stakeholders (commercial excellence, medical, IT, procurement), establishing open lines of communication with economic buyers, influencing HQ-prescribed technology usage guidelines, facilitating introductions and exec touchpoints at director/VP level with a meaningful briefing, demonstrating value in absolute ROI terms, and securing customer presence at customer advisory boards and 3rd-party events and roundtables.
  • [10%] Perform account research, mapping and planning: capturing intelligence on organization design, strategic priorities, Onomi's share of wallet, other vendors' scope, and integration, usage and investments for each use case; understanding budget cycles; partner mapping; and creating pricing benchmarks against other solutions.
  • [10%] Handle first-line account compliance, administrative and product inquiries.
  • [5%] Report on sales activities: CRM updates, sales forecasts and pipeline calls.

Objectives - The problems you will solve

In your first 1 month, you will:

  • Join our leadership team at live industry events: staff the booth at tradeshows and walk congresses with them
  • Master our core sales plays: rehearse them, listen to past winning calls, and successfully conduct an expansion mock demo call that convinces the team you can do it alone
  • Master our sales processes and systems (Salesforce, Google Suite, PowerPoint, Fathom) to be able to manage a sales lifecycle from customer request to contract expansion deals autonomously
  • Get introduced to all customers in your portfolio and secure face time with 80% of them.

In your first 3 months, you will:

  • Close your first deal autonomously
  • Identify 2 expansion levers for each account, with goals and steps documented in Salesforce
  • Attend your first congress solo, with a pre-event target list, a floor contact log, and 100% follow-up
  • Complete your account research and planning for every account in your portfolio, including renewal strategy and budget insertion

After the first 6 months, key indicators (usage and logo revenue) are trending up

After 12 months, you will:

  • Have met 100% of your customer portfolio in person at least once and met 1-3 new influential stakeholders per account
  • Have executed your account plans and achieved an aggregate 20% YoY revenue growth on your portfolio through services and/or software expansion

What you need to be great at:

  • Account leadership: You are above all a true account leader in B2B SaaS or services/consulting - you have managed large accounts ($200K-$2M) in large companies (>500 employees) over time, and you are able to truly understand the decision-making process and buying centers, and establish and nurture relationships with key people to expand scope and volume. You know what it means to operate a global, large-scale account in a first-class fashion.
  • Industry expertise with business orientation: You bring SaaS experience selling into critical industries - pharma, financial services, professional services, or tech - with demonstrated experience working with the most demanding customers. Above all, you have a flair for spotting pain points, helping customers form business cases, and guiding them towards execution. Pharma HCP engagement expertise, with all its nuances (medical, commercial, marketing), is a plus but not a must.
  • Autonomy and resourcefulness: You make decisions with confidence and don't wait to be told what to do. When you hit a wall, you find a way around it - you are scrappy, creative, and solution-oriented by nature. You move fast and act proactively, even when there is no immediate commercial upside.
  • Commercial sharpness: You run numbers quickly, think several steps ahead in negotiations, and understand what truly drives your customers' business. You can build a solid business case that holds up in front of a C-suite or procurement team, and you are comfortable making decisions and forming working hypotheses even when you don't have all the facts.

is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. Preferred:

Important information for candidates

The Marketing Execution Specialist is responsible for executing high-quality marketing campaigns while producing in-house design assets that adhere to the company’s brand guidelines. This role is execution-focused, combining campaign deployment, design production, and operational support. The specialist ensures that marketing initiatives are delivered consistently, accurately, and on time, across multiple platforms.

Key Responsibilities


Marketing Execution
  • Build, format, and send email campaigns using Mailchimp or other CRM platforms (ActiveCampaign experience is a plus, not required).
  • Create and maintain email templates and manage campaign calendars and timelines.
  • Support event marketing initiatives, including invitations, reminders, and follow-up communications.
  • Repurpose marketing content across channels (email, social, events, etc.) while maintaining brand consistency.
  • Ensure campaigns are executed cleanly, accurately, and on schedule.
Design Execution
  • Create marketing assets including emails, event graphics, social posts, and collateral using Canva and/or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Work strictly within the existing brand guide, adhering to logos, colors, fonts, and layout rules.
  • Prepare professional-ready assets that are clean, visually consistent, and deployment-ready.
  • Execute designs efficiently, focusing on quality, speed, and brand alignment without overcomplicating.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Strong execution skills; able to deliver marketing campaigns and design assets reliably and on time.
  • Comfortable owning both marketing deployment and design production tasks.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven, able to follow templates, systems, and direction without friction.
  • Experienced with CRM platforms (back-end familiarity) and marketing automation tools.
  • Portfolio demonstrates high-quality design work, tasteful execution, and alignment with brand standards.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Proficiency in Mailchimp or equivalent email marketing platforms.
  • Experience with text-based marketing platforms a plus.
  • Strong Canva skills; Adobe Creative Suite experience preferred.
  • Familiarity with CRMs (campaign execution, automation workflows, not just data entry).
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills for handling campaign calendars and multiple projects.
  • Ability to create clean, professional marketing assets that follow established brand guidelines.

Benefits

  • Above market salary
  • HMO on Day 1 for principal and two dependents
  • Government-mandated benefits
  • Performance-based Incentives
  • Quarterly Company Events
  • 1,000 PHP De Minimis
  • Equipment and software provided

jobs.description:
Customer Success Lead
Recycled materials
Location: Remote — Europe

About MineHub

At MineHub, we’re transforming how the world’s largest producers, traders, and consumers manage raw material supply chains. Our solutions combine critical B2B marketplace functionality (handling high-volume transactions for global supply chains) with intuitive B2C design, enabling customers to streamline logistics, reduce costs, and build more resilient, sustainable operations through real-time data integration and predictive analytics.
Jules extends MineHub’s offering into the recycled materials industry. Scrap and secondary-materials traders, recyclers and brokers use Jules to run their business end to end: buying and selling; managing inventory across yards and stockpiles; container, bulk, and truck logistics; trade documentation; invoicing and payments; and price-risk management.

The Role

We're looking for a Customer Success Lead to own customer success for the Jules platform. You'll combine a strong understanding of commodity supply chains with the leadership to build and develop a small, high-performing CSM team. You'll personally own our most strategic accounts while setting the standards, processes, and priorities the rest of the team works to. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll be as comfortable running a go-live with a customer's operations team as you are coaching a CSM or making the case to Product for what our customers need next. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll collaborate across CS, Product, Engineering, Sales and leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop the Jules CSM team: set clear expectations, give regular feedback, support career growth, and help hire as the team scales.
  • Own the Jules customer portfolio's health, retention and expansion, and report on it to leadership with clear, commercially grounded metrics.
  • Personally manage our most strategic and complex accounts, from implementation through to renewal and expansion.
  • Build and continuously improve the team's playbooks: onboarding and go-live, data migration, health monitoring, QBRs, renewals and escalations.
  • Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering: synthesise feedback across accounts, frame it in commercial and operational terms, and influence roadmap priorities.
  • Partner with Sales on pre-sales scoping, handover and expansion opportunities, ensuring what we sell can be delivered and adopted. (This is not a quota-carrying role.)
  • Work with your counterparts across MineHub to share best practice and align ways of working across the group's platforms.

Experience & Skills

  • Experience in recycled materials, metals or wider commodities trade is a strong advantage. If you're coming from an adjacent background, you'll be keen to learn how recycled materials are sourced, graded, shipped and documented, and to pick up the industry's terminology quickly.
  • Experience leading, mentoring or coaching others, formally or informally: you've raised the performance of the people around you and set a standard others follow.
  • Leadership qualities we'll look for at interview: sound judgement under pressure, clear prioritisation, ownership, the ability to give direct and constructive feedback, and the credibility to lead both internally and in front of customers.
  • A strong track record of managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts and software implementations, with measurable outcomes in adoption, retention or expansion.
  • Strong professional English. French is a plus, as we work with a number of French-speaking customers.
  • Comfortable with technical topics: data set-up, document workflows, data imports, integrations and reporting. You can get into the detail yourself and guide your team through it. SQL or BI tool experience is a plus.
  • Commercially minded. You understand how our customers make money, from margins to logistics costs and price risk, and can tie platform value to their P&L.
  • Process-oriented without being bureaucratic. You introduce structure that helps a small team scale, and you know when to keep things simple.
  • You're a self-starter who embraces ambiguity and enjoys building something, not just running it.

Why MineHub?

  • Help build the digital backbone of the circular economy, in an industry where secondary raw materials are becoming strategically critical.
  • Join a mission-driven team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term thinking in everything from customer relationships to code.
  • Be part of a fast-growing company that combines startup energy with partnerships across major industry players worldwide.
  • Enjoy the freedom to lead initiatives, own your accounts, and shape how recycled materials businesses experience our platform.

About Us : AI compute is hitting a hard physical wall, and memory bottlenecks are throttling the entire industry. Founded in October 2024 and backed by €57M in funding, Vertical Compute is solving this with proprietary Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM™) chiplets, making AI hardware faster, greener, and vastly more scalable. We are an interdisciplinary team transforming breakthrough semiconductor physics into commercial reality.

Why Now : After 18 months of intensive R&D, Vertical Compute has reached a critical inflection point. Our underlying technology is validated, and we have successfully met our core technical milestones. Armed with a proven technical data package and ongoing system studies, we are now shifting from pure R&D to active engagement with global enterprise customers. As we prepare for our next phase of scale and growth starting in 2027, joining us today means taking direct ownership of the hardware foundation that will power the next era of AI compute.

About the role:

We are looking for a 3D Integration / Chiplet Expert to define and implement 2.5D/3D advanced packaging solutions for our Vertical Integrated Memory (VIM) technology. You will collaborate across teams to define optimal interconnect strategies and die stacking approaches to enable high-bandwidth, low-power operation. This job sits at the intersection of SoC architecture (specifically the physical design) , package design, and 3D manufacturing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Integration Architecture & Process Definition:
    Develop and define architectures for 2.5D/3D stacking of VIM chiplets with compute chiplets.
    Collaborate with design and technology teams to develop interconnect solutions that ensure high bandwidth and low latency.
    Define clearly the impact of the chiplet physical design chiplets (through-silicon vias, micro-bumps, hybrid bonds, redistribution layers, and chiplet interfaces, …)
    define fabrication flows and design rules with foundries, packaging partners, and internal physical design teams

  • Performance Analysis & Simulation: Conduct early multi-physics simulations (thermal, electrical, mechanical) to analyze and optimize the performance and reliability of integrated systems.
    drive external partners for final package design

  • Collaboration & Communication:Partner closely with design, process engineering, metrology, and system architecture teams.
    Participate in conferences, standardization bodies and industry events to promote or lead discussions about the future of chiplet integration.

  • Technical Leadership:Provide
    technical leadership and project management guidance to multidisciplinary teams.

About the team:

This role is part of the Product & system team, partnering closely with our cross-functional engineering teams in Product & system and Memory Design. We foster a highly collaborative, inclusive environment where strong alignment, high transparency and seamless team coordination are central to our shared success.

Requirements

About who you are:

  • You’ve spent 5–10 years exploring the frontiers of 2.5D/3D packaging and heterogeneous integration, turning complex ideas into manufacturable systems.

  • You have a deep understanding on the SoC physical design, TSVs, Redistribution Layers, hybrid bonding and how they are used at system level to implement chip IOs (Functional and power IOs)

  • You are mastering Integrity 3D-IC Platform to define the chiplets interface, to define 3D stacking system, to generate the 3Dblox views, and to run all the 3D system level analysis (Power Delivery Network, Thermal, STA, LVS, SI/PI, …)

  • You thrive where architecture meets technology — translating ambitious concepts into elegant, high-performance designs.

  • Multi-physics isn’t just theory to you; you use thermal, electrical, and mechanical simulations to see the whole system clearly.

  • You’re naturally collaborative — just as comfortable in technical deep dives as you are building bridges between design, process, and system teams.

  • You’re the kind of engineer who balances vision with execution: leading projects, mentoring peers, and pushing boundaries with a calm hand.

  • Above all, you’re curious — drawn to the challenge of building something new and meaningful at the intersection of memory, compute, and packaging innovation.

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication abilities.

Why Join Us:

  • You will get the opportunity to work at the forefront of memory technology innovation.

  • Vertical Compute is not only a state-of-the art but also a human adventure. We believe you must have a lot of fun developing the best of you. Making sure you and your team are going to enjoy the journey and become passionate about what we do is a key goal of our founders.

  • You can be part of a talented and dedicated team in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • In this role, you contribute to projects that will have a significant impact on the future of computing and electronics.

  • You can count on a motivating total rewards package.

  • Flexible ways of working.

Join us in shaping the future of compute & memory technology — and celebrating success!

jobs.description:
Please note that we are unable to consider applications from candidates based in France, Italy, or Germany for this role.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

MetaMask is a self-custody wallet that does not hold users’ private keys. Blockchain transactions are generally irreversible, meaning a vulnerability in the product or its software delivery chain can lead directly to financial losses for users. As a result, MetaMask attracts sustained attention from financially motivated attackers and sophisticated supply chain actors.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Application Security to lead application security across the MetaMask extension, mobile app, Snaps, backend services, DeFi primitives, stablecoins, and supporting smart contracts.

The role covers architecture, code, dependencies, build and release controls, security testing, and vulnerability disclosure. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and operating model, lead a small senior team, and remain directly involved in code review and threat modelling.

You will report to the Head of Security and work closely with MetaMask Engineering leadership to ensure security risks are understood, owned, and addressed.

Responsibilities

Leadership and planning

  • Lead and develop the Application Security team, including hiring, performance management and career development, while remaining directly involved in technical work.
  • Set the Application Security strategy, annual goals and quarterly OKRs in line with company objectives and the approved Target Operating Model. Define and track KPIs to measure performance and progress.
  • Report AppSec progress, coverage, remediation performance and material gaps to Security leadership and contribute to Risk Committee reporting.

Secure design and delivery

  • Define security review requirements across development and release, assess whether they are met and escalate unresolved risks.
  • Lead threat modelling and security design reviews across clients, APIs and backend services, including authentication, key management, signing and delegated actions. Assess trust boundaries across the full system and participate in architecture and RFC reviews.
  • Define software supply chain security requirements and work with engineering teams to implement and validate controls for dependencies, builds, artefacts and publishing.
  • Lead security code reviews across MetaMask applications and smart contracts, working with engineers and relevant specialists to address findings.
  • Define and evolve the secure development lifecycle to incorporate AI agents, including their access, actions and human review requirements. Set security standards for AI development tools, generated code and AI components in products.
  • Integrate security testing into development and delivery workflows, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency scanning, secrets detection and AI scanning. Evaluate tools and validate their findings.
  • Help engineers prevent recurring vulnerabilities through secure coding guidance, reusable libraries, training and the security champions programme.

Vulnerability management and external testing

  • Own application vulnerability assessment, triage, prioritisation and remediation tracking within the organisation’s vulnerability management framework. Correlate findings across clients, services and supporting infrastructure with the relevant owners to assess combined impact. Ensure findings have clear owners and deadlines, verify fixes and escalate overdue risks.
  • Set the scope and proposed investment for bug bounty, penetration testing and AI security scanning based on risk and results. Manage external providers, researcher relationships, rewards and payouts, and coordinate vulnerability disclosure.

Assurance and incident support

  • Provide evidence of application security controls for audits and assurance reviews, and support customer and partner due diligence.
  • Provide application security expertise during incidents, including vulnerability analysis and remediation support.

Qualifications

Required:

  • At least eight years in application security or software engineering with a security focus, including two years leading people.
  • Strong practical code review skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or Solidity across browser extensions, mobile applications and backend services, with the ability to identify vulnerabilities and work with engineers to fix them.
  • Proven experience securing applications across clients and backend services, including distributed authentication, authorisation and key management.
  • Experience building or substantially improving an AppSec programme, including security reviews, automated testing, AI scanning, vulnerability management and developer support, with sound judgement on where AI adds value and how to validate its findings.
  • Practical experience securing software supply chains, including dependency policies, software composition analysis, npm, artefact integrity and CI/CD.
  • Experience running bug bounty and penetration testing programmes, including selecting and managing external providers.
  • Working knowledge of EVM smart contract security, including common vulnerabilities, review methods, upgrade and admin controls, and assessing external audits.
  • A record of delivering security improvements through engineering teams outside your reporting line.
  • Clear written communication, from actionable threat models to concise summaries of risk for executives.

Preferred:

  • Offensive security qualifications such as OSCP, OSWE or OSWA, or a proven record in bug bounty programmes or CTF competitions.
  • Experience securing browser extensions or mobile applications.
  • Experience securing development workflows that use AI, or AI components in production applications.
  • Experience in crypto, Web3 or another sector facing sustained attacks, such as fintech, payments or infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of or a strong interest in applied cryptography.
  • Familiarity with attacks by state actors against software companies, particularly DPRK supply chain and social engineering campaigns.
  • Experience providing evidence of secure development controls for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 assessments.

Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

In the rapidly evolving Web3 space, we believe that everyone is a builder. This expansive paradigm requires a range of backgrounds, talents, skills, and experiences to influence and shape the future. At MetaMask, this diversity fuels our ability to shift control and redefine the realm of possibility. We are committed to ensuring that our technology empowers people and communities through decentralized technologies. We welcome the range of perspectives and differences and celebrate them. We're excited to see how your unique skills as a builder can contribute to our vision, drive innovation, and help us shape a more inclusive Web3.

Customer Transformation Specialist

Location: LATAM · Work Model: Fully remote · Language: Spanish + English C1/C2

About Koronet

Koronet is the leading vertical SaaS, B2B e-commerce, and payments software company for the over $50 Billion global B2B floral industry. Our solution consists of an inventory and operations management SaaS solution and an e-commerce network that enables end-to-end transactions through the B2B supply chain. Managing many of the largest businesses in the industry, our products help keep florists’ shelves stocked, weddings brightly bloomed, and Valentine’s Day brilliant red.

We are the parent company to the leading ERP, operations and e-commerce solutions in the floral industry, including Komet Sales, Axerrio and UNOSOF. The company has teams in Florida, Ecuador, Argentina, Uruguay, Netherlands and Colombia. Our global Network of partners includes hundreds of flower growers, importers, and wholesalers who collectively represent a material portion of the global flower market. Our mission is to be the unified operating floral supply chain by providing mission-critical business operations solutions powering the largest B2B e-commerce network.

We are a fast-growing company backed by a leading growth equity fund, fueling our expansion across North America and Europe through both organic growth and acquisitions.

Why this role exists:

We help customers get more value from Koronet by changing how they work—whether that’s buying smarter, serving their own buyers better, or cutting out friction.

Role Overview:

We’re one team with one goal: delivering actual value. We share what we learn from customers, help our colleagues succeed, and focus on outcomes, not just checking boxes like 'completed call' or 'closed ticket.'

Transactions at Koronet:

Transactions connects how our customers actually work with what our platform can do. We sit between customer feedback and product development, turning what we see in the field into real product improvements. We don't just 'do tasks'—we look for ways to solve problems and use what we learn to make the whole platform better for everyone.

What you will do:

  • Understand how customers operate: buying, selling, inventory, and operational friction.
  • Guide customers to get more value by suggesting practical behavior changes.
  • Lead discovery to uncover real constraints and trade-offs rather than surface-level issues.
  • Give honest advice on what Koronet can do, what needs a workaround, and what isn't possible yet.
  • Treat objections as valuable feedback, not personal rejection.
  • Drive adoption through testing, follow-through, and clear evidence of progress.
  • Share field insights with Product, Support, Marketing, and Sales to improve our product and strategy.

How you will work with other departments

  • CS & Implementation: Prioritize measurable customer value over "completed tasks."
  • Product & Support: Provide specific evidence, workflows, and outcomes to guide development.
  • Marketing & Revenue: Use real-world feedback to improve messaging and targeting.
  • Growth Systems: Use account data to prepare for smarter, more relevant conversations.

What success looks like

  • Increased digital buying and selling in our ecosystem
  • The team understands exactly why actions succeed or fail and applies that learning.
  • Customers trust us because we’re transparent and don't oversell.
  • The wider team gets clear, early feedback that makes our product and workflows better.

A few things this role isn't!

  • A reactive ticket-queue owner or a replacement for implementation.
  • A quota-chaser who makes promises other teams have to clean up.
  • A project coordinator focused only on tracking activity.
  • A silo; you are the direct link between our customers and our product team.

What do we expect from you:

  • Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or B2B operational transformation.
  • Fluent in English (must).
  • Enjoy speaking with customers and feel comfortable leading difficult conversations.
  • Listen well and communicate clearly, connecting changes to real customer incentives.
  • Handle objections with curiosity and use them to improve future conversations.
  • Has strong organizing skills.
  • Team Player, who shares information and puts company goals first.
  • Experience in the floriculture industry will be considered a strong plus.

What We Offer:

  • An independent, flexible, and versatile role within a fast-growing international organization.
  • Flexible / Remote working environment.
  • We encourage continuous learning and professional growth.

Why Join Koronet:

  • Global and Remote-First: Work with a diverse team across the Americas and Europe, with flexibility to work from anywhere.
  • Ownership Culture: We foster an environment where each team member takes ownership and is empowered to contribute to the company's success.
  • Growth & Development: We support continuous professional growth and offer financial assistance for technical certifications and other learning opportunities.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary and an indefinite contract, with salary negotiable based on experience.

If you're passionate about making an impact and growing with a dynamic, remote-first company, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: FP&A Manager
jobs.excerpt: About UsMighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events.
jobs.description:
About Us

Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Through its advanced technology, called people magic, Mighty helps the members of those networks build relationships with each other by surfacing the most relevant and interesting connections.

Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M.

The Role

You own FP&A at Mighty. That means the operating model, the forecast, the budget, the monthly reporting, and the analysis leadership uses to make decisions. You take a business question, find the data, build the model, and come back with an answer and a point of view, without needing someone to lay out the steps for you.

Our SaaS community platform is the core of the business, and the launch of people magic ai will complement it. You will help leadership understand how the business is performing and where to invest.

You report to our Head of Finance and work closely with our accounting team and with leaders across product, engineering, sales, success, and marketing. This is an individual contributor role for someone who has done this work before and wants to own it.

What You'll Own

  • You will own the company operating model and rolling forecast, covering revenue, headcount, operating expenses, and cash, and keep it current as the business changes
  • You will run the annual budget and the regular reforecast process, working with department leaders to build their plans and hold them to them
  • You will produce monthly budget versus actuals reporting and variance analysis, explaining what moved and why in terms leadership can act on
  • You will build and maintain the SaaS metrics that describe the business, including ARR, MRR, churn, retention, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, and gross margin
  • You will model pricing, packaging, and new product scenarios and show what each one does to revenue, margin, and cash
  • You will track and forecast our cost structure, including hosting, infrastructure, and third party software spend
  • You will prepare the financial materials for board meetings and investor updates alongside our Head of Finance
  • You will partner with accounting on the close so the numbers in the model tie to the books, and improve the systems and processes that get data from source to report
  • You will take on ad hoc analysis for leadership, from hiring plans to vendor decisions to new product bets, and turn it around quickly

What We're Looking For

  • You have five or more years in FP&A, with meaningful time at a subscription software or SaaS company, and you have owned a forecast rather than contributed to one
  • You can build a three-statement operating model from scratch and are fluent enough in Excel and Google Sheets that your models are clean, flexible, and easy for someone else to follow
  • You know SaaS metrics well and can explain how they connect to each other and to cash
  • You understand accounting well enough to work closely with a controller and staff accountants, including revenue recognition, accruals, and how the close works
  • You work independently, you know what good looks like without being told, and you bring a recommendation along with the analysis
  • You communicate clearly with people who are not in finance, and you can walk a department leader through their numbers in a way that changes what they do
  • You are comfortable pulling data from systems such as Stripe, our general ledger, a CRM, and our product database
  • You use AI tools as part of how you work, beyond prompting, whether that is building reusable skills or agents, wiring tools together to automate reporting, or knowing which parts of the workflow should stay manual
  • You are accurate and careful with detail, because leadership will make real decisions on your numbers

Bonus, none required. Any one of these moves a candidate up the list.

  • You have modeled a pricing change or a new product launch at a subscription business
  • You have worked at a creator, community, or marketplace business where revenue flows through the platform to customers
  • You have been the first or only FP&A hire and built the function's models and reporting yourself
  • You are comfortable with SQL or willing to get there quickly

DistantJob is looking for a Senior .NET Integration Engineer to join one of our clients, a fintech company whose platform automates accounts payable, payments and financial operations for investment firms, family offices and fund administrators. Their customers rely on the platform to connect with the accounting systems they already use, so the integration layer is central to the product.

The role

You'll design, build and own the integrations that link the platform to ERP and accounting systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage and Microsoft Dynamics. You'll work closely with a Staff Engineer and take real ownership, from scoping through production. You'll spend your time on:

  • Building and improving REST and SOAP integrations that hold up against messy real-world customer setups
  • Designing sync, mapping, validation and reconciliation workflows that keep data accurate between systems
  • Handling partial failures, retries and eventual consistency, with idempotency and audit trails built in
  • Improving performance and reliability, adding logging and alerting, and finding the root cause when an integration breaks
  • Working with the onboarding and support teams to get customers connected and live
  • Contributing to code reviews, documentation and engineering standards

This team is also actively adopting AI-assisted development with tools like Cursor, Claude Code and GitHub Copilot, so you'll have room to work that way.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of software engineering with production systems
  • Strong C# and .NET, including backend services and APIs
  • Proven experience integrating with ERP, accounting or financial systems
  • Solid knowledge of REST and SOAP, including authentication, error handling, retries and versioning
  • Experience with data synchronization, transformation and reconciliation
  • Strong SQL Server skills: query design, optimization and data modeling
  • Experience with event-driven or message-based architectures
  • Independence and clear communication with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders

Bonus points for:

  • Hands-on NetSuite, QuickBooks, Sage or Dynamics integration work
  • A background in fintech, payments, AP or fund administration
  • Azure experience (Service Bus, Functions, API Management)
  • SFTP, EDI or file-based integration patterns
  • Python for scripting and tooling
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience
  • Observability practices such as structured logging and tracing
  • Daily use of AI coding tools

Details

  • Location: Fully remote
  • Schedule: US business hours, Central time preferred but can work in Eastern time
  • Type: Full-time and long-term
  • Time off: 10 paid vacation days and 8 paid national holidays per year

Why this one?

You'll own the integration layer of a growing platform, not just pick tickets off a backlog. The team collaborates closely, and the company is serious about its engineering standards.

Ready to make two systems agree on something? Apply and one of our recruiters will be in touch.

If you meet these qualifications and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Data Engineering Tech Lead (LatAm Only)
jobs.excerpt: At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society.
jobs.description:
At R2, we believe that small and medium businesses are the productive engine of society. Small and medium businesses (SMBs) make up over 90% of companies in Latin America, yet they face a trillion-dollar credit gap. Our mission is to unlock SMBs' potential by providing financial solutions that are tailored to their needs. We are reimagining the financial infrastructure of Latin America, where SMBs' financial needs are satisfied without ever having to go to a bank.

R2 enables platforms to embed financial services that SMBs can then leverage, starting with revenue-based financing. We are a tight-knit team coming from organizations such as Google, Amazon, Nubank, Uber, Capital One, Mercado Libre, Globant and J.P. Morgan.

We are entering a new phase of growth following a strategic investment from Ant International, focused on rapidly expanding our partner footprint, strengthening our credit and underwriting capabilities, and scaling operations across multiple markets. As part of this growth journey, eligible team members have the opportunity to participate in R2’s Phantom Share Program, a performance-based incentive designed to align our team with the company’s long-term success and value creation. We believe in building a culture of ownership, where those who help create value share meaningfully in it.

As Data Engineering Tech Lead, you will be the senior technical authority for R2's data platform and the day-to-day leader of the Data Engineering team. You will report to the Director of Data Management.

You will own the architecture, technical roadmap, tooling and vendor decisions, reliability and cost of the platform behind ingestion, data processing, underwriting and our enterprise data warehouse.

The role evolves in three stages:

  1. Lead by influence. A hands-on lead engineer who sets technical direction and standards.
  2. Run the team. Own planning, prioritization and delivery for the Data Engineering team day to day.
  3. Manage people. Take on direct management of some of our Senior Data Engineers.

As we expand from Latin America into Europe, including a fully isolated EU data platform, you will shape how our data architecture scales across countries, legal entities and regulatory regimes.

What you will do

Architecture and technical direction

  • Own the target architecture of the data platform, including ingestion, cleaning, processing, the warehouse, Airflow orchestration and the data flows behind underwriting.
  • Lead architecture decisions together with the Director of Data, and set the principles the team designs against.
  • Define and own the Data Engineering technical roadmap, balancing business priorities, platform health and tech debt.
  • Lead tool and vendor evaluation, selection and contract input.
  • Design a multi-country, multi-entity platform, including a fully isolated EU data platform and the data residency rules around it.
  • Stay hands-on in the most critical and complex parts of the stack: Snowflake, Airflow DAGs, dbt and Python.

Reliability, operations and cost

  • Own the reliability, observability and SLAs of production pipelines.
  • Design the on-call rotation, incident response process and post-mortem practice.
  • Own Snowflake spend, including warehouse sizing, usage monitoring, budgets and cost-optimization practices.
  • Define and enforce engineering standards for modeling, testing, CI/CD, documentation and code review.
  • Introduce AI-enabled tooling and agents where they measurably improve productivity or data operations.

Team leadership and delivery

  • Run the Data Engineering team day to day: planning, prioritization, delivery cadence and unblocking.
  • Project-manage data initiatives end to end: scope, estimates, plans, tracking, and clear communication of risks and trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow Senior Data Engineers through design reviews, code reviews and regular feedback.
  • Take part in hiring, onboarding and shaping the team's structure as it grows.
  • Progressively take on people management for part of the team, including 1:1s, performance and career development.
  • Partner with Analytics, Product, Risk and Credit, ML, Engineering and Compliance to turn business needs into platform work.

Data governance, security and compliance

  • Co-own data governance with the Director of Data, covering data quality, lineage, cataloging and access control.
  • Design how PII is handled across the platform, including classification, masking, encryption, Snowflake role-based access, retention and deletion.
  • Make sure the platform meets regulatory and audit requirements, including GDPR in Europe, LGPD in Brazil, central bank and local regulatory reporting, and investor and partner requirements such as Ant International's.
  • Translate regulatory requirements into technical controls, evidence and documentation that hold up in an audit.

Who you are

  • 8–12+ years in Data Engineering or closely related roles.
  • Prior experience as a Principal or Staff Data Engineer, or as Tech Lead of a team of 4 or more engineers.
  • Proven team leadership and project management. You have run a team's delivery, led multi-quarter initiatives and managed stakeholders end to end.
  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Snowflake, including architecture, performance tuning, cost management and role-based security. This is required.
  • Advanced experience with Airflow and dbt in production.
  • Strong software engineering background with deep Python expertise, plus advanced SQL and dimensional / analytical data modeling.
  • Hands-on experience with ELT patterns and tools such as Airbyte or Fivetran.
  • Experience running data platforms on AWS.
  • Experience building or operating data platforms across multiple countries, legal entities or regulatory regimes. This is required.
  • Practical experience applying privacy and data protection regulations such as GDPR or LGPD, and building governance controls for PII.
  • Comfortable owning systems in production, including monitoring, alerting and incident response.
  • Able to explain technical trade-offs clearly to leadership and to Risk, Product and Compliance partners.
  • Professional English, plus Spanish or Portuguese.
  • Snowflake is a hard requirement. Profiles centered on Databricks or BigQuery without significant production Snowflake experience will not be a fit.

Bonus

  • Experience in fintech, lending, credit risk or underwriting data.
  • Experience standing up a data platform in the EU, or an isolated regional platform with strict data residency.
  • Experience with data catalog, lineage or data contract tooling.
  • Experience integrating AI/ML tooling or agents into data workflows, or building feature pipelines for ML models.
  • Experience designing self-serve analytics platforms.
  • Experience with cloud data cost management (FinOps) at scale.

What We Offer

  • The chance to join a high-impact, mission-driven fintech.
  • Ownership and impact in a fast-paced, growth-oriented startup.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with exceptional teams.
  • Exposure to complex regulatory challenges and innovation in embedded finance.

Locations: Buenos Aires, São Paulo, Bogotá, Santiago, Bogotá

jobs.description:
Brand Licensing Agent

Build and lead Wavelength’s licensing business in your market

Location: Worldwide - priority markets across North America, Europe, Middle East, Asia Pacific and Latin America
Working model: Brand Licensing agent
Company: Wavelength Network and our network of talent
Compensation: Partnership based on standard Licensing gross revenue share

About Wavelength

At Wavelength we are building a global social media, marketing and creator agency built around the power of talent, content and communities. Founded by the team behind the Extreme Sports Channel, we bring 30+ years of media and entertainment experience together with a global network of leading creators (Super Car Blondie), athletes and social publishing pages. Our network has 300 million+ followers and reaches 950 million+ views every month across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Snapchat and Facebook.

We create high impact marketing campaigns that connect brands with engaged audiences through creator partnerships, social storytelling, content production and live experiences across adventure, action sports, travel, automotive, fitness, wellness, beauty, technology, sustainability and entertainment.

The Opportunity

We are putting together a network of territory focused licensing agents around the world and looking for highly connected, commercially driven, deeply experienced brand licensing specialists who understand their local market and have the relationships, credibility and entrepreneurial drive to build a licensing business with us around some of the world's leading social media talent and social brands.

As a Country Licensing Agent, you will effectively become our partner and licensing representative in your territory. You will identify where our talent, brands, content and intellectual property can create commercial value and then find, pitch and develop the partners capable of bringing those opportunities to market.

Here is what you will be doing

Market Strategy & Planning

  • Develop a country specific licensing plan and strategy for Wavelength talent and IP

  • Creator and brand

  • Identify the most commercially attractive industry sectors and licensing categories

  • Map the local licensing ecosystem, including manufacturers, retailers, distributors, brands and potential licensees

  • Identify market gaps and opportunities for Wavelength talent and IP

  • Build an annual licensing pipeline and commercial plan

  • Recommend which Wavelength talent, properties and IP should be prioritised in your market

Business Development & Sales

  • Identify and qualify potential licensing partners

  • Build relationships with brands, Creators and licensees

  • Conduct targeted outreach and business development.

  • Generate new licensing opportunities

  • Present Wavelength's talent, properties and licensing opportunities to prospective partners

  • Lead commercial discussions and negotiations alongside Wavelength

  • Develop opportunities from initial conversation through to signed agreement

  • Continuously build and manage a strong licensing pipeline

We want agents who can answer a simple question:

Who should be licensing our talent and IP in your market and how do we get them to the table?

You will be expected to proactively identify opportunities across areas such as:

  • Consumer products

  • Apparel and fashion

  • Sports equipment

  • Automotive products and accessories

  • Travel products

  • Fitness and wellness

  • Beauty

  • Technology

  • Gaming

  • Publishing

  • Experiential

  • Collectibles

  • Digital products

  • Destination and tourism partnerships

  • Brand collaborations

  • Co-branded products and experiences

The opportunity is deliberately broad because our network of talent and intellectual property spans multiple categories.

Managing the Licensing Programme

Once opportunities are developed, you will work closely with the Wavelength team to manage the programme in your territory.

This includes:

  • Maintaining relationships with licensees and commercial partners

  • Coordinating with Wavelength on negotiations and agreements

  • Supporting partner onboarding

  • Managing the local licensing pipeline

  • Monitoring opportunities and deal progress

  • Supporting product and campaign development where required

  • Identifying additional commercial opportunities within existing partnerships

  • Reporting market intelligence and pipeline development to Wavelength

  • Helping grow successful partnerships over the long term

You will own the market relationship, while Wavelength provides the wider network, talent relationships, commercial infrastructure and central support.

What Wavelength Brings

We will provide access to a growing international network of creators, athletes, publishers and talent, giving you a portfolio of properties and personalities that can be taken to market.

We provide:

  • Access to Wavelength's global talent network

  • Creator and athlete relationships

  • Licensing opportunities and intellectual property

  • Central commercial and management support

  • International market knowledge

  • Pitch materials and commercial assets

  • Support with negotiations and deal structures

  • Global relationships with brands and agencies

  • Cross market opportunities

  • The ability to build international licensing programmes around successful properties

As The Country Licensing Agent, you will bring the local knowledge, relationships, commercial instinct and execution.

Who We Are Looking For

This opportunity is suited to someone who already has a strong network and understands how business is conducted in their respective market.

Desired professional background and industry experience

  • Licensing

  • Sports marketing

  • Brand partnerships

  • Media

  • Entertainment

  • Consumer products

  • Advertising

  • Sponsorship

  • Athlete or creator representation

  • IP development

  • Agency business development

  • Fashion

  • Gaming

  • Publishing

We are particularly interested in individuals who can demonstrate:

  • A strong network of senior commercial contacts

  • Excellent business development and sales skills

  • Knowledge of their local market

  • Experience negotiating commercial partnerships

  • An entrepreneurial mindset

  • Ability to work independently

  • Strong communication and presentation skills

  • Ability to identify opportunities rather than simply respond to them

  • Persistence and the ability to develop relationships over time

  • Genuine interest in creators, talent, media, brands and intellectual property

Applying

We are looking for entrepreneurs and agents and not employees. You should already know your market. You should already know who the major players are. If you can open doors, develop relationships and turn opportunities into revenue, we want to hear from you. Apply through the portal or send your resume and cover letter to Thando () with the following:

  • A summary of your relevant experience in licensing, IP commercialization, or media partnerships, including a link to your LinkedIn profile.

  • Overview of your active industry network, key local market relationships,

  • Examples of high-impact partnerships, licensing agreements, or commercial deals you have personally developed and closed.

  • The specific licensing categories (e.g., apparel, CPG, tech accessories, LBE) you believe offer the highest revenue opportunity in your market.

Why Wavelength?

The creator economy has created an enormous amount of valuable intellectual property, audiences and cultural influence. Much of that value remains underdeveloped commercially.

Wavelength sits at the intersection of creators, audiences, brands, media and commercial partnerships. We are building a global network that can identify that value and turn it into scalable commercial opportunities. For the right licensing agent, this represents an opportunity to build a significant licensing business in their market without having to build the underlying talent network themselves.
