jobs.description:
We’re looking for an incredible senior engineer to help us build the future of blockchain scalability.

This is an ideal opportunity for an engineer who is already passionate about tackling problems in blockchain scalability, or looking to break into the blockchain engineering space. If you’re looking to work in a fast-paced, high-impact team and help shape the direction of our product and company, this position is for you.

We’re backed by some of the best investors across silicon valley and the global blockchain ecosystem and offer competitive pay, an equity + token grant in the company, and full benefits.

About Caldera

Caldera enables dynamic, scalable blockchain experiences. Currently, dapps that are deployed to general-purpose blockchain compete with thousands of other applications for space on the network. This can lead to congestion and high fees or even network outages.

That’s where we come in. We’re building software that makes it easy for the most innovative blockchain applications to launch their own ultra-performant blockchains (rollups), enabling applications to own their ecosystem, scale to millions of users, and provide a superior user experience to their users. We already operate chains for a significant user base, and are eager to expand that operation with a sleek, performant team.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer at Caldera, you will:

  • Own significant components of Caldera's core infrastructure

  • Architect, develop, and deploy blockchain infrastructure to ensure the smooth operation of existing Caldera chains, and expand offerings for new customers.

  • Expand and hone our DevOps pipeline, allowing blockchains to be deployed and operated reliably and securely

  • Continuously improving the observability stack for the services we provide

  • Maintain and enhance the security posture of our infrastructure in AWS and Kubernetes, and upwards in the stack for the apps we run.

You might be a fit for this role if you...

  • Have 4+ years of engineering experience

  • Have experience writing backend services in Go or Typescript

  • Have experience with containerization, especially Kubernetes, Docker

  • Have strong experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, Helm

  • Hands-on experience with cloud / infrastructure and service providers, including AWS, Vercel, and Cloudflare

  • Keen eye for security, basic understanding of threat modeling and secure system architecture

  • Are confident with performance optimization, identifying bottlenecks and scalability concerns

  • Have familiarity with observability tools like Prometheus/Grafana or Datadog

If in doubt, please apply! We will find a place for great candidates, even if you feel that you don’t check all of the boxes 😀

jobs.description:
Who You Are

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who thrives in high-ownership environments and knows what it takes to build, ship, and operate distributed systems at scale, not just design them.

You’ll help build and scale a product that relies on reliable, high-throughput backend services
and strong operational maturity. This is a hands-on senior role: you will design, code, ship,
operate, and continuously improve distributed systems in production.

You're someone who has seen production fail, learned from it, and built better systems because of it. You care about observability, reliability, and code quality not as checkboxes but as craft. You're comfortable with ambiguity, collaborative by nature, and you raise the bar for the engineers around you.

What you’ll do

  • Design and implement distributed backend systems: services that are resilient,
    observable, and scalable (latency, throughput, reliability).

  • Build event-driven and asynchronous architectures using queues, pub/sub,
    background workers, and idempotent processing.

  • Own production reliability: performance tuning, incident response, on-call participation
    (if applicable), and systematic improvements (SLOs, error budgets, runbooks).

  • Raise the engineering bar: lead by example in code quality, API design, testing
    strategy, and operational best practices.

  • Deeply instrument services with logs, metrics, and traces; help standardize
    observability patterns across the platform.

  • Partner with Product and other engineers to define success metrics, measure impact,

    and iterate quickly based on real usage.

  • Mentor and guide: review designs and PRs, support other engineers, and shape

    long-term technical direction.

Specifically, we’re looking for

  • Senior experience (typically 8+ years) building and operating backend systems in

    production.

  • Strong coding skills in Go (production-grade, not scripting).

  • Distributed systems fundamentals: concurrency, backpressure, retries, idempotency,
    consistency tradeoffs, schema evolution, failure modes.

  • Cloud and infrastructure maturity (AWS preferred): designing services with managed
    cloud components, scaling patterns, cost awareness.

  • Kubernetes and Docker experience: containerized services, deployments, operational

    workflows.

  • Observability expertise: traces, metrics, logs, dashboards, alerting, incident analysis
    (Datadog and/or OpenTelemetry experience is a plus).

  • Databases: strong PostgreSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning) plus
    comfort working with OpenSearch and modern data stores.

  • Engineering rigor: testing strategies (unit, integration, contract), CI/CD hygiene, safe
    rollout patterns (feature flags, canaries, gradual releases).

Bonus

  • Experience with queueing and streaming systems (SQS, SNS, Kafka, Kinesis,

    RabbitMQ, Pub/Sub).

  • Vector databases and retrieval patterns (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant,

    OpenSearch vector).

  • Redis, MongoDB (only if truly used and not just “resume keywords”).

  • Terraform (or equivalent IaC), GitHub Actions (or similar CI/CD).

  • Security basics for backend systems (authn/authz, secrets management, least privilege,

    threat-aware design).

What success looks like

  • Services that are easier to operate: clear SLOs, better alerts, faster incident resolution.

  • Higher throughput and lower latency as usage grows.

  • Stronger platform foundations: repeatable patterns for async processing, observability,

    and safe deployments.

  • A team that levels up through your mentorship and technical leadership.

Ideally, you are someone that

  • Has previously worked in startups - comfortable navigating some uncertainty and high

    energy environments

  • Enjoys the collaborative process with different roles to design, implement and iterate on

    possible ideas and solutions

  • Is not a perfectionist but has a mindset of continuous, incremental improvements

    towards top-quality work

  • Is great at communicating with engineers, product managers, and other team members

  • Bonus:

    • Worked in the SalesTech space

Our Process

We want to be mindful of your time while finding the right candidate for our team. No homework to do, only human interactions ! Our typical recruitment timelines looks like this:

  • Screening call with Talent Acquisition (30 minutes) - to know more about you and go deeper about the role

  • Technical fit call with CTO (30 minutes) - to get to know each other, know about your technical depth.

  • Virtual Onsite Session :

    • Coding Session (1 hour) : In this hands-on session, you'll pair with our engineers to solve a real-world problem, focusing on clean logic, maintainability, and how you think through edge cases in real-time.

    • System Design Interview (1 hour) : We’ll dive into a whiteboard session to explore how you architect scalable systems, specifically looking at your ability to navigate technical trade-offs and balance performance with simplicity.

    • Culture and Values Interview (30 minutes) : We’ll wrap up by exploring our core values and your working style to ensure our environment is one where you’ll feel energized, supported, and empowered to do your best work.

    • Manager Interview (30 minutes) : This is a two-way conversation with your potential lead to discuss your career trajectory, how you navigate project ownership, and how we can support your growth within the team.

If all goes well, we’ll then make you an offer !

What we offer

  • Up to 100K€ package, depending on equity, profile and contract type

  • Challenging and interesting work

  • A place in our diverse team

  • A healthy work environment (few meetings and “low touch” management)

  • Fully-remote work within EU timezones (GMT +/- 3h)

  • Stipend to set up your home office

  • Yearly team events in Paris and offsite

  • Health insurance and other benefits applicable to your place of residence, if contract of employment in France or elsewhere via Deel Employer of record

  • Possibility to work as a freelancer

jobs.description:
About Journal Lab

Journal Lab is a Netherlands-based startup dedicated to revolutionizing the way people and organizations capture and share their stories.

🌟 Our flagship product: Travel Diaries

Travel Diaries enables users to create beautiful digital diaries that can be:

  • 📝 Shared online as blogs

  • 📄 Downloaded as PDFs

  • 📚 Ordered as exquisitely printed books

Our impact so far:

  • 🌍 Over 200,000 users worldwide.

  • 📦 More than 15,000 books delivered globally.

  • ✍️ 3000 premium members.

💼 Our B2B solutions

But we don't stop at individual travelers! We also offer innovative B2B solutions designed to help DMOs, travel agencies, tour operators, and other travel-related companies enhance their marketing efforts and deepen client relationships. By providing tools for content marketing, UGC integration, branding opportunities, and technological solutions, we empower our partners to engage their customers in new and meaningful ways.

🚀 Ready to make an impact?

Check out 🌐 our website to learn more of if you’re interested in contributing to the mission! Join us at Journal Lab and be part of a team that's shaping the future of digital journaling for individuals and businesses alike.

Our missionis to enable people and organizations to easily capture, share, and immortalize their adventures, experiences and thoughts in a fun and easy way, so they can relive them whenever they want and pass them on for generations to come.

Our vision includes:

  • Empowering individuals:

    • Expanding into new journaling segments such as personal, health, and professional journaling.

    • Maintaining a strong emphasis on storytelling and personal growth.

  • Enabling businesses:

    • Providing innovative solutions that help our partners enhance customer engagement and deepen client relationships.

    • Offering tools for content marketing, user-generated content integration, and branding opportunities to elevate their marketing efforts.

    • Help travel agencies turn their clients into ambassadors.

By uniting our commitment to personal storytelling with empowering organizations to connect meaningfully with their customers, we strive to create lasting emotional connections that resonate globally. ✨

🙆 Join our team

We’re a small (<15), young, dynamic and innovative remote-first company dedicated to driving growth and creating impactful solutions.

  • 🎉 Passionate and diverse team: Committed to excellence and continuous improvement.

  • 💻 Tech-savvy and data-driven: We leverage cutting-edge technology and use data analytics to drive innovation and make informed decisions.

  • 🌐 Fully remote company: All of our positions are fully remote. You don’t have to relocate to join us!

  • 💡 Innovative environment: We’re always adapting to meet our users’ and partners’ needs.

  • ⏰ Flexible work environment: Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of remote work, allowing you to balance your professional and personal life effectively.

  • 📈 Growth opportunities: Be part of a venture-funded startup in its exciting growth stage, offering ample opportunities for career advancement and professional development.

  • 🚀 Exciting product development: Engage with an exciting product in its early growth stages, with lots of opportunities to be part of designing and shaping our platform to reach our mission.

🧑‍💻 About the role

As our New Business Developer, you'll be the driving force behind expanding and optimizing our B2B efforts. Your primary focus will be on validating and driving our expansion into a new segment: travel agencies, both in the Dutch and international markets with a strong emphasis in the English speaking markets. You'll work on increasing our business activities with travel agencies and travel-related companies, helping us identify and penetrate new markets.

You'll set hypotheses and run experiments to discover the best approaches for our B2B products targeted at travel agencies. This involves shaping our existing products to make them appealing to this new segment or developing new solutions to serve these customer segments effectively.

Your number one challenge in the first 3 months will be identifying high-potential opportunities within the travel agency sector, testing hypotheses, and laying the groundwork for scalable, repeatable sales processes.

You'll report directly to the CEO and collaborate closely with the Growth Sales and Customer Success teams to shape our B2B strategy, define key problems to solve, and drive revenue growth in this new segment.

💼 What this job can offer you

  • Opportunity to drive growth: Play a pivotal role in expanding our B2B presence into new international markets, directly impacting the company's growth trajectory.

  • Strategic influence: Collaborate closely with the CEO and Head of Growth and other stakeholders to shape our B2B strategy, product offerings, and market approach.

  • Professional development: Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that encourages innovation, experimentation, and continuous learning.

  • Autonomy and flexibility: Enjoy the freedom to organize your work, set your strategies, and take ownership of your projects in a remote setting.

  • International exposure: Engage with clients and partners across various countries, broadening your professional network and cultural understanding.

  • Supportive team environment: Join a talented and passionate team where your ideas are expected, heard, and appreciated.

📝 Practicals

  • You’ll report to: CEO, Veerle

  • Team: B2B Sales

  • Location: Remote (Europe, Africa, or East Coast Americas)

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Type of contract: Contractor

  • Annual compensation: €42,635 - €46,635

📊 KPIs

As the New Business Developer, you will be expected to influence and drive the key performance indicators (KPIs) listed below.

  • Segment validation and entry

  • Qualified lead generation

  • Number of new clients acquired

  • B2B revenue growth from travel agencies

  • Sales process development

  • Client satisfaction

🧐 Responsibilities in detail

  • Market research and validation

    • Identify opportunities within the travel agency sector in Dutch and international markets.

    • Test hypotheses and validate market needs.

    • Develop hypotheses about new market opportunities and design experiments to test them.

  • Strategic business development

    • Develop and execute strategies to penetrate the travel agency market.

    • Adapt and shape our B2B products to meet the needs of new clients, potentially developing new solutions.

    • Identify opportunities to diversify our B2B strategy and implement scalable, repeatable sales processes.

  • Lead generation and sales

    • Generate and qualify leads through outreach and networking.

    • Build relationships with key stakeholders.

    • Present proposals and close deals with travel agencies.

    • Maintain a pipeline of high-quality leads and opportunities.

    • Meet and exceed revenue targets by driving sales growth in new segment.

  • Process optimization

    • Design scalable sales processes tailored to travel agencies.

    • Collaborate with teams to align efforts.

    • Maintain accurate records of business development activities, opportunities, and pipeline status in our CRM system.

    • Generate regular reports on performance, including key metrics and progress towards goals.

    • Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

🧰 What you bring

Experience and skills:

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in business development, sales, or a similar role within the travel industry or related sectors.

  • Proven track record of successfully entering new markets and driving revenue growth.

  • Experience in setting hypotheses and running experiments to validate market opportunities.

  • Strong understanding of B2B sales principles, strategies, and scalable sales processes.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Proficiency in CRM software, ideally Pipedrive.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a remote setting.

  • Strong organizational and time management skills.

  • Results-oriented with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • An existing network within the travel industry is a plus.

  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.

Personal attributes:

  • You're proactive, innovative, and not afraid to take calculated risks to achieve goals.

  • You make decisions based on data and are skilled at analyzing market trends and performance metrics.

  • You’re passionate about understanding and meeting client needs.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, changing environment and able to adjust strategies as needed.

  • Ability to engage with diverse cultures and adapt communication styles accordingly.

🌍 Our Company Culture

We believe in a flexible, results-oriented work culture where productivity is rewarded, and team members have the freedom to shape their work and personal lives. Our ethos is centered around fostering happy, engaged, and motivated team members who feel a strong connection to the company. We prioritize location-independent work, leveraging digital meetings and daily communication through Slack to maintain a content and efficient team.

📜 Journal Lab Tenets

  • 👑 Ownership Mindset: We act as stakeholders, taking responsibility for the company's direction and goals. We don’t say “that’s not my job” – we roll up our sleeves and contribute solutions, not just problems. We avoid working in silos, always considering our impact on the team.

  • 👟 Bias for Action: We take calculated risks and explore new opportunities, moving quickly on reversible decisions while pausing to consider irreversible ones. We reward seizing opportunities and exploring new possibilities without fear of failure.

  • ⚡ Move with Urgency and Focus: We prioritize impactful work, providing prompt and efficient service, and making swift decisions to drive growth and protect our reputation. We cultivate a culture of accountability, innovation, and resilience.

  • 🔍 Think Rigorously: We commit to thorough and analytical thinking in all aspects of our work, ensuring well-informed decisions aligned with our objectives. This fosters a culture of excellence, driven by innovation, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

  • 🤝 Trust and Amplify: We trust and amplify each other’s expertise and strengths, fostering open communication, transparency, and inclusive decision-making. This cultivates mutual respect, empowerment, and innovation, driving meaningful impact and achieving collective goals.

  • 🌟 Optimism: We maintain a positive outlook, viewing challenges as opportunities for growth. We encourage proactive problem-solving, fostering resilience, creativity, and a can-do attitude, enabling us to navigate complexities with confidence and agility.

🪧 Benefits

  • Work remotely: Collaborate with a globally distributed workforce with team members from 🇦🇷 Argentina, 🇧🇪 Belgium, 🇧🇷 Brazil, 🇨🇴 Colombia, 🇩🇪 Germany, 🇮🇩 Indonesia, 🇸🇷 Suriname, 🇳🇱 The Netherlands, 🇹🇷 Turkey ,🇺🇦 Ukraine and more!

  • Flexible work-schedule: Flexibility in your schedule; what we care about is getting the job done. We work mostly async.

  • Generous paid time-off (PTO): Enjoy 26 days of annual vacation plus national holidays.

  • An inclusive and dynamic workplace: We respect and value diversity in all its forms, where people from all walks of life are welcomed and valued for their unique perspectives and experiences.

🗓️ How you’ll organize your day (and life)

At Journal Lab we work mostly async which means you can plan your schedule around your life and not around meetings. You’ll be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt, you’ll default to action instead of waiting. Balancing your life and work-schedule is important and you’ll be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

Lear more about our flexible working policy here: Flexible working at Journal Lab

✍️ Ready to write the next chapter with us?

If you're excited to be part of our story and make a real impact in the travel and journaling world, we'd love to have you on board. Let's create amazing stories together!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Mapping & Content
jobs.excerpt: About the companyAt Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry.
jobs.description:
About the company

At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

About the job

Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or Casablanca.

This is a product role where a good idea in the morning can be in the product by the evening.

You'll own Mapping & Content: the layer that decides whether a room one supplier calls "Deluxe Double" and another calls "Habitación Deluxe" are recognized as the same physical room, at a precision and coverage the rest of the industry hasn't matched.

You’ll run it as a full business and product domain. You’re accountable for the outcomes, economics, priorities, and product decisions. You’ll help define what success looks like, then decide with your team what to prioritise, what to test, what to build, and where to make trade-offs.

The problem underneath is unusually complex. A single physical hotel room can be described in 500 to 1,000 different ways across suppliers, languages, and content formats. How do you resolve that ambiguity at scale, and keep improving coverage without degrading accuracy?

What makes it interesting for you

  • You can move extremely fast. There's very little red tape, teams make their own product decisions, and the culture is much closer to ask for forgiveness than wait for permission. If something makes sense, you can test it quickly instead of spending weeks getting alignment.
  • You own the path to the outcome. You'll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there.
  • You get a genuinely hard, industry-wide problem. Room and hotel mapping has resisted easy solutions across travel, and you're inheriting one of the strongest systems in the market: roughly 99.5% accuracy at 85% coverage, validated by customers like EasyJet who chose Nuitée over the alternatives.
  • You'll help build Nuitee's product organisation. We got to roughly €1B in booking value without a proper product org. Now we're building one, and you'll help shape it as we push toward €10B.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build.

The kind of problems you’ll work on

  • How do you map the same physical room across hundreds of differently worded supplier descriptions, in different languages, with extremely high confidence?
  • When should the system prioritize coverage versus precision, and how do you increase coverage without degrading accuracy?
  • How do you identify the highest-value mapping failures and focus the team where better mapping creates the biggest customer or commercial impact?

This role fits if you

  • Have owned a product or business area end to end for several years and can show the outcomes you drove.
  • Understand entity resolution and can go deep into data or ML product problems: search, matching, catalogues, identity, recommendations, knowledge graphs, or content quality.
  • Can go deep into data and technical mechanics and turn that into product decisions, without needing to be the person building the algorithm.
  • Are comfortable working closely with engineering and data science on technically complex products.
  • Have worked in a high-pressure environment where you were expected to drive the outcome yourself.
  • Are willing to go deep into ambiguous, probabilistic problems rather than staying at surface-level product management.

Data and platform depth matters more to us than travel experience.

Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your product actually delivers.

If this sounds like your kind of product role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks.

Why Nuitee?

At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
  • World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.
  • Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
  • Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others
  • AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.

By joining Nuitée, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us—Nuitée is the place for you.

By submitting your application, you consent to Nuitée processing your personal data for the purposes of assessing your suitability for employment. Your information will be stored securely and will only be retained for as long as necessary for the recruitment process, or up to 6 months afterward, in accordance with our data protection policy and applicable laws. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at . For more details, please see our Privacy Policy: Nuitée Privacy Notice 2026.

jobs.title: Head of B2B Growth
jobs.excerpt: Who we areProperstar connects real estate buyers, renters, and agents, here and everywhere.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Properstar connects real estate buyers, renters, and agents, here and everywhere. Buyers and renters find their next home with us, locally or across borders. Agents reach them in countries they couldn't otherwise sell into, in languages they don't speak.

Our Product & Marketing department grows the brand and our footprint. Small team, no fluff. We acquire new users, nurture them, qualify them, and turn them into customers. We believe in a new way of working, where AI is fundamental: you direct, you don't execute.

About the job

You own B2B growth end to end. Our database holds some 140,000 real estate agency offices and 640,000 agents. You turn more of them into active, engaged and paying users. AI does the heavy lifting, you steer it.

Three targets: B2B revenue, monthly active users, and mobile adoption.

That means real segmentation, not the same email sent to everyone. A solo agent in Lisbon and a 40-office network in Madrid don't need the same message. You get agents onto the app, push self-serve purchases through the dashboard, design offers that convert, and use content and every relevant channel to move them along.

2027 is the year we build and test the engine. 2028 is the year we scale it.

You set the strategy and you run it. You own the budget, get hands-on when needed, and lead the people who help you execute. You report to the CPO.

What you'll do

  • Set the B2B growth strategy. Segments, markets, channels, offers, budget. Defend every euro with numbers.
  • Segment the base for real. Office size, market, plan, activity, behavior. Each segment gets its own path.
  • Own the agency lifecycle. Onboarding, activation, engagement, upgrade, retention, win-back. Find where agents drop and fix it.
  • Drive self-serve revenue. Push purchases through the dashboard. Upgrade flows, trials, pricing pages, checkout. Less sales touch, more conversion.
  • Design offers that convert. Plans, bundles, promotions, timing. Test them. Kill the losers.
  • Make the app the agent's daily tool. Installs, adoption, weekly use. Move agents from desktop to mobile and keep them there.
  • Grow monthly active users. Give agents reasons to come back. Leads, insights, alerts, content.
  • Use every relevant channel. Email, push, in-app, content, webinars, paid, partnerships. Pick by segment, not by habit.
  • Run experiments. Onboarding, messaging, offers, pricing. Fast cycles, clear reads.
  • Work with sales and customer success. Self-serve for the long tail, humans for the big accounts. Hand them the right accounts at the right time.
  • Work with product. Push for what moves activation and conversion. Bring evidence, not opinions.
  • Lead the people who execute. Set their goals, review the work, raise the bar.
  • Build the playbooks as Claude skills, so the team and the agents can run them.
  • Talk to agents. Read the data yourself.

What we're looking for

  • B2B growth track record. You've grown a B2B or SMB product with thousands of customers, largely self-serve. Real numbers, real graph. Show us. SaaS for small businesses, marketplace, or portal experience is a strong plus. Real estate is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • Lifecycle and segmentation. You think in cohorts, segments, and lifecycles, not campaigns. The cheapest customer is the one already in your database.
  • Self-serve monetization. You've moved users from free to paid through the product. You know your activation, conversion, expansion, and churn by segment.
  • Multichannel range. You've owned several channels and have strong opinions on the rest. Single-channel specialists won't fit.
  • Mobile adoption. You've driven app adoption with a professional audience. You know what makes a busy agent open an app twice.
  • Product sense. You know how product changes move conversion. You bring PMs and designers evidence, not opinions.
  • Strategist and operator. You build the plan and you run it. You've owned a budget and answered for the return. You set up the flow and pull the numbers yourself. No agency in between.
  • Deep AI fluency. Claude is your daily driver, in Cowork and Code. You've built skills and orchestrated agents. Tell us what you automated this month. "Open to AI" doesn't pass the bar.
  • Data and judgment. You measure what works and kill what doesn't. You also decide without waiting for the perfect test.
  • Ownership. Brief to result. No handoffs.
  • Leadership. You make people better and faster without micromanaging them.
  • Clarity. You explain things simply. You don't hide weak results behind charts.
  • Languages. Fluent English. French or Spanish is a plus.

What we don't care about

  • Where your degree is from. Bachelor preferred, not required. Track record beats papers.
  • How polished your LinkedIn is. We read what you've shipped.
  • Whether you've worked at a brand we recognize. The best operators we've met came from companies you haven't heard of.

Logistics

Remote. Anywhere within +/- 3h of CET.

Type: Full-time, permanent contractor.

Start: January 2027 at the latest.

What we offer

  • B2B growth to own end to end. No committees, no hand-holding.
  • 140,000 agency offices and 640,000 agents to activate.
  • A dashboard and an app to grow.
  • Budget to test now, and a bigger one to scale in 2028.
  • The AI stack you'd struggle to build elsewhere. Claude (Cowork and Code), Mixpanel, HubSpot. All paid for.
  • A title with weight. You report to the CPO in a flat hierarchy.
  • Competitive comp aligned with your market.

About the role

You will own the entire requirements process on our client projects, and you will be the bridge between the client, the product and the engineering team.

This is not a BA role whose main job is documentation. We expect you to run the client communication yourself, lead discovery, shape and challenge requirements, and help design the solution together with the technical team — especially on our AI and fintech projects. You need to be technical enough to speak the same language as developers and architects, and to turn the client’s business need into something the team can actually build.

We enter projects two different ways. Often from scratch: no written product definition exists yet, and we author it with the client. Just as often by joining something already in flight: an existing backlog, someone else’s conventions, a deadline already running. Both ask the same thing of you — build the structure where there is none, and take the requirements to the point where a developer can build without guessing.

Requirements

What you will do:

  • Drive the client communication — you don’t just take part in the meetings, you drive the discussion.

  • Lead discovery and refinement sessions with clients in English — you run them, you don’t take notes at them.

  • Shape and challenge requirements, and help design the solution together with the technical team.

  • Join running projects, map what already exists, and bring the documentation to a consistent, testable state.

  • Write specifications developers can build from: concise, testable acceptance criteria, no duplication, no invented facts.

  • Turn unknowns into open questions with named owners, and chase them down the cheapest route that can answer them.

  • Support scope and ROM estimation with explicit assumptions, dependencies and confidence levels.

  • Use AI as a full working instrument in your analysis, and take part in building AI-enabled solutions — verifying everything it produces before it reaches a client or a developer.

What we are looking for:

  • Strong client-facing experience — you have been the person the client talks to, not the person briefed afterwards.

  • Strong fintech / banking expertise — a deep understanding of financial products and processes, integrations and data flows: enough to ask the right questions, spot the risks and challenge what the client asks for.

  • An AI background — experience on projects where AI is part of the product, plus daily use of AI tools in your own analysis work, including a concrete example of catching a wrong AI output.

  • Technical enough to speak the same language as developers and architects.

  • 5+ years as a Business Analyst / Systems Analyst in custom software development, including at least 2 years as the only analyst on a project.

  • Experience of both entries: starting a product from scratch, where the requirements had to be created rather than collected, and joining a project already in flight with documentation you did not write.

  • English B2+ (C1 preferred) — enough to facilitate a workshop with a client, not only to attend one.

  • Discipline in written specifications: testable acceptance criteria, and the judgement to cut what does not belong.

  • Confident daily use of Jira and Confluence; able to read designs in Figma.

  • The habit of asking the uncomfortable question a second time when the first one was brushed off.

Nice to have:

  • Pre-sale experience: scope shaping, assumptions, ROM estimates, proposal input.

  • Domains beyond fintech: healthcare, logistics, renewable energy.

  • BPMN / UML / ERD used as a means of agreement, not as a deliverable for its own sake.

  • Experience mentoring analysts or reviewing other people’s specifications.

How we work:

  • One department standard and one quality rubric — your work is measured against the same instrument as everyone else’s, and so is everyone else’s.

  • Decisions have named gates: AI drafts, a human decides, and it is written down who decided.

  • We fight documentation overload as a matter of policy. Shorter and testable beats longer and thorough.

What we offer:

  • Long team focus: we create an environment of transparent communication, and minimal bureaucracy, which leads to long-term relationships.

  • Development of niche expertise: we are working in several niches, such as FinTech, healthcare, and logistics. Therefore, our employees can develop their own expertise in these domains.

  • Continuous learning: we create employee development plans / personal roadmaps /quick promotion processes.

  • Internal career development: 80% of our current executives were promoted to those positions within S-PRO. We encourage initiative. If a person wants to set new challenges and grow, we will definitely support them.

Benefits and perks:

  • Flexible schedule.

  • Remote work model.

  • Paid vacations.

  • Paid Sick-leaves.

  • Paid State holidays.

Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer, a pipeline architect, a "why-is-this-TOS-data-a-mess" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself, you'll join Terminal.exe, All Your BI's AI-native data platform for container terminal operators, and build the core of it: the pipelines and data model that turn fragmented, hard-to-trust terminal data into something operators run their day on.

What you get

  • A salary between €85,000-€99,000 per year inclusive of holiday allowance, based on your experience.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, within Europe.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

About Terminal.exe

Terminal.exe is All Your BI's SaaS platform for container terminals. It unifies fragmented data, TOS, maintenance, gate, sensors, into one governed model, so every site works from the same numbers instead of rebuilding its own reporting from scratch. The platform is growing fast. You'll help shape the engineering foundations that need to scale next: multi-tenant data architecture, near-real-time pipelines from 24/7 operations, and a standardized data model that works across terminals worldwide.

What the job looks like

You will design and build the pipelines that move data from terminal operating systems (such as Navis N4) into our platform, and the transformation layer that turns raw operational data into curated, documented datasets.

Concretely, you will work on:

  • ELT pipelines from on-premises terminal databases into our Azure-based platform, with near-real-time refresh (3-minute microbatch) for operational reporting and daily batch for analytics. Extraction uses watermark-based incremental queries over Kafka (Azure Event Hubs) to PostgreSQL staging.

  • A multi-tenant data architecture on Azure PostgreSQL with database-per-tenant isolation and a standardized STG → ODS → DataMart layer structure driven by our internal declarative transformation framework (dewi)

  • Our internal connector tooling written in Go, which you will help develop and extend

  • Data quality monitoring: gap detection, freshness alerting, and reconciliation

  • The standardized terminal data model: mapping source data from different TOS versions and configurations onto shared definitions of moves, calls, and equipment events

You will work directly with terminal operations staff, without intermediate layers.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Attitude and experience: curiosity and a genuine appetite for architectural ownership, and 5+ years of data engineering experience, including end-to-end ownership of production data platforms. This is a product under active development, we need you comfortable deciding, not just executing.

  • Core stack: strong SQL and Python; Go experience is a significant plus (our connectors and consumers are written in Go). Solid experience with SQL Server as a source system and PostgreSQL as a target store.

  • Pipelines and streaming: experience building and operating ELT pipelines against operational source systems, including watermark/incremental or CDC/replica-based extraction, and with event-driven or streaming architectures, we use Azure Event Hubs with a Kafka-compatible endpoint.

  • Cloud and observability: cloud data platform experience on Azure, familiarity with AKS, Azure DevOps CI/CD, and GitOps (Argo CD) is a plus, alongside a strong focus on data correctness and instrumentation, we use OpenTelemetry.

  • Nice to have: knowledge of the container terminal or port logistics industry, direct experience with Navis N4 or another TOS, multi-tenant SaaS data architecture experience, and familiarity with declarative, YAML-driven transformation frameworks. Industry knowledge is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, we'll teach you the terminal domain.

We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

Highlights

Build the pipelines and data model powering a live SaaS platform for container terminals worldwide.

jobs.title: Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We’re Fly. io, and we’re building a new public cloud.
jobs.description:
We’re Fly.io, and we’re building a new public cloud. We transmogrify containers into lightweight VMs and run them on our hardware around the world – hundreds of thousands of applications rely on us, running on every continent except Antarctica. If you haven’t already,take us for spin. Your app will be up and running in just minutes.

Unlike all the rest of our roles, these roles are geographically specific; devrel here is in large part about engaging local communities. We’re currently hiring devrel people who can deliver work full time in North America and Europe. Of course, our whole thing is that we deploy everywhere else in the world, too, so we’ll be expanding from there soon.

There are a lot DevRel jobs where you have to make your own fun, because the product is about eliminating some gnarly business slog like inventory management or expense tracking or underwriting. We’re not knocking those jobs! There’s nobility in eliminating slogs!

But this isn’t one of those jobs. We’re doing something big, something that’s about software development itself. We’re one of a number of upstart companies rethinking the public cloud, breaking down infrastructure problems that used to take months of work and dedicated headcount into a platform that our users can gain fluency with in a matter of minutes. If you’re our kind of developer, the fun in this job is built-in.

Folks working in DevRel at Fly.io interact with three different groups of people:

  • Group A: our product teams, like in every other devrel job: the people building the platform and its features.
  • Group B: our “framework” teams, which are a fun quirk of Fly.io: these are small teams of people organized around individual application frameworks like Rails, Django, Phoenix, and whatever people are doing in Javascript these days.
  • Group H: the “developer community”, a term the industry uses because it is apparently squicked out by the word “customer”.

You’ll accomplish this by deploying all of your “skills of an artist”, hopefully including things like:

  • Quickly building proof-of-concept applications that show off cool things about Fly.io, like how quickly you can start up a new VM, or the timeless elegance of our IPv6 addressing.
  • Building and delivering presentations for events, presentations that have the net effect of customers (err, the developer community) liking us more. Also, having the good taste to do this in ways that are interesting even to people who might never deploy an app on Fly.io.
  • Talking to people working on all kinds of applications, from side projects to large teams building microservice ensembles, and talking them through making the best use of Fly.io, the Fly Machines API, our integrations with products like Supabase, that sort of stuff.
  • Maintaining a public presence in online communities where developers congregate, and somehow doing all of this while maintaining your own authenticity and credibility. We’ll help!
  • 25% monthly travel (with seasonal variability) to meet with developer communities in person to engage in small and large settings to build authentic developer interest in various regions and communities.

This Role Is A Good Fit For You If:

  • You enjoy building applications and are particularly psyched about the prototyping phase of building things, because there’s going to be a lot of that here.
  • The idea of a little bit of chaos appeals to you, because it’s a sign to you that there’s an opportunity to help define a new practice and make some big moves.
  • You’re opinionated enough to be interesting, but exceptionally good at listening, empathizing, and rolling with the opinions of our users. That’s a hard tradeoff and not a lot of us here can do it!
  • Your career goals involve increasing your public profile. We punch above our weight in getting attention from developers, and your job here would be part of building and expanding on that.
  • Going to a bunch of different developer events sounds like a good time to you. There’s some travel involved in this job.

You’ll Know You’re Succeeding If:

More Details

This is a fully-remote, full-time position.

Our hiring process may be a little different from what you’re used to. We respect career experience but we aren’t hypnotized by it, and we’re thrilled at the prospect of discovering new talent. This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.

We’re currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

Profile Overview

As our Growth Marketing Specialist, you'll be the hands-on engine behind our demand campaigns across every channel we run: paid search, paid social, email, webinars, events, community, and our website. Reporting into the Growth Marketing Manager, you'll own the build, launch, and daily optimisation of campaigns, and you'll partner closely with Marketing Operations to keep everything automated, accurately tracked, and performing. This is a genuinely multifaceted, execution-first role. One week your focus might be paid search performance, the next a webinar cadence or an email nurture flow. We're building the demand foundations from the ground up, so there's real space to bring ideas and leave your stamp on what we create.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • Take full operational ownership of day-to-day campaign execution across paid and email, driving performance forward without needing a playbook handed to you.
  • Spot what's underperforming early, bring clear recommendations to the table, and run the tests and optimisations that move the needle.

Your responsibilities

  • Execute demand campaigns end to end across paid search (Google, Microsoft), paid social (LinkedIn, with more channels on the way), email, webinars, events, and community channels like Reddit, owning build, launch, and daily management.
  • Own campaign timelines, coordination, and smooth delivery in close collaboration with the Growth Marketing Manager and the wider marketing team.
  • Monitor performance daily, dig into the data, and proactively flag risks and opportunities before they become problems.
  • Build and iterate email campaigns and nurture sequences that turn event and webinar interest into real pipeline.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations to make sure every campaign is correctly set up, automated, and tracked from end to end.
  • Stay close to what's shifting in the industry and what competitors are doing, and translate that into how we sharpen our own campaigns.

What you bring to the table

  • 3+ years hands-on running and optimising campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and similar, with real depth in paid.
  • Genuine breadth beyond paid: practical experience across email marketing and sequences, plus exposure to webinars, events, or community channels, and the adaptability to switch focus as priorities shift.
  • An execution-first mindset: you love being in the trenches daily, building and shipping, with sharp attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical instincts: you spot patterns and performance issues quickly and act proactively rather than reactively.
  • Clear, structured communication: you keep stakeholders informed on what's happening and what you're seeing in the data, with minimal back-and-forth.
  • You use AI tools regularly to work smarter and can point to concrete examples of how they boost your output.

What’s in it for You

  • Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. jobs.description:
Job Summary:

We’re looking for a Software Engineer Team Lead (Forward Deployed) to join our customer engineering team as a player/coach. You’ll work directly with enterprise clients to design, implement, and scale real-world solutions while leading and developing a team of up to 6 engineers.

Job Description:

We’re looking for a Software Engineer Team Lead (Forward Deployed) to join our customer engineering team as a player/coach. You’ll work directly with enterprise clients to design, implement, and scale real-world solutions while leading and developing a team of up to 6 engineers.

As a player/coach, you’re not expected to be great at everything, but you are expected to lead by example and be willing to roll up your sleeves when things get challenging. You’ll balance hands-on technical work with people management, ensuring both project success and team member growth.

You’llleverage AI tools throughout the entire software development lifecycle to rapidly drive value. While you may have natural specialties, we expect full-stack capability accelerated by AI — no dedicated frontend, backend, or DevOps silos.

At least 25% of your time is expected to be dedicated to hiring, talent management, and training your team members.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Value Creation Projects (3-6 months): Drive deployment and integration of solutions for specific business units, solving materially hard problems like re-platforming or creating innovative features

  • Lead Applications Projects (Long-term): Architect and maintain Volaris-focused applications that drive sustained value, providing ongoing support, roadmaps, and feature development

  • Manage and develop up to 6 team members across various projects and assignments

  • Design and build complex custom components, APIs, and data pipelines to fit client needs

  • Debug and optimize complex systems across cloud and on-prem infrastructures

  • Work directly with business unit technical teams to design scalable solutions

  • Conduct hiring interviews and participate in talent acquisition

  • Provide career coaching, performance feedback, and professional development for team members

  • Serve as the bridge between our product team and end users, influencing the roadmap through field experience

  • Lead technical discussions and architectural decisions across multiple projects

  • Occasionally travel to customer sites (as needed) for deployment or design sessions

What You Bring

Required:

- 7+ years of professional experience in software engineering (Python, TypeScript, Java, .NET, or similar)

- 2+ years of experience managing and developing engineering teams

- Strong experience working with APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems

- Full-stack mindset: Proven ability to work across frontend, backend, and infrastructure with AI assistance

- AI tool proficiency: Experience with AI-assisted development tools and practices

- Proven track record of mentoring and developing junior and senior engineers

- Experience with hiring, performance management, and career development

- Comfort working directly with customer engineering or operations teams

- Strong leadership skills with ability to lead by example

- Excellent communication and influence skills

- Ability to thrive in ambiguous, high-impact environments

Nice to Have:

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)

- Prior work in AI, analytics, or enterprise SaaS deployments

- Familiarity with customer success / implementation roles

- Experience managing matrix organization or cross-functional teams

Why You’ll Love It

You’ll get to work on meaningful, high-impact projects where your code directly powers real customer outcomes — not theoretical demos. You’ll also gain deep exposure to different industries, data systems, and product architectures while being part of a team that moves fast and ships daily.

As a player/coach, you’ll have the opportunity to shape both technical direction and team culture, developing the next generation of engineers while staying hands-on with challenging technical problems.

Regular

Job Title: Manager, Value & Access Analytics - GTN Forensics - U.S. Remote

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Manager, Value & Access Analytics - GTN Forensics


Live

What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Manager, GTN Forensics, will support the development and delivery of cross-portfolio analytics that improve visibility into Gross-to-Net (GTN) performance and help identify potential anomalies, leakage, and process-improvement opportunities. As a member of the Value & Access Insights team, this role will independently execute defined workstreams supporting GTN initiatives, from business-question framing through analysis, validation, and stakeholder communication.

Collaborating closely with US Value & Access transformation initiatives and other cross-functional partners, the Manager will support broader GTN forensics priorities and advance scalable analytics, reporting, and proof-of-concept capabilities. The role will work with Contracting & Pricing (C&P), CPE, Market Access, data product and technology teams, and other stakeholders to address payer and provider contracting, pricing, invoice, and performance questions.

This is a hands-on, collaborative role requiring strong analytical judgment, disciplined project execution, and the ability to communicate findings clearly across business, analytics, and technology audiences. The individual will coordinate inputs across teams, document methods and decisions, and help transition successful analyses into repeatable and durable capabilities.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Value & Access Insights - Cross-Portfolio & Innovation.


Responsibilities

• Execute defined analytical workstreams supporting GTN forensics priorities, from problem framing and data assessment through analysis, validation, and delivery. Coordinate with workstream leads and partner teams to maintain timelines, resolve issues, and ensure outputs are accurate and useful.

• Support recurring and ongoing GTN related activities by identifying unusual plan-, invoice- or claims-level patterns; conducting preliminary root-cause analyses; preparing findings for review with business partners; and tracking feedback, disposition, and follow-up actions.

• Collaborate with Value & Access transformation initiatives and other Value & Access Insights leads to advance shared GTN forensics capabilities. Contribute business requirements, data definitions, user-acceptance testing, documentation, feedback, and rollout support for integrated tools, data products, and workflows.

• Analyze and connect relevant invoice, rebate, claims, contract, access, chargeback, reimbursement, and other market access information. Perform quality checks and reconciliations, investigate data inconsistencies, and clearly document assumptions, limitations, and outstanding questions.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify business questions, align on analytical approaches, and translate findings into practical implications and recommendations.

• Develop and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, presentations, and other communication materials that summarize findings and progress. Adapt the level of detail for technical and non-technical audiences and escalate material risks or decisions in a timely manner.

• Gather stakeholder feedback, help refine analytical rules and thresholds, identify opportunities to improve repeatability and efficiency, and support training, release, and adoption activities for new or enhanced capabilities.

• Maintain clear documentation of processes, data definitions, analytical logic, assumptions, decisions, and handoffs. Follow applicable privacy, governance, compliance, and quality standards and contribute to consistent ways of working across teams.


Win

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The strategic professional we seek is a motivated individual with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications

• Doctorate or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field; OR

• Master's or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field and 2 years of relevant experience; OR

• Bachelor's or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field and 4 years of relevant experience


Preferred Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, health care analytics, market access, and/or strategy consulting, with familiarity with GTN, payer or provider contracting, pricing, rebates, reimbursement, coverage, or access.

• Experience independently delivering defined analytical workstreams or supporting analytics products from requirements and data assessment through testing, reporting, and stakeholder adoption.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex data, identify patterns and root causes, and translate results into clear business implications.

• Working proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and experience with one or more analytical or reporting tools such as SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI, or Anaplan.

• Familiarity with invoice, rebate, claims, contract, chargeback, access, reimbursement, or other health care and market access datasets is preferred.

• Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated collaboration, organization, and project-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate across teams, and deliver against agreed timelines.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, documentation, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Thrive

What you can expect from us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives

jobs.description:
MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.

To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner's codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.

This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.

Learn more about #LifeAtMongoDB here!

This role will be based remotely in Toronto.

What you'll do at MongoDB

In this role, you will:

  • Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
  • Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
  • Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
  • Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
  • Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
  • Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have

  • 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
  • Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
  • Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
  • Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
  • Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
  • Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
  • Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have

  • Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
  • Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
  • Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
  • Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB's broader product portfolio

What you will learn

  • Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
  • Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
