jobs.description:
Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer

AI Foundry | NewRocket
Location: Remote with travel (~70%)

Role Overview

NewRocket is seeking a highly skilled SeniorForward Deployed AI Engineerand Architect to join the AI Foundry team and work directly with customers to deploy, operationalize, and scale AI-powered workflow solutions.

This role blends full-stack engineering, enterprise integration, generative AI implementation, and client-facing solution delivery. Forward Deployed AI Engineers partner closely with business consultants, product teams, AI/ML engineers, and customer stakeholders to translate real-world business problems into secure, reliable, deployable AI-driven solutions.

As an Anthropic partner/vendor, NewRocket is expanding its capability to design and deliver enterprise solutions using Claude and other leading AI technologies. In this role, you will apply modern LLM engineering practices—including prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, structured outputs, agentic workflows, model evaluation, and responsible AI controls—to deliver measurable customer value.

You will help customers implement agentic AI workflows, intelligent automations, and AI-powered integrations within ServiceNow and broader enterprise ecosystems. You will also contribute directly to the evolution of NewRocket’s AI platforms, accelerators, and intellectual property, including the NewRocket Intelligence Platform, Value Realization Dashboard, Data Intelligence Platform, and reusable Agent Packs.

This role requires strong engineering skills, curiosity about emerging AI technologies, sound judgment regarding responsible AI deployment, and the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving customer environments.

Key Responsibilities

Client Delivery & AI Solution Implementation

  • Deploy, configure, and operationalize agentic AI workflows, AI assistants, and AI-powered automations within client ServiceNow environments and enterprise technology ecosystems.
  • Translate customer business requirements, operational processes, and desired outcomes into technical architectures, implementation plans, and production-ready AI solutions.
  • Implement and integrate NewRocket Agent Packs, AI accelerators, and workflow solutions into enterprise environments.
  • Work directly with customer teams to tailor AI solutions to their operating models, business processes, data sources, security requirements, and user needs.
  • Support workshops, discovery sessions, technical working sessions, demonstrations, pilots, and production rollouts.
  • Clearly communicate AI capabilities, limitations, tradeoffs, solution behavior, and adoption considerations to technical and business stakeholders.

Anthropic and Generative AI Engineering

  • Build enterprise AI applications and workflows using Claude, the Anthropic API, and other LLM platforms as appropriate for the client use case.
  • Apply effective prompt and context-engineering techniques, including clear instructions, examples, role and task definition, structured inputs, response constraints, and long-context management.
  • Design and implement AI workflows using structured outputs, tool use/function calling, API integrations, multi-step orchestration, and human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions that ground AI responses in authorized enterprise data and knowledge sources.
  • Implement practical techniques to improve reliability and user trust, including citation or source-grounding patterns, validation, confidence thresholds, output schemas, fallback handling, and escalation workflows.
  • Stay current on Anthropic platform capabilities, Claude model releases, implementation guidance, responsible AI principles, and enterprise deployment best practices.
  • Complete relevant Anthropic training, partner enablement, and technical education programs as available, and incorporate those practices into NewRocket solution delivery.

Solution Engineering & Prototyping

  • Build demos, prototypes, and proof-of-concept implementations that validate AI-driven workflows and customer use cases.
  • Rapidly iterate with customers and internal teams to refine AI-powered solutions based on feedback, performance results, and operational needs.
  • Support the design and implementation of AI orchestration, LLM integrations, agentic decision models, and workflow automation patterns.
  • Evaluate when an agentic approach is appropriate versus deterministic automation, traditional workflow logic, search, analytics, or human review.
  • Develop reusable implementation patterns, solution templates, prompt libraries, integrations, and deployment assets that accelerate future client delivery.

Full-Stack Engineering & Integration

  • Develop secure integrations between ServiceNow, enterprise systems, APIs, data platforms, and AI services.
  • Build supporting components such as scripts, microservices, automation logic, integration services, and lightweight user interfaces.
  • Implement integrations with AI platforms, enterprise APIs, identity systems, document repositories, databases, and structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Apply sound engineering practices for authentication, authorization, secrets management, access controls, logging, error handling, version control, and documentation.
  • Design solutions that meet enterprise expectations for security, scalability, maintainability, observability, and production readiness.

AI Quality, Evaluation & Responsible AI

  • Develop and execute practical evaluation approaches for AI applications, including test cases, representative datasets, success metrics, and regression testing.
  • Assess AI workflow quality across dimensions such as relevance, accuracy, groundedness, task completion, safety, latency, cost, and user experience.
  • Implement safeguards for sensitive data, role-based permissions, appropriate data access, prompt injection risks, unsafe tool use, and unintended model behavior.
  • Establish human-in-the-loop workflows for sensitive, high-impact, low-confidence, or exception-based decisions.
  • Document AI solution behavior, known limitations, risk controls, governance considerations, and operational support procedures.
  • Monitor and improve deployed solutions based on user feedback, usage patterns, performance data, incidents, and evolving customer needs.

Product & Platform Contribution

Actively contribute to the development and evolution of NewRocket’s AI intellectual property and platforms, including:

  • NewRocket Intelligence Platform
  • Value Realization Dashboard
  • Data Intelligence Platform
  • Agent Packs and reusable AI solution accelerators

Responsibilities include:

  • Identifying common patterns, requirements, integration needs, and capabilities discovered through customer deployments.
  • Contributing reusable assets, integration components, prompt patterns, evaluation frameworks, and automation capabilities.
  • Providing actionable product feedback that improves usability, reliability, scalability, security, and customer value.
  • Helping transform successful client implementations into repeatable platform features, accelerators, and delivery playbooks.
  • Supporting the definition of standards and best practices for enterprise AI delivery across NewRocket’s AI Foundry.

Systems Integration & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues across AI workflows, integrations, retrieval pipelines, data connections, and automation processes.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to model inputs and outputs, prompt behavior, tool execution, API reliability, permissions, data quality, and system performance.
  • Ensure deployed AI solutions are secure, scalable, supportable, and production-ready.
  • Optimize deployed systems for reliability, performance, latency, model usage, and cost efficiency.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Work closely with Business Process Consultants, Product Engineering, Data Engineers, AI/ML Engineers, ServiceNow teams, and the AI Center of Excellence.
  • Serve as the engineering counterpart to consulting and delivery teams throughout discovery, solution design, implementation, rollout, and continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to internal playbooks, technical documentation, reusable deployment patterns, reference architectures, and product evolution.
  • Share lessons learned from customer deployments to strengthen NewRocket’s AI delivery capabilities and solution portfolio.

What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months

  • Successfully deploy AI-powered workflows, assistants, automations, or integrations across multiple customer engagements.
  • Deliver secure, reliable AI workflows within customer ServiceNow environments and connected enterprise systems.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer technical teams, business stakeholders, and NewRocket delivery teams.
  • Demonstrate strong practical application of Claude and modern LLM engineering practices, including prompt/context engineering, tool use, RAG, evaluations, and responsible AI controls.
  • Contribute reusable components, implementation patterns, prompt assets, and improvements to NewRocket’s AI platforms and accelerators.
  • Provide actionable customer-driven feedback that improves the NewRocket Intelligence Platform and related products.
  • Help establish repeatable methods for moving AI use cases from prototype through governed production deployment.
  • Design, develop, and deploy autonomous and human-in-the-loop AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and related Microsoft technologies.
  • Build sophisticated agentic workflows capable of reasoning, planning, executing actions, and interacting with enterprise applications.
  • Develop multi-agent solutions with agent orchestration, tool calling, contextual memory, and workflow coordination.
  • Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using Azure AI Search, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge sources
  • Extend Copilot capabilities through custom connectors, APIs, plugins, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations
  • Develop custom agent capabilities using Python, C#, TypeScript, and relevant AI orchestration frameworks
  • Experience with integrating Jira and confluence and smart sheets
  • Leverage Azure AI Foundry for model deployment, agent development, evaluation, and operational management

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, systems integration, enterprise platforms, workflow automation, or related technical delivery roles.
  • Strong engineering foundation, with hands-on experience in full-stack development, scripting, APIs, microservices, enterprise integrations, or cloud-native applications.
  • Experience building, deploying, or supporting AI/LLM-powered applications, AI-enabled automations, conversational experiences, RAG systems, or agentic workflows.
  • Experience integrating APIs, enterprise applications, data platforms, or workflow systems in production environments.
  • Experience with Power Automate and Power BI
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming and scripting languages.
  • Familiarity with modern LLM application concepts, including prompt engineering, context windows, token usage, embeddings, vector search, RAG, tool use/function calling, structured outputs, and model evaluation.
  • Understanding of responsible AI concepts, including hallucination mitigation, sensitive-data handling, identity and access controls, human oversight, AI safety, and secure AI deployment.
  • Experience operating in customer-facing engineering, consulting, technical implementation, solutions architecture, or professional-services roles.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, travel to clients as needed, and deliver high-quality solutions in fast-moving customer environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) concepts and experience building or integrating secure tools and data connections for AI applications.

ServiceNow Experience — Strong Plus

  • Experience with ServiceNow development, configuration, workflow automation, or enterprise platform implementation.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow scripting, APIs, IntegrationHub, Flow Designer, Virtual Agent, Now Assist, AI Agents, and platform development patterns.
  • Understanding of ServiceNow data models and enterprise workflow concepts, including:
    • CMDB
    • ITSM, CSM, HRSD, or employee workflows
    • Workflow and task tables
    • Knowledge management
    • Enterprise integrations and data exchange patterns

AI, Data & Platform Experience

  • Experience building AI prototypes, RAG systems, semantic search capabilities, AI assistants, or agent-based workflows.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI services into enterprise applications and business processes.
  • Experience with vector databases, embeddings, document ingestion, chunking, retrieval strategies, and knowledge-grounding patterns.
  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration and application frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable tools.
  • Experience with AI observability, tracing, evaluation frameworks, prompt/version management, monitoring, and cost optimization.
  • Experience contributing to internal platforms, reusable accelerators, developer tooling, or product capabilities.
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, SQL, Git, infrastructure-as-code, and secure cloud deployment practices.

Why This Role Matters

Forward Deployed AI Engineers are the bridge between real-world enterprise problems and NewRocket’s AI platforms. By working directly with customers, they deliver immediate operational value while shaping the evolution of NewRocket’s AI products, accelerators, and platform capabilities.

This role is critical to scaling the NewRocket Intelligence Platform and the broader AI Foundry strategy. As NewRocket expands its partnership with Anthropic, this engineer will help establish practical, secure, and responsible patterns for deploying Claude-powered AI solutions that improve enterprise workflows, accelerate decision-making, and create measurable business outcomes.

We Take Care of Our People

NewRocket is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value and celebrate diversity, believing that every employee matters and should be respected and heard.  We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer, committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, citizenship, military, or Veteran status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please contact .

As a Senior .NET Software Engineer, you’ll be an integral part of our dynamic agile team, leveraging the Scrum framework to drive the development of innovative features while ensuring the continuous enhancement and scalability, while working at the heart of our subscription e-commerce platform, a multi-tenant B2B engine that powers global distributors. Our collaborative environment embraces modern software engineering practices, including asynchronous programming techniques, to deliver robust solutions. From building scalable services to integrating major Software Vendors with our platform, you’ll play a key role in shaping how our product evolves.

🎯 Your goal?

To design and build reliable, high-performance software that simplifies subscription services delivery, while keeping scalability and clean architecture top of mind.

You’ll be hands-on with .NET (legacy full .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10 (latest)), C#, SQL, implementing domain and service-oriented approaches. You’ll collaborate across teams (POs, BAs, QA, and DevOps) in an agile environment, ensuring smooth delivery of features and improvements.

You'll own the design and delivery of complex, multi-component systems end-to-end, from design to deployment, ensuring performance, scalability, and quality.

💡 This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys complex technical challenges, has experience with high-traffic applications, and thrives in a collaborative engineering culture.

🙋‍♀️ Our Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re a curious and analytical engineer who sees the big picture but sweats the details. You enjoy diving into system architecture, making thoughtful trade-offs, and writing clean, testable code.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where innovation meets stability. You’re not just a builder. You’re a problem solver who looks for ways to make systems more efficient, scalable, and maintainable.

You value teamwork and knowledge-sharing, but you’re also confident in owning features independently. You’re someone who wants to grow while helping the team grow.

Why You’ll Love It Here 💙

  • Work on a platform that directly impacts customers across 75+ countries.

  • Hands-on exposure to APIs, billing systems, and large-scale/high-traffic B2B commerce.

  • A collaborative engineering culture with peer-led code reviews and knowledge-sharing.

  • Opportunities to shape system architecture and technical direction.

  • Friendly, dynamic team with room to grow and learn.

  • Remote-first: work from anywhere, with optional, ad hoc in-person meet-ups arranged around team members' availability.

What you'll do:

  • System Ownership: Own the system design and hands-on delivery of your systems throughout our S-SDLC, from analysis and architectural design to implementation, testing, and deployment.

  • .NET Application Development: Develop new and existing .NET web applications (.NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10).

  • Database Interaction: Design, build, and optimize database interactions (SQL Server).

  • Clean, Scalable Code: Write and maintain clean, reliable code that prioritizes scalability and performance.

  • Testability: Design your systems to be testable, and make sure your code isn't just written, but also tested (we like integration and unit testing).

  • Quality Standards: Set and uphold the code-review and quality standards the team works to, through peer-led reviews.

  • Design Principles: Apply design principles (we follow SOLID) and patterns (like factory method, strategy, etc.) as necessary.

  • CI/CD Pipelines: Build and maintain continuous integration and deployment pipelines.

  • Optimization: Enhance system quality by identifying issues and common patterns, and pinpointing opportunities for improvement.

  • Innovative Solutions: Be constantly on the lookout for designing innovative technical solutions.

  • Documentation: Contribute to the development of comprehensive technical documentation.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with a diverse group of team members, such as POs, BAs, Automation Testers, and DevOps, to shape product requirements.

  • Mentoring: Mentor engineers through design, decomposition and risk thinking, helping them grow in how they approach complex work.

  • Observability: Own monitoring, logging and alerting for the services you build — you'll know how your systems behave in production, not just in test.

  • Continuous Refactoring: Drive continuous refactoring to keep the codebase healthy. Reverse-engineer existing code, diagnose the underlying problem, and make the call between refactoring and rewriting to reduce technical debt.

  • Risk-based Decisions: Make technical decisions based on risk, using evidence from production.

  • Delivery Discipline: Plan ahead, keep your work current and transparent, and flag risks early.

  • AI-assisted Engineering: Use and supervise AI-assisted engineering for complex work, and verify the designs and code it generates.

Success looks like: quantitatively — services that consistently meet agreed SLOs (availability, latency, error rate) and measurably improve in reliability and performance over time, an improving code-health trend (complexity, churn), low escaped-defect, regression and recurring-incident rates, and predictable delivery; qualitatively — high design quality, strong end-to-end ownership, maintainable and well-tested solutions, sound technical decisions, and effective mentoring and knowledge-sharing that measurably lifts the team's engineering capability.

What you'll bring:

  • Depth in .NET engineering, typically gained over 6+ years of professional experience — we look for proven, hands-on depth rather than years alone, and assess this case by case.

  • Deep experience in system design and performance tuning, with a track record of shipping complex, multi-component systems.

  • Experience with .NET Framework 4.8 and .NET 10, and C#.

  • Strong SQL Server skills (queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, SSRS).

  • Strong understanding of HTTP, JSON, and RESTful API principles for consumer-facing and enterprise applications.

  • Proven experience with high-traffic applications emphasizing performance and scalability.

  • Understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns, and the ability to implement them where appropriate.

  • Self-starter with a keen ability to identify and resolve challenging issues.

  • Strong command of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation and modern engineering workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools, and the judgement to critically verify what they produce.

  • Commitment to knowledge-sharing and collaborative teamwork.

  • University degree in Computer Science or any related field.

  • Fluency in the Greek and English languages, both oral and written.

Bonus points 😉

  • Knowledge of how message brokers such as RabbitMQ and Apache Kafka work.

  • Knowledge of billing and subscription management systems, including subscription lifecycles, billing processes, cancellations, and asynchronous call handling.

This is a remote position.

REMOTE / WORK FROM HOME POSITION
Before applying, please note:

WHO ARE WE? FOUNTAIN FORWARD

We are a hyper-motivated crew of internet marketing experts based in Houston, Texas. We're on a mission to provide truly profitable data-driven marketing solutions, primarily for The Automotive industry.
We love working together to accomplish one thing: persuade people to do business with our clients, and do it more often. Seeing our clients make more money and collaborating together to accomplish their goals is what drives us to slam down a couple of espressos every morning and fire up our brain cells.
​
Purpose

Fountain Forward is hiring a Senior Full-Stack Developer to lead the design, build, and launch of our client portal while mentoring and managing a team of four junior developers. This role is hands-on: you will ship code, own architecture decisions, and raise the technical bar of the team.

Definitions & Abbreviations

  • Client Portal: Fountain Forward's customer-facing web application providing dashboards, reporting, and self-service tooling

  • RPC: Remote Procedure Call framework used for typed, high-performance service-to-service communication


Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical delivery of the Fountain Forward client portal, from architecture to production.

  • Lead, mentor, and manage a team of 4 junior developers through code reviews, pairing, and technical planning.

  • Design scalable backend services in Python (FastAPI) and a performant Next.js (TypeScript) frontend.

  • Architect data flows across Supabase (Postgres), Redis, and BigQuery, ensuring reliability and cost efficiency.

  • Set engineering standards: testing, CI/CD, code quality, observability, and security best practices.

  • Collaborate with product, data, and leadership to translate business goals into technical roadmaps.


Requirements

Required Experience

  • 5+ years building production web applications, with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role.

  • Strong proficiency in Next.js and TypeScript, including App Router, server components, and modern React patterns.

  • Solid backend experience with Python and FastAPI, including async programming and REST/RPC API design.

  • Hands-on experience with Postgres (Supabase a plus), Redis for caching and queuing, and BigQuery for analytics workloads.

  • Familiarity with optimization and RPC frameworks (e.g., gRPC, tRPC, Protocol Buffers, or equivalents).

  • Proven track record of mentoring junior engineers and leading small teams.

  • Comfort with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production monitoring.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with data-heavy or analytics-facing client portals.

  • Background in performance optimization at scale (query tuning, caching strategies, frontend performance).

  • Exposure to event-driven architectures and background job processing.

  • Previous experience in an agency, consultancy, or fast-moving product environment.

OUR HIRING PROCESS
1. Application Review
2. Initial Interview
3. Skills Assessment
4. Final Interview

Benefits

How We Work
  • Freedom and flexibility. We’re a team working from around the world. That is, as long as they show up on our weekly calls, do their job correctly, and have a good sense of accountability.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Working on a distributed team means you don’t have someone micromanaging you or looking over your shoulder to make sure you’re getting things done. We’re a team of do-ers who take full ownership for their results.
  • ABe helpful and dedicated. We help our clients be successful. We help our prospects get the right information and make the right decision whether or not it includes our services. We help our team members reach their full potential.

What We Offer
  • Technical ownership of a flagship product from day one.
  • A clear leadership path with a team to grow and develop.
  • Modern stack, pragmatic processes, and fast decision-making.
  • Competitive compensation aligned with seniority and impact.

The Perks!
  • Remote-First Culture: Work from home—or anywhere in the world. We value results, not where you log in from.
  • Flexible Schedule: We offer flexibility in your daily schedule (within reason) to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off: Enjoy an unlimited vacation policy with just two weeks’ notice and manager approval. We also offer paid sick days because your well-being matters.
  • Parental Leave: We understand the importance of supporting our team members during significant life events. Our maternity and paternity leave policy ensures you can prioritize your growing family without added stress.
  • Room to Grow: We’re a fast-growing company with massive opportunities for upward mobility. As we grow, you grow with us.

Our Values

Best Life

We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

Growth Mindset

AND IT'S NICE TO HAVE

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

About the role

  • What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

  • Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.

  • What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

What you'll do

  • Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

  • Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

  • Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

  • Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.

  • Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.

  • Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

  • Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

We're excited about you because

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.

  • You have 2+ years of professional Go experience, writing services that run in production, not side projects.

  • You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

  • You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

  • You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

  • You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

  • You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.

  • You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

Strong plus

  • Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

  • Experience running multi-tenant systems.

  • Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get

  • Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

  • Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

  • Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at .

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Technical Manager to lead our Platform Services Mobile Foundations engineering initiatives in Portugal!This is a Remote – Portugal position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Portugal.

In this role, you will lead a multidisciplinary software engineering team focused on building core frontend and mobile platform foundations, SDKs, and integration services (including push notifications, identity, and localization) across the entire Wellhub ecosystem.

As a Technical Manager, you will bridge hands-on technical architecture with people leadership and project management. You will directly manage a team of engineers, drive technical execution, align product roadmaps with system architecture, and mentor team members in career growth. While your primary focus will be people, execution, and strategy, your strong technical background, specifically with React and React Native ecosystems, will allow you to guide architectural discussions, perform code/design reviews, and maintain delivery quality.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Technical Project Management: Drive end-to-end delivery of complex cross-functional platform initiatives, aligning frontend/mobile requirements with Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) and core services.
  • Technical & Architectural Leadership: Act as a technical soundboard and leader for mobile/frontend architecture (React / React Native), ensuring scalable, robust design patterns and sound technical trade-offs.
  • Stakeholder & Cross-Team Collaboration: Serve as a key liaison between Product, UX, and consumer teams (e.g., CODE / Wellhub App team) to negotiate technical scope, roadmaps, and integration standards.
  • Culture & Engineering Excellence: Establish best practices for testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and developer experience across platform frontend services.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have proven experience managing and leading engineering teams (people management, hiring, performance management, career development).
  • You possess a solid software engineering background with hands-on experience in React and React Native ecosystems, as well as modern frontend/mobile architecture.
  • You have a track record of leading technical projects from conception to deployment, balancing engineering quality with time-to-market.
  • You understand distributed system architecture, including modern mobile architectures, Micro Frontends, BFF (Node.js), RESTful APIs, and GraphQL.
  • You demonstrate strong organizational and project management capabilities (roadmap execution, sprint planning, risk mitigation, resource allocation).
  • You possess strong communication skills, capable of bridging technical details with non-technical stakeholders in both Portuguese and English.
  • You foster an inclusive, collaborative culture and enjoy mentoring developers to help them reach their full potential.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in React / React Native & Mobile architecture are mandatory requirements

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Wellhub was named one of the Best Engineering Teams and Top IT Companies to Work For in Portugal! Join a team where technology, purpose, and wellbeing come together. Read more about our award here.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
SOFWARE ENGINEER

Check out The Global Talent Co.’s talent network:

The Role

You will join a company building the digital infrastructure for grant funding, helping organizations spend less time navigating funding logic, forms, and administration and more time on the projects and impact that matter.

The platform brings together research across 18,000+ funding programmes, AI-supported analysis and application drafting, expert review, and ongoing grant management. AI handles what can scale, while people bring experience and judgement where it matters.

As a Software Engineer, you will help build the product across the backend, frontend, and AI pipeline at the core of the platform. You will work directly with the CTO, who already has one successful exit, and learn first-hand how modern software is built in a clean, fast, AI-native environment.

This role is designed for someone early in their career who wants real responsibility and a steep learning curve. You will start with close guidance and progressively take on more independent ownership, with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

Position: Software Engineer

Seeking an early-career Software Engineer with solid programming fundamentals, curiosity across the stack, and a strong desire to learn how production software is built.

The ideal candidate has 1–3 years of experience or is a recent graduate with strong projects, and combines technical curiosity with high self-motivation, a user-first mindset, and an AI-native approach to development.

What you have built matters more than simply the number of years on your CV.



Responsibilities


Product Development & Full-Stack Engineering

  • Ship features end-to-end, from backend development through to the user interface.

  • Work across the stack, including React, Node/Express, Postgres, and AWS.

  • Start with close guidance and progressively take on greater independence and ownership.

  • Work closely with the CTO and grant team to build solutions based on real user problems rather than abstract tickets.

  • Build software with a user-first mindset, ensuring what you create works for real people.


AI Development

  • Help build the platform's AI pipeline from week one.

  • Work with prompt engineering, context management, and AI evaluations.

  • Gain hands-on experience with AI development and learn how AI-powered features are built and improved in production.

  • Use AI-native development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor as part of your engineering workflow.


Production & Debugging

  • Trace and fix bugs in the production environment.

  • Work with tools including Sentry, CloudWatch, and Postgres.

  • Learn how production systems work by investigating real issues and understanding their underlying causes.

  • Develop strong debugging and problem-solving skills through hands-on production experience.


Learning & Engineering Growth

  • Work closely with the CTO and receive direct technical mentoring.

  • Use code reviews as a learning tool, incorporating feedback and progressively contributing feedback to others.

  • Take increasing ownership of features and technical problems as your experience grows.

  • Develop toward independent feature ownership, with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

  • Contribute to improving the time from starting a project to a finished, submitted application through reliable features, automation, and product improvements.


Requirements

  • 1–3 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, or recent university graduation with strong technical projects.

  • What you have built matters more than simply the number of years of experience.

  • Solid fundamentals in TypeScript and/or JavaScript.

  • Curiosity and willingness to work across the full stack, including:

    • React

    • Node / Express

    • Postgres

    • AWS

  • Strong desire to learn how production software is built and operated.

  • High self-motivation and the ability to dig into problems rather than wait for instructions.

  • Comfortable receiving feedback and using it to improve your technical skills.

  • AI-native approach to software development, with familiarity using tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

  • User-first mindset, with a focus on building software that works for real people.

  • Strong curiosity, ownership, and willingness to take on increasing responsibility.

Nice to Have

  • First experience with AI tools or LLM APIs, including university or side projects.

  • German language skills at B1 level or above. The product and customers are German-speaking, while the team works bilingually.

  • A side project, open-source contribution, or other work built independently.

Growth Path

This role is designed as a springboard for your engineering career.

You will start with significant mentoring and guidance from the CTO, then progressively move toward independent ownership of complete features and technical problems.

The goal is that, over time, you can ship independently, contribute to technical decisions, and take ownership of increasingly complex parts of the product, with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

What We Offer

  • Direct mentoring from the CTO, who already has one successful exit and will work closely with you on your development.

  • A steep learning curve across a modern technology stack, AI-native development, and real production systems.

  • Real production ownership from day one, with increasing responsibility over time.

  • Fully remote work is possible.

  • Competitive entry-level salary and participation in company success.

  • Clear development path toward a senior engineering role.

  • €2,000 annual professional development budget.

  • Opportunity to work on a scalable SaaS product with clear market demand and genuine social impact.

  • Short decision paths and direct collaboration with the leadership team.

  • Team events and optional workations.

jobs.excerpt: About StoraStora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.
jobs.description:
About Stora

Stora is building the operating platform for modern self-storage businesses.

Our software helps operators manage bookings, payments, customers, facilities and day-to-day operations from one place, while automating much of the work that traditionally makes running a self-storage business unnecessarily complicated.

In just over five years, Stora has grown from an early-stage product into a platform used by more than 500 operators.

We’re a product-led, remote-first company with an experienced engineering team and ambitious plans for what comes next.

Now, as the engineering organisation grows, we’re hiring an Engineering Manager to make sure the way we lead, develop and support engineers grows with it.

The Role

This is a genuine people leadership role.

You’ll manage approximately 12 engineers working across three product teams, with the team expected to continue growing.

Each product team has a Tech Lead responsible for technical direction, alongside Product and Design. Your focus is different: the engineers themselves.

This isn’t a role for somebody looking to move away from engineering completely, though. You’ll need enough technical depth to understand the work, follow engineering discussions and ask good questions without needing to be the person making every technical decision.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Engineering and have support from People, but you’ll have meaningful autonomy to improve how engineering management works at Stora.

What Else You’ll Own

Engineering Management

  • Manage engineers across multiple product teams through regular, useful 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback.

  • Make expectations clear and help engineers understand what good performance looks like.

  • Identify performance issues early and handle difficult conversations properly when needed.

  • Support engineers in progressing from junior through senior and beyond.

  • Build strong relationships with engineers without creating unnecessary management overhead.

Performance & Progression

  • Own the engineering performance and progression approach.

  • Review and improve our existing career levels, expectations and review processes.

  • Make promotion and progression decisions that are consistent, evidence-based and understood by the team.

  • Create a culture where feedback happens throughout the year rather than being saved for formal reviews.

Hiring & Team Development

  • Own engineering hiring alongside the relevant Tech Leads and wider team.

  • Help define what we need before a search begins, assess candidates properly and maintain a high hiring bar.

  • Ensure new engineers have a structured and useful onboarding experience.

  • Think proactively about team composition, capability gaps and future hiring needs.

Team Health

  • Pay attention to engagement, retention, collaboration and emerging people issues across the engineering organisation.

  • Work with Tech Leads when team problems sit somewhere between technical delivery, behaviour and team dynamics.

  • Help maintain a strong remote engineering culture as Stora grows.

Technical Context

  • Stay close enough to the engineering work to understand what the team is solving and the environment they’re working within.

  • Be comfortable reading code, following pull requests and participating intelligently in technical conversations.

  • Partner with Tech Leads without competing with them for technical ownership.

What Success Looks Like

After your first year, we’d expect:

  • Engineers to have a clear understanding of what is expected of them and how they can progress.

  • Managers and engineers to be having better, more useful conversations about performance and development.

  • Performance issues to be addressed early rather than becoming surprises.

  • A progression framework that works for the engineering organisation Stora has become, not the company we were several years ago.

  • Stronger and more consistent hiring and onboarding.

  • The Head of Engineering spending less time acting as the default people manager for the entire engineering organisation.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager, rather than somebody taking their first step into management.

You’ll ideally have:

  • Previous experience directly managing software engineers across more than one team or product area.

  • A strong track record of developing engineers at different stages of their careers.

  • Hands-on experience managing performance, including difficult or underperformance situations.

  • Experience making promotion and progression decisions.

  • Experience running or improving engineering career frameworks, review cycles or progression processes.

  • Previous experience hiring software engineers and building effective interview processes.

  • An engineering background that allows you to understand code and contribute meaningfully to technical conversations.

  • The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in a remote environment.

  • A practical understanding of how AI tools are changing software engineering and experience using them in your own work.

Experience with Ruby or Rails would be useful, but it isn’t essential.

We’re much more interested in whether you can lead engineers well.

What This Role Isn’t

It’s worth being clear that this isn’t:

  • a Tech Lead role with some people management added on;

  • a delivery or project management position;

  • a Product Manager role;

  • a hands-on engineering role where you’ll spend most of your week writing production code;

  • a first Engineering Manager opportunity.

Technical leadership already exists within the product teams.

We’re hiring you because engineering management itself deserves dedicated ownership.

Our Technology

You won’t be expected to spend most of your time writing production code, but you should be comfortable working around our stack.

Backend: Rails, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, TimescaleDB

Frontend: Turbo, React, ViewComponents, Sass

Testing: Minitest, Playwright

Deployment: GitHub Actions, Heroku

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary: Highly competitive and depending on experience

  • Location: Fully remote within the UK or Ireland

  • Belfast office: Available for anyone who wants to use it

  • Private health insurance for you and your family

  • Company pension

  • 35 days’ annual leave inclusive of applicable public/statutory holidays, depending on location

  • Learning and development support

  • Share options

  • Work-from-home budget

Our Hiring Process

We’re reviewing applications as they arrive rather than waiting for a closing date.

If your experience looks like a strong match, we’ll explain the process clearly from the outset and move quickly.

Equal Opportunities at Stora

Stora is an equal opportunities employer.c

We want to build a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect, and where different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are valued.

We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment and employment decisions are based on merit, competence and business need, and we promote equality of opportunity and fair participation in line with our responsibilities under Northern Ireland equality legislation.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Developer (Angular)
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.
jobs.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a product-focused Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).
  • Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked.
  • Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution.
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.
  • Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
  • Full overlap with CET working hours.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

﻿Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

  • Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
    • Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors

• Processed 5M uploads per day

  • Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Database & Infrastructure Engineer

(Full-Stack Systems)

We process millions of files per day and store hundreds of millions of media records.

Your job is to make our data layer world-class.

You will:

  • Optimize and scale our PostgreSQL (Supabase) infrastructure
    • Design indexing, partitioning, and query strategies for large-scale media datasets
    • Improve performance across ingestion, enrichment, and retrieval pipelines
    • Build internal tools for querying and auditing large datasets
    • Create customer-ready dataset sample packs
    • Design and automate dataset exports and delivery pipelines (S3, secure transfers, custom formats)
    • Work across backend, ML, and product teams to support new features

This is not just DBA work.

You’ll help design the systems that move and package the data powering frontier AI labs.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Strong PostgreSQL expertise (indexing, partitioning, performance tuning)
    • Experience working with large datasets (100M+ records preferred)
    • Deep understanding of storage systems (S3 or similar object storage)
    • Strong backend experience (TypeScript, Python, or similar)
    • Comfort building internal tooling and automation scripts
    • Ability to move between database, backend, and infrastructure work

Bonus:

  • Experience with data pipelines (ETL, transformation layers)
    • Experience with vector databases (pgvector, FAISS, Pinecone)
    • Experience delivering structured datasets to enterprise customers
    • DevOps experience (CI/CD, infra automation)
    • Experience working with media-heavy systems

CURRENT STACK

Backend

  • PostgreSQL (Supabase) — 188M+ media files

• S3 storage

  • Deno / TypeScript edge functions

• Python ML pipelines

Frontend

• SwiftUI (migrating to Flutter)

COMPENSATION

  • Base salary: $150,000 - $250,000

• $750,000 – $1,500,000 equity

We move fast and work hard.

If you're excited to build the world’s largest consumer app, let’s talk!

GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

You’ll join a team operating at the frontier of applied AI data infrastructure.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Own core systems that power one of the largest human data networks in the world
    • Design infrastructure that directly influences what data trains next-generation AI models
    • Build at real scale - millions of uploads per day, adversarial environments, global contributors
    • Ship alongside a team that has built marketplaces, AI systems, and products used by millions

If you’re excited to move fast, build systems that matter, and help define how human data powers frontier AI, let’s talk.

Compensation Range: $150K - $250K

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.excerpt: Mathematics Expert (MSc.  or PhD)Pay: $80–$120/hour Location: Global, fully remote Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week) Schedule: Flexible—you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired as long as you're active.
jobs.description:
Mathematics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Pay: $80–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired as long as you're active.

We are looking for highly skilled Mathematics Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving advanced mathematical problem-solving, computational mathematics, numerical methods, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating mathematical tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require translating a mathematical problem into a computational procedure, implementing the relevant equations or algorithms, calculating a reproducible result, testing special cases, and determining whether the final answer is mathematically and numerically valid.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate advanced mathematical and computational problems.
  2. Translate mathematical requirements into precise, executable workflows.
  3. Implement mathematical workflows using Python and command-line-accessible tools.
  4. Use Python to automate calculations, numerical experiments, parameter sweeps, visualization, and result validation.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computational Science, Theoretical Computer Science, or a closely related quantitative field; or
  2. A BS in Mathematics or a closely related quantitative field plus at least 1–2 years of mathematics-focused professional or research experience in top companies/institutions.
  3. Strong expertise in at least one mathematical area, such as applied mathematics, numerical analysis, optimization, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, algebra, geometry, mathematical modeling, or dynamical systems.

Relevant tools may include Python, SymPy, SageMath, SciPy, CVXPY, NumPy, GNU Octave, Julia, or similar programmatic mathematical software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, CVXPY, statsmodels, NetworkX, numerical solvers, optimization libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.
